chapters.title: Chapter 651 - 388: Interrogation, the Ogre Lord’s Difficulties (Part 3)
paragraphs: The two heads of the ogre spoke simultaneously: "Stop!"
Of course, Han Xing continued to ignore it, leading his team forward.
The two-headed ogre’s face stiffened, seemingly losing face a bit.
"Hmph."
With a cold snort, the ogre’s divine power directly enveloped them.
[You have been confined by the divine power of the Ogre Lord; after judging both parties’ divine power, this confinement is ineffective.]
Seeing this notification, Han Xing laughed.
His current divine power value exceeded 6000.
Ordinary demigods couldn’t dream of oppressing him with their divine power values.
The same was true for other team members.
The Ogre Lord was also surprised.
Unexpectedly, he, a dignified demigod, couldn’t suppress these legends with divine power.
But moments later, it reacted.
It directly said, "If you continue to ignore this king’s warning, this king will attack you directly!"
Hearing this, everyone present turned their gaze over.
Was the Ogre Lord looking for trouble with that group of the Human Race?
What happened?
Han Xing shrugged and finally turned around.
"Do you have something to say?"
The Ogre Lord directly asked, "Is the death of our clan’s demon son, Gulichi, related to you?"
Before Han Xing could answer.
At this moment, the Dwarf King came over.
"Gulidun, didn’t I tell you that your clan’s Gulichi died during the mechanical beast uprising?"
"These Humans are my guests."
"Don’t continue causing trouble here."
However, Gulichi sneered coldly: "Krookum, you don’t understand."
"The Ogre Race’s bloodline has a special ability."
"Any being tainted with our clan’s blood will carry a certain scent."
"I smelled that scent on that Human."
At this moment, the Ogre Lord directly concluded: "It was you who killed our demon son!"
Everyone present was extremely surprised.
The Dwarf King pondered for a moment, seemingly recalling something.
He looked at Han Xing and asked in confusion, "Human friend, is what Gulidun said true?
"Did you really kill the Ogre Race’s demon son?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing directly said, "That’s right, I killed him."
Hearing Han Xing directly admit it.
Everyone present, including those demigod-level powerhouses, widened their eyes.
At this moment, the Ogre Lord laughed directly: "It really was you."
"Very well, now I can openly attack you!"
As soon as the words fell.
The Ogre Lord’s overwhelming divine power surged.
The entire sky was instantly dyed blood red!
"Wait a minute!"
The Dwarf King instantly intervened, standing in front of the Ogre Lord.
The Ogre Lord asked, "Krumman, this human admitted himself that he killed our demon son."
"Are you still going to stop me?"
The Dwarf King frowned.
In the Holy Spirit Realm.
A clan’s demon sons and daughters are cultivated as the next clan leaders.
Han Xing and his group killing the demon son truly was an irreconcilable enmity.
This is also an unwritten rule in the Holy Spirit Realm.
However, if it were an ordinary person.
The Ogre Lord would kill them without hesitation, and the Dwarf King wouldn’t bother stopping it.
However, the Dwarf King knew the identity of this Human.
He is not only the Master of the Human Race but also the current Saint Master of the Witch Race.
In terms of status, he wasn’t lower than them, these demigods.
The Dwarf King, somewhat conflicted, said, "Could there be some misunderstanding here?"
The Ogre Lord sneered coldly: "Misunderstanding?"
"I don’t care about any misunderstanding; I only know that this brat killed our demon son!"
"So, I will devour him to avenge our demon son!"
Speaking of which, the Ogre Lord’s eyes were already blood-red.
"No, just devouring him is not enough to quell my anger."
"I want to devour his fellow Humans, then go to the present Human location and wipe them all out!"
"Only then can I quell the anger in my heart."
Hearing this, Han Xing lifted his gaze.
Murderous intent appeared in his eyes.
The Ogre Lord saw Han Xing’s eyes filled with murder and laughed, "Interesting, it seems you truly want to fight me."
The atmosphere instantly became tense and confrontational.
On the field, all the demigods stopped in their tracks,
all watching this spectacle.
With eyes carrying a sense of entertainment.
Among them, a giant five-petal flower spoke: "This Human is truly interesting."
"To dare release killing intent towards the Ogre Lord, does he really think he won’t die quickly enough?"
Other demigod-level powerhouses chimed in.
"Indeed, he overestimates himself."
"This is the Dwarf Realm; if he sincerely admitted fault, the Dwarf King might protect him."
"But now, this Human is undoubtedly doomed."
"Yes, it’s rather foolish."
However, a small stature girl beside them quickly intervened: "Clan Leader, don’t say any more!"
This giant seven-petal flower asked in confusion: "Cyan Lotus, what’s wrong with you?"
The girl’s face looked very uncomfortable.
Still asking what happened!
Those Humans you mentioned are not to be trifled with!
They are gods of slaughter!
Though demigods are strong in the Holy Spirit Realm.
But in that god of slaughter’s eyes, demigods are existences to be shot down with just an arrow!
She already felt that that god of slaughter was ready to take action.
She now feared that her clan leader might say something wrong and attract that god’s attention.
The group of divine sons and daughters who experienced the relic’s journey also began to stop their clan’s demigods.
At this time.
The Dwarf King, caught in the middle, was also troubled.
On one hand, he didn’t want the Ogre Lord to kill Han Xing and them here.
Yet on the other hand, it was a sea of blood and deep hatred.
And this was also the accepted rule in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Afterward, Han Xing said: "Dwarf King, you should step aside."
"Since this guy wants to fight us, then let it come."
"I don’t have the energy to waste too much time here."

chapters.title: Chapter 652 - 389: This Kid Is Terrifying!
paragraphs: Upon hearing these words, the Dwarf King looked at Han Xing with puzzlement.
Seeing his eyes filled with murderous intent.
"You... alright then."
The Dwarf King sighed and made way for them on the battlefield.
At this moment, the Ogre Lord wore a sinister smile.
"Finally, no one is stopping us now."
"So, have you decided how you want to be devoured by me?"
Han Xing gave him a casual glance, "You talk too much."
At this moment.
The Ogre Lord once again unleashed his full aura, and half of the Dwarf Realm felt the pressure.
It seemed to have used some kind of secret technique.
The body, already over ten meters tall, instantly expanded to ten thousand meters in size.
Layers of red divine power in the air were like a web, completely blocking the humans’ path.
Han Xing also felt the power of the Ogre Lord.
Middle-tier Demigod!
Previously formidable indeed.
A rather troublesome enemy as well.
But now, it seems somewhat lacking already.
"So then, some ants, die for me!"
The Ogre Lord cast a divine power web over.
Han Xing calmly said, "Everyone, attack together, let’s take it down swiftly."
The four nodded in agreement.
Then, Shen Yun’s buff was applied.
Everyone’s aura surged significantly.
The Ogre Lord was slightly surprised, "Reached high-tier legend? Impressive."
"But, still not enough."
As these words fell, it opened two large mouths.
A terrifying suction force emerged.
It wanted to swallow everyone whole.
However, what it didn’t know was that this was just a common tactic for Han Xing’s team.
Next moment, special effects emerged from the five of them.
Their momentum instantly rose to the legendary limit!
The Ogre Lord’s pupils shrank.
Before it could react.
Suddenly, it felt a wave of intense chill approaching.
Then, the entire Ogre Lord was frozen into a massive ice sculpture ten thousand meters high!
It was exactly Zhang Lianmeng’s legendary skill—Ice Age.
In just an instant, the giant ice sculpture began to show countless cracks,
the skill’s control time was in fact under a second.
Nevertheless, a second was entirely enough for the team.
The next moment.
The attacks of the four, infused with a power that could even make demigods apprehensive, precisely struck Gulichi.
Among them.
There was even a newly learned legendary skill by Cheng Jianyong—Heaven-Sundering Sword!
The terrifying sword qi nearly tore the sky in half.
A spatial rift stretching tens of thousands of meters appeared.
All the demigods looked at the figure who launched that sword, full of astonishment.
"This young one, only at the legendary level, can unleash such terrifying sword qi!"
"An extraordinary demon! An extraordinary demon indeed!"
Cheng Jianyong saw the surprised looks of those demigods, full of pride.
Suddenly, he had a flash of inspiration and loudly proclaimed:
"Today, I, Cheng Jianyong, will cut down a demigod with a single sword!"
With these words spoken.
Even the demigod powerhouses about to leave the Dwarf Kingdom turned back.
They were all fixated on Cheng Jianyong, who had made that Heaven-Shocking Sword.
Meanwhile.
The sword qi and the team’s attacks had already landed on the enormous ice sculpture!
"Boom!"
Space shattered, divine power exploded!
At this moment, the massive ten-thousand-meter body of the Ogre Lord was already full of fissures.
Then, it directly shattered!
"Puff!"
A dazzling blood flower appeared.
At the same time.
Red blood rain suddenly began to fall from the sky.
Streaks of dark lightning struck down.
Amidst the crowd, a strong figure suddenly exclaimed.
"A demigod has fallen! This is the omen of a demigod’s fall!"
On the field, those demigods looked utterly terrified as if they had seen a ghost!
Because they knew, the appearance of this phenomenon meant.
Gulidun was dead!
Killed by these humans at the legendary level!
At the same time, far away in the Ogre Realm.
A statue collapsed with a thunderous crash.
Countless ogres, sensing something dreadful, knelt down on the spot.
Just as when the Witch Race Saint Master Helas perished back then.
The sky of the Ogre Race suddenly became shrouded in dark clouds!
A torrential downpour began.
One by one, the legendary ogres awoke from their slumber in alarm.
They rushed out of their resting places, looking at the scene in the sky with sheer terror!
"What happened? The Demon Lord has fallen?"
"Impossible!"
"The Demon Lord is a demigod level being, and has activated most of its ancient bloodline, how could it possibly fall?"
Yet, no matter how much they refused to believe it.
The cold reality was laid before them.
At this moment, the ogres only felt like the sky was about to collapse.
First, the Demon Son died accidentally.
Now, their pillar of support, the Ogre Lord, also met an inexplicable end.
Today could be said to be the darkest day for the Ogre Race.
In the Dwarf Realm.
After Han Xing and his team burst forth, eliminating the Ogre Lord, they simultaneously received system notifications,

[Successfully killed the leader of the Ogre faction: Gulidun, earning 17.4 billion experience points, gaining 50 legendary points, successfully absorbing the opponent’s divine power, divine power +100.]
[Due to killing the opposing faction leader, successfully absorbed the opponent faction’s fortune value.]
[Han Xing’s faction fortune value +10000.]
A series of system notifications brought joy to the faces of Han Xing and his team.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in amazement, "Tsk tsk, these kill rewards are really nice."
"Not only added so many legendary points, but also a full ten thousand fortune value points."
"Almost like a 10% boost."
Han Xing nodded.
The rewards from killing the Ogre Lord were indeed quite satisfactory.
At this moment, a strange idea suddenly occurred to Han Xing.
On the field, these dozens of demigods were likely the leaders of their respective factions.

chapters.title: Chapter 653 - 389: This Kid Is Terrifying!
paragraphs: If, we could just take them all out.
Then Han Xing’s camp fortune value might instantly increase by hundreds of thousands of points, wouldn’t it?
Noticing the scrutinizing gaze of Han Xing.
The dozens of demigod-level powerhouses on the field felt a chill running down their necks.
If it were in the past, a Legendary Level existence daring to look at them this way.
They would have immediately made a move without a second thought.
However now, because they saw the scene of the Ogre Lord being killed in one hit.
All the demigods swallowed their saliva but still did not speak.
Even those few demigods with the worst temper dared not say much.
After all, they had already witnessed the terrifying strength of this Human Race.
On the field, none of the demigods had the confidence to withstand such an attack.
At this time, the words of the Dwarf King interrupted Han Xing’s thoughts.
"Dear young friends of the Human Race, you really are..."
The Dwarf King seemed to be searching for words to describe them.
After a moment, he said.
"Hidden and unfathomable."
Han Xing smiled but didn’t explain anything.
He said directly, "Your Majesty the King, I’ll leave matters here for you to handle."
"Sorry for causing you some trouble."
The Dwarf King shook his head, "No trouble at all, I didn’t even make a move."
Han Xing also laughed.
"In that case, we won’t disturb any further."
The Dwarf King nodded, "Rest assured, you can go. I’ll handle everything here."
"The Dwarf Realm always welcomes you to visit again."
Compared to before, the Dwarf King’s attitude had softened considerably.
On one hand, it was because of Han Xing and the others’ relationship with him.
On the other hand, it was also because of his strength.
In this world, only by holding power that makes enemies fear you.
Can you earn the respect of others.
After speaking, Han Xing left the place with his teammates.
At the same time, the Dwarf King watched the backs of Han Xing and his companions.
Then he shook his head and sighed, "Hidden so deeply, even I couldn’t see they possessed such power.
"This generation of the Human Race is indeed extraordinary."
Just as the Dwarf King was about to turn and leave,
A voice transmitting divine power suddenly echoed in his ear.
After hearing the content of the voice.
The Dwarf King’s eyes instantly widened.
Even because of excessive shock, his divine power almost went out of control.
"Boom!"
The sky and earth changed color.
The sky over the Dwarf Realm, originally covered by blood-red clouds.
Now, due to the Dwarf King’s aura going uncontrolled, those clouds instantly dispersed!
Next to him, a group of demigods looked at the Dwarf King in astonishment.
"Krumman, what’s wrong?"
The Dwarf King did not answer.
It took him a long while to calm his excited heart.
He stared, surprised, at the retreating backs of Han Xing and his companions, seemingly wanting to rush over to inquire more.
But shortly after, the Dwarf King gave up on the idea.
His gaze turned towards the inside of his kingdom, becoming immensely profound.
A day later.
In the desolate region tens of thousands of kilometers from the Dwarf Realm.
Han Xing and his team of five returned to Sky Island.
Coal Ball joyfully pranced around on it, with Cheng Jianyong playing alongside.
While Han Xing and the others were away.
Coal Ball had kept watch over Sky Island alone for over a month.
Now seeing Han Xing and the others return, Coal Ball was extremely happy.
At this moment.
Shen Yun came to Han Xing’s side and said, "Brother Xing, did you share with the Dwarf King news of the Insect Race?"
"Do you think he will believe it?"
Han Xing shrugged, "Who knows."
"But it doesn’t matter if he believes it or not, it has nothing to do with us."
"I just informed him of the hidden demigods of the Insect Race within the Dwarf Race."
"Consider it repayment for his recent assistance to us.
Shen Yun nodded.
How the Dwarf King would handle it was indeed not their concern.
After playing with Coal Ball to the point of sweating profusely, Cheng Jianyong excitedly ran over and asked.
"Brother Xing, where are we going next?"
Han Xing thought for a moment and mentioned a location.
"The Flame Plateau."
Upon hearing this relatively unfamiliar name, everyone looked a bit puzzled.
Then Han Xing explained, "One of the Divine Formats for the Elemental Law God’s class change task is located within the Flame Plateau."
The team nodded in realization.
The seven Divine Formats for the Elemental Law God were their next targets.
After all, all five of them were at Level 57.
Reaching Level 60 and transforming into demigod-level wouldn’t take much longer.
Naturally, they need to prepare the Divine Formats in advance.
Zhang Lianmeng looked at Han Xing with a smile of infatuation.
Besides the Elemental Divine Format.
Han Xing also had a collection task to complete.
Which was the Master of Stars Set.
As a Holy Artifact Set, its attributes were bound to be terrifying.
But so far, Han Xing hadn’t found any related clues.
So, he could only put it aside, searching for it in due course.
However, before that, Han Xing had one major enhancement to proceed with.
That was to digest part of the gains from the recent Ancient Ruins.
Han Xing looked at his territory Sky Island.
During this period, he raised many buildings again.
Including a new Lord’s Mansion, Miracle Tower, and Demon Furnace.
Now, this new Ten Thousand Stars City was already exceptionally powerful.
With as many as 350 Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
Proven through practice, its firepower here could already annihilate a Divine Spirit.
And with the materials Han Xing currently held.
He could raise a total of ten thousand Spiritual Godslaying Cannons!

After a moment, he said.
"Hidden and unfathomable."
Han Xing smiled but didn’t explain anything.
He said directly, "Your Majesty the King, I’ll leave matters here for you to handle."
"Sorry for causing you some trouble."
The Dwarf King shook his head, "No trouble at all, I didn’t even make a move."
Han Xing also laughed.
"In that case, we won’t disturb any further."
The Dwarf King nodded, "Rest assured, you can go.
I’ll handle everything here."
"The Dwarf Realm always welcomes you to visit again."
Compared to before, the Dwarf King’s attitude had softened considerably.
On one hand, it was because of Han Xing and the others’ relationship with him.
On the other hand, it was also because of his strength.
In this world, only by holding power that makes enemies fear you.
Can you earn the respect of others.
After speaking, Han Xing left the place with his teammates.
At the same time, the Dwarf King watched the backs of Han Xing and his companions.
Then he shook his head and sighed, "Hidden so deeply, even I couldn’t see they possessed such power.
"This generation of the Human Race is indeed extraordinary."
Just as the Dwarf King was about to turn and leave,
A voice transmitting divine power suddenly echoed in his ear.
After hearing the content of the voice.
The Dwarf King’s eyes instantly widened.
Even because of excessive shock, his divine power almost went out of control.
"Boom!"
The sky and earth changed color.
The sky over the Dwarf Realm, originally covered by blood-red clouds.
Now, due to the Dwarf King’s aura going uncontrolled, those clouds instantly dispersed!
Next to him, a group of demigods looked at the Dwarf King in astonishment.
"Krumman, what’s wrong?"
The Dwarf King did not answer.
It took him a long while to calm his excited heart.
He stared, surprised, at the retreating backs of Han Xing and his companions, seemingly wanting to rush over to inquire more.
But shortly after, the Dwarf King gave up on the idea.
His gaze turned towards the inside of his kingdom, becoming immensely profound.
A day later.
In the desolate region tens of thousands of kilometers from the Dwarf Realm.
Han Xing and his team of five returned to Sky Island.
Coal Ball joyfully pranced around on it, with Cheng Jianyong playing alongside.
While Han Xing and the others were away.
Coal Ball had kept watch over Sky Island alone for over a month.
Now seeing Han Xing and the others return, Coal Ball was extremely happy.
At this moment.
Shen Yun came to Han Xing’s side and said, "Brother Xing, did you share with the Dwarf King news of the Insect Race?"
"Do you think he will believe it?"
Han Xing shrugged, "Who knows."
"But it doesn’t matter if he believes it or not, it has nothing to do with us."
"I just informed him of the hidden demigods of the Insect Race within the Dwarf Race."
"Consider it repayment for his recent assistance to us.
Shen Yun nodded.
How the Dwarf King would handle it was indeed not their concern.
After playing with Coal Ball to the point of sweating profusely, Cheng Jianyong excitedly ran over and asked.
"Brother Xing, where are we going next?"
Han Xing thought for a moment and mentioned a location.
"The Flame Plateau."
Upon hearing this relatively unfamiliar name, everyone looked a bit puzzled.
Then Han Xing explained, "One of the Divine Formats for the Elemental Law God’s class change task is located within the Flame Plateau."
The team nodded in realization.
The seven Divine Formats for the Elemental Law God were their next targets.
After all, all five of them were at Level 57.
Reaching Level 60 and transforming into demigod-level wouldn’t take much longer.
Naturally, they need to prepare the Divine Formats in advance.
Zhang Lianmeng looked at Han Xing with a smile of infatuation.
Besides the Elemental Divine Format.
Han Xing also had a collection task to complete.
Which was the Master of Stars Set.
As a Holy Artifact Set, its attributes were bound to be terrifying.
But so far, Han Xing hadn’t found any related clues.
So, he could only put it aside, searching for it in due course.
However, before that, Han Xing had one major enhancement to proceed with.
That was to digest part of the gains from the recent Ancient Ruins.
Han Xing looked at his territory Sky Island.
During this period, he raised many buildings again.
Including a new Lord’s Mansion, Miracle Tower, and Demon Furnace.
Now, this new Ten Thousand Stars City was already exceptionally powerful.
With as many as 350 Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
Proven through practice, its firepower here could already annihilate a Divine Spirit.
And with the materials Han Xing currently held.
He could raise a total of ten thousand Spiritual Godslaying Cannons!

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - 389: This Kid Is Terrifying!
paragraphs: From this, it’s evident how terrifying their harvest is this time!
Of course, over ten thousand units is somewhat exaggerated.
This time, they only collected a large amount of Insect Emperor Stone (Philosopher’s Stone) and Calamity Divine Gold.
To build these high-tier weapons, they still need Shimmering Terra Stone, Shadow Divine Stone, and other materials.
Therefore, thinking of suddenly building ten thousand units is impossible.
"It seems that the idea of using Territory Defense Towers to crush the Divine Spirits won’t succeed in the short term."
Han Xing shook his head with some regret.
At this moment, he checked the four blueprints in his backpack.
They are: [Catastrophe-level Defense Tower]: Silent Annihilation Lightning, Fury Heart Storm, Withered Snowflakes.
And one high-tier ancient weapon blueprint: [Frozen Star Cannon]
Han Xing has already checked the attributes of the three high-tier ancient weapons.
Only the last Frozen Star Cannon he hasn’t looked into yet.
So, he opened the blueprint interface.

[High-tier Ancient Weapon: Frozen Star Cannon]: Able to converge an energy shell with intense freezing aura, causing freezing damage to enemies within a diameter of 5 to 50 kilometers, putting them in a 0.1-second to permanent frozen state.
[Farthest Strike Distance]: 100,000 kilometers.
[Attack Power]: 500,000.
[Defense Value]: 300,000.
[Construction Materials]: Philosopher’s Stone*5000, Extreme Ice Divine Stone*5000, Calamity Divine Gold*20, Chaos Divine Stone*10.
Compared to the three catastrophe-level weapons, the Frozen Star Cannon belongs to the same tier of ancient weapons.
Seeing the freezing effect on it, Han Xing pondered.
"In this case, the Frozen Star Cannon should be able to produce a combined skill effect with Fury Heart Storm and Withered Snowflakes."
"Just in time, when taming that Slime last time, I discovered a massive Sky Island."
"And on that Sky Island, there are plenty of Extreme Ice Divine Stones."
"Now, I can build a batch of them in bulk."
Thinking of this, Han Xing checked his reserve of Extreme Ice Divine Stones.
[Extreme Ice Divine Stone]*1.17 million...
"It seems the Witch Race hasn’t been idle this month."
"In fully developing that Ice Continent, they actually increased my reserve by over a million Extreme Ice Divine Stones."
Thinking of this.
Han Xing waved his hand grandly.
Began mass-building Catastrophe-level Defense Towers and Frozen Star Cannons.
The system prompt appeared.

[Would you like to consume materials: Philosopher’s Stone*500,000, Extreme Ice Divine Stone*500,000, Shadow Divine Stone*500,000, Calamity Divine Gold*2500 to build 50 Withered Snowflakes Catastrophe-level Defense Towers?]
[Would you like to consume materials: Philosopher’s Stone*500,000, Extreme Ice Divine Stone*500,000, Calamity Divine Gold*2000, Chaos Divine Stone*1000 to build 100 Frozen Star Cannons?]
Han Xing directly clicked yes!
"Rumble!"
The new Ten Thousand Stars City, on the giant Sky Island.
Over a hundred massive clouds of smoke appeared around!
Building so many Catastrophe-level Defense Towers and high-tier ancient weapons at once.
Even the Dwarf Race had never done so.
The number of defense towers whipped up by Han Xing this time.
Is almost equivalent to the Dwarf Realm’s total number of high-end defense towers!
Moreover, the key point.
Han Xing has two Holy Artifact Steles to boost the attack of defense towers.
But the Dwarf Race does not.
Instantly, the difference is seen!
"Very good, these 150 defense towers can greatly enhance the strength of my territory!"
"From originally barely dealing with one Divine Spirit, now handling two at the same time should not be a problem."
Han Xing’s face revealed joy.
As for the other two types of Catastrophe-level Defense Towers.
Among them, Silent Annihilation Lightning requires Thunder Divine Stone, and Fury Heart Storm requires Waveless Metal.
These two materials.
Han Xing currently has no reserves at all.
Thus, not a single one has been built.
However, Han Xing already knows the clues for these two materials.
It is also related to the places he plans to visit next.
Thinking of this, Han Xing thought, "Soon."
"The gap between me having the Power to crush Divine Spirits is not much!"
The Sky Island continued advancing forward.
The target is, the Flame Plateau five million kilometers away!
Five days later.
The Ten Thousand Stars City crossed the vast uninhabited zone.
All around were floating Sky Islands, only with signs of some wild creatures’ activity.
The Holy Spirit Realm is really too vast.
Despite having so many races now.
But in the middle, there are still many uninhabited zones.
These places don’t lack resources.
On the contrary, the resources are very abundant.
At least, along the way, Han Xing encountered many Sky Islands containing a large amount of Terrastone and Rhythm Black Iron.
But due to the lack of population in the Holy Spirit Realm.
These places have not been developed.
For these Sky Islands, Han Xing selected some larger ones to explore.
Cleared the monsters inside, then incorporated them into the new Ten Thousand Stars City.
Waiting for the next return to the Witch Race Territory, let the miners extract them.
Three days later.
Finally, the surrounding scenery changed.
The sky here became a bright red, the farther you look, the more vivid the red becomes.
As if, this is where the Sun falls.
The area is constantly covered in high temperature.
Barely a few hundred kilometers forward.
Surface temperature already reached over 70 degrees.
Cheng Jianyong said with a peculiar expression, "This feeling is similar to the Abyss Realm."
"There it’s also so hot, covered in high temperature all year round."
Indeed.
With Cheng Jianyong’s mention, everyone recalled.
Here, indeed resembles the environment of the Abyss Realm somewhat.
However, the Abyss Realm has a complete continent.
But here, there are just Sky Islands covered with red clouds.
Shen Yun seemed to suddenly recall something and asked, "Brother Xing, with our current strength, should we explore the Abyss Realm?"
Han Xing thought for a moment and then nodded.
"It should be possible."
"After handling matters on the Flame Plateau, we’ll take time to go to the Abyssal Rift."
"Let’s see if we can get the first clearance rewards on the 80th and 90th levels."

chapters.title: Chapter 655 - 390: Arrival at the Flame Plateau
paragraphs: Han Xing and the others were discussing their next venture to the Abyssal Rift.
Previously, they had refrained from venturing forth because a Great Demon Monarch was guarding the 70th level.
It had been nearly a year since their last trip to the Abyssal Rift.
Now, they had the power to slay a demigod.
Naturally, they intended to reclaim their honor.
Han Xing added, "However, once we enter, let’s not go overboard."
"The power of the Abyss Realm is incredibly strong and unfathomable."
The group nodded in agreement upon hearing this.
After all, they all knew the power of the Abyss Realm far exceeded their imagination.
The demigod-level Great Demon Monarchs were not limited to just one.
Among them, there were even more powerful Demon Monarchs.
Shen Yun said, "I heard from intelligence reports that recently those Abyss Demons have been harassing the Elf Race."
"Does this mean those demons are preparing to invade the Holy Spirit Realm again?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment and shook his head, saying, "I’m not quite sure."
"However, such a major event affects all the powerhouses in the Holy Spirit Realm, so we don’t need to worry about it."
"If the Demon Race invades, I imagine those hidden Divine Spirits in the Holy Spirit Realm will surely step in."
Shen Yun nodded in agreement.
Ten Thousand Stars City continued to progress.
A few hours later.
They delved deeper into the Flame Plateau, advancing over hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
The Sky Islands here exhibited a different change.
No longer covered by clouds.
But instead, they were on fire!
Yes, the entire Sky Island was aflame.
The temperature here had reached over eight hundred degrees Celsius.
Many substances had hit their ignition points and begun to combust.
Han Xing and his companions, being Legendary Powerhouses, could withstand this temperature.
The burning Sky Islands were all around.
Occasionally falling into the Endless Void like meteor showers.
A scene reminiscent of doomsday.
Cheng Jianyong marveled as he took pictures, occasionally using the recording function.
They advanced another few hundred thousand kilometers.
The temperature here had exceeded three thousand degrees.
Even a block of iron would turn red hot and possibly melt.
The air became unbearably hot, with not a trace of oxygen present.
The entire world seemed like a massive furnace.
However, the group could still tolerate the heat.
Including Ten Thousand Stars City, as it was shielded by the group’s Divine Power.
So the structures on it remained unaffected.
Cheng Jianyong conjured a barrel of ice from nowhere, crunching on it with audible cracks.
Shen Yun asked speechlessly, "Where did you get that?"
Cheng Jianyong, clutching the ice barrel, pointed near Ten Thousand Stars City.
"From those new Frozen Star Cannons and Calamity Towers Brother Xing built, they keep emitting cold air, it’s freezing."
"I put a barrel of water there, and within seconds, it was frozen into ice cubes, like a natural big ice chest."
Upon hearing this.
Everyone turned to look.
In the Ten Thousand Stars City territory.
Stood around a hundred massive base structures.
Atop them, a gigantic elliptical energy cannon.
The cannon body was over five kilometers, with a mouth diameter reaching an astonishing over a hundred meters!
From the base to the cannon body, it was all ice blue.
The ground in that area had turned completely into permafrost.
These were the Frozen Star Cannons.
And on the other side of the Frozen Star Cannons.
Stood dozens of strange structures.
They looked like towering, steel-crafted pine trees.
Completely snow-white, towering over ten thousand meters.
The trunks were bare, with only a cluster of ice-blue leaves at the top.
However, those leaves were snowflake-shaped.
Occasionally, they shook down glistening snowflakes from the top.
These were the catastrophe-level weapons, Withered Snowflakes.
The group’s amazement at their peculiar appearance lasted quite some time.
But upon considering their attack style simulating the calamity of the void.
Their appearance seemed more fitting.
Shen Yun snatched the ice barrel from Cheng Jianyong and laughed heartily, "Let me have a taste too!
Cheng Jianyong didn’t mind having his ice barrel taken.
After all, he had his fill.
Cheng Jianyong looked at the nearby burning Sky Islands in awe, saying, "Brother Xing, with such temperatures here.
"Could anything really survive in this place?"
Han Xing smiled, "Who said anything about life here?"
Cheng Jianyong was taken aback,
"Uh, didn’t you say there was a powerful race on the Flame Plateau."
"Their clan leader even had demigod-level power?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, there is such a race."
"However, they aren’t any form of life."
"They’re a group of Stone Men."
The group’s eyes filled with confusion, "Stone Men?"
Han Xing nodded, "More precisely, they are a group of Flaming Stone Men."
"But they possess intelligence and know how to cultivate."
"So, they’ve survived on the Flame Plateau."
The group suddenly understood and nodded.
Hours later.
They finally reached the core region of the Flame Plateau.
It was the highest temperature area.
Everything here was crimson.
The sky, the clouds, even the air, was red.
However, at this moment.
Something different appeared before them,
An unending black mountain range, stretching beyond sight.
It lay across their path.
This mountain range resembled a naturally formed Sky Island.
On it, all was charred black.
Occasionally, small areas of flames could be seen burning.
And this, was the origin of the Flame Plateau’s name.
Gazing at the sight above.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, is that Fire Attribute Divine Format here on the Flame Plateau?"

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - 390: Arrival at the Flame Plateau (Part 2)
paragraphs: Han Xing nodded, "That woman gave me the intelligence saying so."
"To be precise, it’s at the hottest spot on the entire Flame Plateau."
"I’m afraid this time, we’ll go through it again, just like on that Ice and Snow Sky Island."
Everyone seemed to think of something, and their expressions slightly changed.
The last time at the Ice and Snow Sky Island, that terrible freezing seal left a deep impression on them.
If it wasn’t for the moment when the Elemental God’s recognition mechanism triggered.
Detecting their Human Race identity.
Otherwise, even if they entered the ice cave, they wouldn’t have been able to get that Ice and Snow Divine Format.
However, compared to the time on the Ice and Snow Sky Island,
Han Xing and their strength had become stronger.
Especially with the enhancement of their Divine Power.
Presumably, this time shouldn’t be as dangerous as last time.
Han Xing directly controlled the Sky Island to head towards the vast black mountain range.
As previously seen, it was barren on top, with no vegetation or signs of biological activity.
After advancing a few hundred kilometers.
Han Xing saw a clump of burning flames ahead.
That flame emitted a strong aura fluctuation,
at least with the power of a Four-star Lord Level.
In front of Han Xing appeared the attributes of this monster.
[Flaming Stone Man: Four-star Lord Level]
[Level]: 47.
[Attributes]: Power 5172, Agility 4392, Spirit 4463, Constitution 4912.
[Skills]: Flame Body, Rock Body.
Seeing the attributes of this monster, it was pretty much as Han Xing and they had speculated,
At this moment, the Flaming Stone Man, noticing Han Xing and their arrival, woke from its slumber.
"Boom!"
The mountain range shook a bit.
Once the Stone Man stood up completely, it was over a hundred meters tall.
Right now, it was looking at Han Xing and them with full hostility.
If not for sensing the Legendary Level aura of Han Xing and them above.
I’m afraid this Stone Man would have already made a move on them.
However, though it did not attack.
It suddenly burst out with a rush of flames from its body.
The whole entity ignited right away!
Only, the flames on its body seemed somewhat different.
Besides deep red, there was a tinge of black.
Seeing the observing gaze of everyone, the Flaming Stone Man seemed extremely furious.
"Roar! Roar!"
"Humans, leave our territory quickly!"
Cheng Jianyong was a bit surprised, "Do these Stone Men have this kind of fiery temper?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Ignore it, this Stone Man race has its own sense of territory."
"Speaking of which, it is us who intruded into their territory."
Everyone nodded.
Ignoring the furious Stone Man below.
They continued onwards.
However, before leaving, Han Xing turned his head and glanced at the flames on that Stone Man.
The further they advanced.
The more Stone Men they encountered.
All of them awakened due to the arrival of Han Xing and the group.
Every Stone Man, without exception, maintained hostility towards Han Xing and them.
If not deterred by Han Xing and their strength.
Perhaps they would have already taken action.
Not long after.
Han Xing and his group encountered a Legendary Level Stone Man.
Upon seeing Han Xing and them.
This Legendary Stone Man did not appear very aggressive.
Instead, it asked calmly.
"Master of the Human Race, what brings you to my Flame Plateau?"
Hearing the other party directly call out his identity, Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
The last journey to the Dwarf Realm’s Secret Realm.
Did not involve any strong beings from the Flame Plateau.
So, they hadn’t learned about the final defeat of the Ogre Lord by Han Xing and them.
However, it was clear that this Stone Man had received the news.
Han Xing quickly snapped out of his surprise.
"I came to the Flame Plateau to retrieve something."
The flaming Stone Man’s pupils flickered with fire, questioning, "Saint Master Han Xing, I wonder what you wish to retrieve?"
Han Xing straightforwardly said, "Flame Divine Format."
Han Xing didn’t intend to beat around the bush with this group of Stone Men; he directly stated his purpose.
Hearing this, the Flaming Stone Man’s aura instantly erupted.
"Boom!"
A terrifying black and red flame surged up.
This Stone Man exclaimed, "You actually know that our clan possesses the Flame Divine Format."
"Who told you this information?" the other party questioned.
However, Han Xing shook his head, "You don’t need to know who informed me."
"This matter, you can’t decide."
"Take me to see your Clan Leader."
Hearing this, the Flaming Stone Man immediately roared, "How dare you! We will never let you take the Divine Format from our clan!"
Han Xing frowned, "I didn’t say I wanted to rob your Divine Format."
"I want to make a transaction with you."
"You can’t make this decision, summon your Clan Leader."
However, the Legendary Level Flaming Stone Man still angrily said, "There’s no need to summon our Clan Leader."
"I said, I will not let you take the Flame Divine Format away!"
"Get out now!"
At this moment, before Han Xing could speak.
Cheng Jianyong directly drew out the Divine Artifact Greatsword, pointing at the other party.
"How dare you! What’s your status? Speaking to our Master of the Human Race like that?"
"In terms of status, our Master of the Human Race is nobler than your Stone Giant Race Leader."
"You still want to make decisions on behalf of your Clan Leader? Do you have the qualifications?"
Upon hearing this, the Flaming Stone Man was irate.
It raised its hundred-meter-high fist, ready to smash down!
"You’re asking for death!"
"I think it’s you who is seeking death."
Cheng Jianyong’s actions were swifter than it.
At the moment the opponent’s fist was about to crash down.
Cheng Jianyong had already swung his sword.
With the same Legendary Level strength.
Cheng Jianyong, equipped with Legendary-level equipment along with the fortune value bonus from Han Xing’s faction.

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - 390: Arrival at the Flame Plateau (Part 3)
paragraphs: For those ordinary Legendary Level powerhouses, it’s almost a dimension-reducing strike!
"Swish!"
After a single slash.
The Flaming Stone Man’s fist was instantly cleaved open.
In the opponent’s horrified eyes.
A huge stone broken arm fell down.
"Boom!"
It smashed onto the mountain, creating a strong tremor!
That very sword actually severed its arm directly!
Its eyes were filled with disbelief.
"How is it possible, you’re also a Legend, how can the gap be so big?"
"Because you’re a waste."
Cheng Jianyong’s face was filled with disdain, mercilessly mocking it.
He had spared its life just now.
If he had used his full strength, this Stone Man might have fallen on the spot.
The Flaming Stone Man felt a strong sense of humiliation!
However, it dared not make any other move.
Because it knew, it was no match for these Human Race members.
Hence, it began to open its fiery mouth, roaring.
"Enemy attack! All Legendary Stone Men, wake up swiftly!"
The sound carried across ten thousand miles.
Half of the Flame Plateau heard the Stone Man’s roar.
Numerous Legendary Level auras awakened.
They burst out divine power and then quickly rushed towards this side.
Cheng Jianyong snickered at this: "Oh, can’t beat me so you’re calling reinforcements?"
The Legendary Stone Man didn’t answer, instead waiting silently.
Moments later, over a hundred powerful auras swiftly rushed in.
Flames erupted one after another.
Turning the sky entirely into a scene of flames burning the heavens.
Those auras were also a group of Stone Men burning with black and red flames.
After they arrived, they all asked, "Pollard, what’s happening?"
"Why are you in conflict with these Human Races?"
"Don’t you know this is Saint Master Han Xing?"
The Stone Man gained confidence seeing its clan arrive.
It replied angrily, "I don’t care what kind of Saint Master he is!
"I only know that these Human Races are after our Divine Format!"
"And they still intend to take the Divine Format away!"
The Legendary Stone Men fell silent upon hearing this.
Moments later.
Another Stone Man with Legendary Level strength spoke up.
"Saint Master Han Xing, please leave."
"The Flame Divine Format is our most important item, we cannot allow you to take it."
Hearing these words, Han Xing frowned.
"You won’t let me take it? Why?"
"I can offer something of equal value to the Flame Divine Format for a trade."
"Or, if you have conditions, feel free to state them."
The Stone Man remained silent, still speaking seriously, "Please leave, this matter cannot be negotiated."
"If you insist on taking the Flame Divine Format, it will mean declaring war with our clan!"
Upon hearing this, all the Legendary Stone Men loudly declared.
"Declare war!"
"Declare war!"
The entire Flame Plateau, it seemed all the Stone Men awakened.
Everyone frowned, seemingly not expecting such a big reaction from the other side.
After a rough count.
The number of Legendary Powerhouses on the Flame Plateau reached nearly two hundred, quite formidable.
Cheng Jianyong was instantly infuriated: "Damn, these Stone Men are quite arrogant!"
After speaking, he lifted the Divine Artifact Longsword, about to fight.
Han Xing stopped him, saying: "I want to see your Clan Leader."
However, the group of Stone Men had already regarded Han Xing as an enemy.
They directly refused: "Our Clan Leader is in cultivation, not available!"
Upon hearing this, a trace of impatience finally appeared on Han Xing’s face.
This group of Flaming Stone Men’s attitude had worn out his last bit of patience.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly spoke seriously.
"In the Holy Spirit Realm, large clans maintain mutual courtesy."
"If a Clan Leader from another race visits, no matter how busy, they will find time to meet."
"Even the Dwarf King and Elf King adhere to this rule."
"And I, as the Master of the Human Race and the current Witch Race Saint Master."
"Is it not enough qualification to meet your Stone Giant Race Leader?
As Han Xing’s words fell.
A terrifying kingly aura burst from his body.
Directly suppressing the flames on the Stone Men back into their bodies.
Meanwhile, Han Xing’s team members also entered combat state.
The atmosphere instantly grew tense and confrontational.
One Stone Man was just about to speak.
At this moment.
An aged voice came forth.
"Saint Master Han Xing, do you have business with me?"
This voice carried a Demigod Level aura.
It should be the legendary presence.
Han Xing frowned, "You finally come out?"
The voice sighed: "Saint Master Han Xing, apologies for the negligence, please forgive us."
"But I was just asleep, and truly did not sense your arrival, my apologies."
Hearing this, Han Xing pondered for a moment, seemingly considering the truth in the words.
The voice continued: "Saint Master Han Xing, can you tell me why you are here this time?"
Han Xing frowned, "I have repeated it three times."
"I need that Flame Divine Format from your clan."
"It’s of great use to me."
"If you are willing to part with it, I can compensate with something of equal value."
Han Xing had many treasures,
Their value definitely exceeded a single Divine Format.
Yet, the voice sighed: "Master of the Human Race, it’s not about compensation, it’s a bit complicated to explain."
"How about this, come to me."
Hearing this.
Han Xing and others looked off into the distance.
There lay the aura of a Demigod Level powerhouse.
Han Xing did not hesitate.
Amidst the angry gazes of the Legendary Stone Men.
He went into the highest mountain ahead.
However, there was nothing there.
"Why don’t I see that guy?" Cheng Jianyong muttered.
Everyone also extended their divine power to explore.
Yet they still couldn’t find the Flaming Stone Man’s figure...

chapters.title: Chapter 658 - 391: The Stone Giant Race Leader’s Secret
paragraphs: However, everyone truly felt the presence of a demigod here.
Han Xing directly asked, "I’m here, where are you?"
At that moment.
The mountain beneath their feet suddenly trembled.
As if a long asleep eye suddenly opened.
And on the other side of this eye, another pitch-black peak appeared.
This fellow, with an eye alone as large as a mountain range!
"Rumble!"
After a massive vibration, a stone giant towering hundreds of thousands of meters tall!
Appeared, as large as a planet,
However, compared to those ordinary stone people.
This stone giant’s body did not burn with flames but was entirely charred black.
Giving off a sense of returning to the basics.
The attributes of this giant stone figure appeared before Han Xing.
[Flame Stone Giant Race Leader: Demigod Level]
[Level]: Level 66.
[Attributes]: Power 127756, Agility 99756, Spirit 84232, Constitution 113894.
[Skills]: Flame Body, Rock Body, Heaven-Burning Earth-Sundering, Destruction Trample, Ultimate Skill—Flame World.
[Divine Power Value]: 12764
Previously, whenever Han Xing and his group encountered demigod-level powerhouses, they couldn’t view the opponent’s information.
However, now, as Han Xing’s divine power value increases, the opponent’s panel gradually becomes visible.
Han Xing said, "Stone Giant Race Leader, I’ll be straightforward."
"I need this Flame Divine Format here in the Flame Plateau."
"I’m willing to pay the appropriate price to trade with you."
"See what you need, Philosopher’s Stone, Calamity Divine Gold, or even high-tier ancient weapons, I can get them for you."
Han Xing directly offered his terms.
Even going so far as to bring out high-tier ancient weapons capable of injuring demigods.
The Stone Giant Race Leader’s eyes wavered upon hearing this.
It seemed indeed a bit tempted.
After all, in the Holy Spirit Realm, most ancient weapons are controlled by the Dwarf Race.
Not to mention, the most powerful high-tier ancient weapons.
Any complete high-tier ancient weapon is worth at least hundreds of thousands of Philosopher’s Stones.
And they are hard to come by.
But moments later, it still shook its head and said, "It’s not that I am unwilling to meet the request of Saint Master Han Xing."
"But truly, this Divine Format is crucial to our tribe."
Han Xing remained silent, seemingly wanting to hear its explanation.
The Stone Giant Race Leader said, "Since Saint Master Han Xing wants this Divine Format, I assume you must have studied the characteristics of the Divine Format."
"It continuously emits a special kind of divine power, endlessly over the years."
Han Xing nodded, understanding this much.
The Stone Giant Race Leader continued, "Since that’s the case, I’m sure Saint Master Han Xing also knows that this divine power can be absorbed."
"And it is through absorbing this divine power that our Stone People gradually developed intelligence."
"And I am the first Stone Person in this entire mountain range to develop intelligence."
"Then gradually established a vast Stone People tribe."
After hearing the Stone Giant Race Leader’s words, Han Xing grasped the origin of the Stone People.
They, like the slimes on that Ice and Snow Sky Island,
Unintentionally absorbed divine power released from the Divine Format, then developed intelligence and embarked on the path to strength.
The Stone Giant Race Leader continued, "Our entire Flame Plateau, millions of Stone People, all through absorbing divine power emitted by the Divine Format over the years."
"Under the accumulation of time, we have gained our current strength."
"If Saint Master Han Xing takes the Divine Format, it would be equivalent to cutting off our tribe’s source of divine power."
"From then on, it would be very difficult for our tribe to produce Legendary Powerhouses."
"Saint Master Han Xing, now you should know why my clansmen are reacting so fiercely, right?"
Having listened to this demigod-level Stone Giant’s explanation,
everyone understood the importance of the Flame Divine Format to the Stone People.
At this moment, Han Xing’s brow furrowed.
As mentioned before,
The Flame Divine Format is indeed very important to this group of Stone People.
But to Han Xing and his group, it is also irreplaceable.
To change professions to the supreme profession, Elemental Law God,
The Flame Divine Format is indispensable.
Additionally, Han Xing knew that this Divine Format was not the private property of the Stone People.
On the contrary, it was left by the Elemental God specifically for the Human Race.
From the last Ice and Snow Sky Island instance, it was evident.
The ultimate ice-seal ban couldn’t even be approached by demigods.
It was only by relying on their Human Race identity that they lifted the final restriction.
But it’s apparent that if you tell these Flame Stone People now,
This Flame Divine Format isn’t yours but belongs to our Human Race.
The other party definitely won’t believe it.
At this moment, Han Xing found himself in a dilemma.
A moment later, Han Xing suddenly asked, "Stone Giant Race Leader, I want to know, what is the deal with your black skin?"
"Why is it different from other Stone People?"
The Stone Giant Race Leader’s eyelid twitched when he heard this question.
It seemed unexpected that Han Xing would ask this question suddenly.
A moment later, the Stone Giant Race Leader said, "This is an old secret technique of mine, capable of concealing divine power fluctuations."
"Otherwise, with the divine power flames of us Stone People alone, it’s dangerous and could cause you harm."
Han Xing nodded thoughtfully.
Yet his gaze remained on this demigod stone person, sizing it up and down.
The Stone Giant Race Leader asked in confusion, "Saint Master Han Xing, is there a problem?"
Han Xing, upon hearing this, seemed to come to his senses.
"It’s nothing, I was just asking casually."
The Stone Giant Race Leader nodded faintly after hearing this.

Unintentionally absorbed divine power released from the Divine Format, then developed intelligence and embarked on the path to strength.
The Stone Giant Race Leader continued, "Our entire Flame Plateau, millions of Stone People, all through absorbing divine power emitted by the Divine Format over the years."
"Under the accumulation of time, we have gained our current strength."
"If Saint Master Han Xing takes the Divine Format, it would be equivalent to cutting off our tribe’s source of divine power."
"From then on, it would be very difficult for our tribe to produce Legendary Powerhouses."
"Saint Master Han Xing, now you should know why my clansmen are reacting so fiercely, right?"
Having listened to this demigod-level Stone Giant’s explanation,
everyone understood the importance of the Flame Divine Format to the Stone People.
At this moment, Han Xing’s brow furrowed.
As mentioned before,
The Flame Divine Format is indeed very important to this group of Stone People.
But to Han Xing and his group, it is also irreplaceable.
To change professions to the supreme profession, Elemental Law God,
The Flame Divine Format is indispensable.
Additionally, Han Xing knew that this Divine Format was not the private property of the Stone People.
On the contrary, it was left by the Elemental God specifically for the Human Race.
From the last Ice and Snow Sky Island instance, it was evident.
The ultimate ice-seal ban couldn’t even be approached by demigods.
It was only by relying on their Human Race identity that they lifted the final restriction.
But it’s apparent that if you tell these Flame Stone People now,
This Flame Divine Format isn’t yours but belongs to our Human Race.
The other party definitely won’t believe it.
At this moment, Han Xing found himself in a dilemma.
A moment later, Han Xing suddenly asked, "Stone Giant Race Leader, I want to know, what is the deal with your black skin?"
"Why is it different from other Stone People?"
The Stone Giant Race Leader’s eyelid twitched when he heard this question.
It seemed unexpected that Han Xing would ask this question suddenly.
A moment later, the Stone Giant Race Leader said, "This is an old secret technique of mine, capable of concealing divine power fluctuations."
"Otherwise, with the divine power flames of us Stone People alone, it’s dangerous and could cause you harm."
Han Xing nodded thoughtfully.
Yet his gaze remained on this demigod stone person, sizing it up and down.
The Stone Giant Race Leader asked in confusion, "Saint Master Han Xing, is there a problem?"
Han Xing, upon hearing this, seemed to come to his senses.
"It’s nothing, I was just asking casually."
The Stone Giant Race Leader nodded faintly after hearing this.

chapters.title: Chapter 659 - 391: The Stone Giant Race Leader’s Secret (Part 2)
paragraphs: Then he directly said, "Saint Master Han Xing, I deeply apologize for not being able to satisfy your request."
"However, the Flame Divine Format truly cannot be traded."
"I’m afraid I can’t let you continue as my guests."
With these words, everyone understood that this Stone Man was preparing to drive them away.
Han Xing said nothing, instead silently turning to leave with the group.
The Demigod Level Stone Man watched the back of Han Xing and his companions.
Until he confirmed they had completely left this black Endless Mountain Range.
Then he fell silent again.
"Rumble!"
After a violent tremor.
The enormous body of the Stone Giant Race Leader once again merged with the Flame Plateau.
Half an hour later...
Outside the Flame Plateau.
The group stood on the Sky Island, some with furrowed brows.
Unexpectedly, the task of collecting the Elemental Law God Divine Format hit a snag right at the first step.
Cheng Jianyong said somewhat unwillingly, "Brother Xing, are we really giving up just like that?"
"If we don’t get the Flame Divine Format, even if we find other Attributes’ Divine Formats, Sister Lian Meng still can’t switch to the Elemental Law God."
"Besides, this Flame Divine Format isn’t even theirs."
"This group of Stone Men are so damn stubborn, with such a bad temper!"
Shen Yun also directly said, "Brother Xing, why not just go to war with them!"
"I don’t believe that if we use force, this group of Stone Men still won’t hand over the Divine Format!"
Cheng Jianyong also got excited, "Right, let’s go to war with them!"
"It’s just a Demigod, what are they so arrogant about?"
Zhang Lianmeng quickly persuaded from the side, "Everyone, there’s no need for that..."
"Even if we don’t find other Divine Formats, this Ice Divine Format is already enough."
"By then, I can still break through to a Demigod."
Saying this, Zhang Lianmeng gave everyone a gentle smile.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong no longer spoke, instead turning their gaze to Han Xing.
However, at this time, Han Xing smiled and said, "Don’t worry."
"This Flame Divine Format is definitely ours."
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong’s eyes instantly lit up.
"Brother Xing, do you mean... take them on?"
Their tone held no tension, on the contrary, there was a hint of eagerness.
After all, they knew that the power Han Xing now possessed was already enough to dominate the Holy Spirit Realm.
Yet now, he had to speak lowly with this group of Flaming Stone Men.
Everyone looked exasperated.
Zhang Lianmeng showed a worried expression on her face.
Han Xing said, "It’s not about taking them on."
"However, I know that the Stone Giant Race Leader didn’t tell us everything truthfully."
"Its power doesn’t just come from that one Flame Divine Format."
"I sensed a long-lost familiar aura from it."
Everyone showed a puzzled expression, "Familiar aura?"
Han Xing didn’t keep them guessing, and directly said:
"That power comes from an Otherworldly Evil God."
Hearing this, everyone’s eyes widened suddenly.
Having experienced the Blood Tide, they naturally understood the weight of these words.
As a type of Evil God adept at curses, they possessed extremely powerful abilities.
Ten thousand years ago, almost causing the extinction of the Witch Race.
For the Holy Spirit Realm, the Evil Gods from Alternate Spaces.
Are the same existence as Demons from the Abyss Realm,
They are enemies of the Holy Spirit Realm!
Shen Yun asked with confusion, "Brother Xing, are you saying that this Flaming Stone Man is colluding with an Otherworldly Evil God?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Just a speculation, but most likely true."
"The power of that Divine Format is indeed strong, but it can at most allow it to break through to a Demigod."
"However, this guy possesses the strength of a Middle-tier Demigod."
"This indicates it likely has leveraged some other powers."
Everyone suddenly nodded in realization.
Han Xing continued to add, "And not only that, I also sensed the same aura from other Stone Men.
Cheng Jianyong, hearing this, immediately exclaimed in anger, "Damn it, this group of stubborn stones, acting so high and mighty with us!"
"Brother Xing, let’s go back now and expose this guy’s true face ourselves!"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Hold on a bit."
"The other Stone Men don’t know, but the Stone Giant Race Leader should have realized I discovered some secrets about it."
"That’s why it was so eager to send us away in the end."
"If we go back now, the other party might just destroy all evidence directly."
Thinking of this, Han Xing suddenly said, "Let Coal Ball go."
"Help me gather some things."
Hearing this, everyone’s eyes instantly lit up,
Coal Ball, after evolving, is indeed quite suitable for this kind of task.
Just its Escape into the Void Skill makes them all envious.
As long as it activates Stealth State, even a Demigod Level powerhouse couldn’t detect Coal Ball’s presence!
This is truly a Divine Skill!
Han Xing called Coal Ball over.
Then took out a drop of ’Cursed Blood’ from his backpack.
This thing, a product of the Blood Tide period.
At present, there’s not much of it left on the trading channels.
And Han Xing had saved a bit.
Han Xing placed the ’Cursed Blood’ under Coal Ball’s nose, letting it sniff a few times.
Coal Ball’s nose twitched, seemingly remembering this scent.
At this moment, Han Xing gently patted Coal Ball’s head and said.
"Little Coal Ball, sneak in later and bring me some things with this aura."
Coal Ball tilted its head, as if it understood Han Xing’s meaning.
Han Xing continued, "Be careful, if you’re discovered, activate your escape skill immediately."
Coal Ball shook its head, indicating for Han Xing not to worry.
It would not be discovered.
Han Xing smiled.
"Go on, Little Coal Ball."

chapters.title: Chapter 660 - 391: The Stone Giant Race Leader’s Secret (Part 3)
paragraphs: In the next moment.
Coal Ball’s figure vanished directly from the spot.
No matter how everyone searched, there wasn’t the slightest trace.
Cheng Jianyong said enviously, "Tsk tsk, Coal Ball’s Stealth Skill is truly abnormal."
"Even though our Divine Power Value has increased significantly compared to before, we still can’t find a trace of Coal Ball."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Then, they began to wait silently.
A dozen minutes later.
The Flame Plateau was silent.
But Han Xing knew that with Coal Ball’s speed, it should have reached the depths of the Flame Plateau by now.
And this also indicated that Coal Ball hadn’t been discovered.
After another half hour.
Han Xing and the others remained where they were.
Their presence seemed to have irritated the agitated Stone Men.
Because they knew that these humans refusing to leave meant they hadn’t given up.
One by one, they let out angry roars, threatening them to leave quickly.
These roars were naturally ignored by Han Xing and his team.
However, the Stone Men were already losing patience.
As beings that constantly absorb Flame Divine Power.
Their personalities were inherently very irritable.
In their hearts, they already regarded Han Xing as their enemy.
"Boom boom boom!"
One by one, the Stone Men awakened, letting out angry roars.
"Humans, get out of our Flame Plateau!"
"Get out!"
"Get out!"
The voices echoed for miles, trying to force Han Xing and the others to leave.
The group remained unmoved, coldly watching the group of roaring Stone Men.
Cheng Jianyong struggled to suppress his desire to draw his sword, his eyes filled with a murderous intent.
At this moment.
A figure appeared suddenly on Han Xing’s Sky Island.
No one noticed how this figure appeared.
It was Coal Ball.
At that moment, it pounced in front of Han Xing, appearing very excited.
Han Xing smiled and patted its head, saying, "Back already?"
"Did you finish the task?"
Coal Ball nodded repeatedly.
Then, it opened its mouth.
With a "plop."
A black stone slipped out from inside.
Even without getting close, Han Xing could feel the special divine power within this stone.
[Otherworld Divine Power Crystal Stone]: Contains ancient and evil divine power, which can instantly increase the Divine Power Value by +100 upon absorption.
Note: This Divine Stone can be used without limits, but during use, one might experience erosion from the Otherworldly Evil God, becoming its servant.
Upon seeing the attributes of this Divine Stone,
Han Xing began to laugh.
Indeed, the Stone Giant Race Leader has colluded with the Otherworldly Evil God.
Moreover, the opponent provided a stone that the Stone Man can directly absorb for divine power.
The cost is the risk of becoming an Evil God’s servant.
And clearly, the Stone Giant Race Leader truly absorbed the divine power from this stone.
Causing its body to suffer certain conditions.
Making it have to enter long periods of sleep.
Han Xing held the stone, smiling, "Let’s go, let’s settle things with that fellow."
Upon hearing this, smiles appeared on everyone’s faces.
Ten Thousand Stars City moved closer to the Flame Plateau once more.
Upon sensing that Han Xing and the others hadn’t left and in fact returned.
The group of Stone Men issued threatening warnings.
"Roar! Roar!"
"Damn it, these humans still refuse to give up?"
"Brothers, keep calling more over!"
At the same time.
In the sky, over a hundred Legendary Level auras ascended.
Together, they charged towards Han Xing, appearing to want to block them.
Moments later.
In front of Han Xing, over a hundred Stone Men, standing tens of thousands of meters tall and ablaze with flames, gathered.
Glaring with fiery eyes, they angrily said, "If you approach the Flame Plateau by another step, it will be considered as a provocation against our Flaming Stone Man race."
"We will consider it as you initiating war and attack you!"
"Attack!"
"Attack!"
This group of Flaming Stone Men shouted in unison.
The terrifying sound waves caused the entire Flame Plateau to continually quake.
And at this moment.
The shouts of the Flaming Stone Men abruptly stopped.
Because they saw.
Ten sphere-shaped objects, each with a diameter of a thousand meters, emitting a chilling aura, swiftly attacking them!
Within those spheres, there was intense Ice and Snow Divine Power.
They could feel these Frost Snowballs.
Any one of them had the power to instantaneously annihilate these Legendary powerhouses.
"Damn, what is that?"
"Not sure, but I feel these massive snowballs can kill us instantly!"
"Quick, flee!"
At that moment, one by one, they fled in panic!
Shortly after they vacated.
"Bang! Bang bang bang!"
The ten enormous snowballs fired directly.
Then suddenly exploded!
The terrifying energy fluctuations created ten giant craters, each tens of thousands of meters wide, on the Flame Plateau’s ground!
Even the scorching soil of the Flame Plateau was instantly vaporized.
A territory of tens of kilometers turned directly into frozen ground!
This is the horrifying killing power of the High-tier Ancient Weapon, Frozen Star Cannon.
Feeling the chill in the air, the Flaming Stone Men suddenly shivered.
This was a sensation they hadn’t experienced for thousands of years.
At that moment.
Han Xing gave them a glance and said, "Keep quiet."
"Otherwise, the next shot lands right on your heads."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s threat.
Those Flaming Stone Men dared not utter a word.
Because now they realized.
They had grossly underestimated the power of this human group.
Based on just that wave of attack, none of the Stone Men on the ground had any confidence they could endure the next one.
In other words, the opponents had the ability to annihilate them entirely.
Thinking back to how they had just threatened these humans and even considered starting a war.
A chill went through their hearts.
Seeing the deflated expressions of the Stone Men, Cheng Jianyong felt immensely pleased!

chapters.title: Chapter 661 - 392: Flame Divine Format, Acquired
paragraphs: Cheng Jianyong’s eyes filled with a look of satisfaction, and he mocked, "Damn it, scream then!"
"Weren’t you shouting quite happily just now?"
"Didn’t you say you wanted to wage war against us?"
"Now you have the chance, try attacking us once."
Listening to Cheng Jianyong’s mocking voice.
The group of Stone Men kept silent.
They had hot tempers, but they weren’t fools.
Currently, the initiative lay in the hands of the Humans.
To engage in conversation now would be to give the other side a reason for war, wouldn’t it?
Yet despite this, they still felt quite frustrated inside.
At this moment, a Stone Man with High-tier Legendary power said, "Master of the Human Race, do you intend to use your power to forcibly take our clan’s divine artifact?"
"We will report the happenings here truthfully to the Three Great Clans."
However, Han Xing laughed, "Threatening me with the Three Great Clans? When I mentioned maintaining respect among the clans earlier, why didn’t you speak up?"
"Also, do you really think the threat of the Three Great Clans would work on me?"
Listening to Han Xing’s voice.
The fire power on the Shi Ren’s bodies flickered continuously.
But they didn’t counter.
That Stone Man thought for a moment,
"Saint Master Han Xing, even so, it’s not a reason for you to use force to seize our divine artifact."
"The Three Great Clans will not allow you to do so."
"I have already reported the situation here to the Three Great Clans."
"The Elf King and the Dwarf King will soon receive the news."
Upon hearing this, not only was Han Xing unmoved, but he also laughed, "Alright, go ahead and report."
"Don’t think I don’t know about the underhanded dealings you guys have been up to."
"Each and every one of you, actually colluding with the Otherworldly Evil God, what audacity!"
Yes, Han Xing had already sensed it.
Not only did the Demigod-level Stone Man bear the aura of the Otherworldly Evil God.
The same was true for these Legendary-level Stone Men!
Although faint, how sharp was Han Xing’s perception.
He immediately sensed something amiss.
"You clearly know that the Otherworldly Evil God is the enemy of the entire Holy Spirit Realm."
"As soon as a trace of their power appears, it could evolve into a horrifying calamity."
"Tell me, if I announce this publicly."
"Would the Three Great Clans trouble you first, or me?"
Upon hearing this, the faces of all the Flaming Stone Men changed drastically!
As if their deepest secret had been revealed.
Their flames flickered continuously.
But they also knew, that this was something they absolutely could not admit.
Thus, they all started to refute.
"You’re spouting nonsense!"
"To get our divine format, you’re stooping to any means, using such reasons to slander us!"
Han Xing ignored their explanation, and in his hand appeared a stone out of thin air.
"You recognize this, right?"
"I think each Stone Man’s body contains such a stone now."
"Do you need me to cut open your bodies and test it on the spot?"
At the sight of the stone in Han Xing’s hand.
All the Flaming Stone Men fell silent.
Each body became stiff.
Faced with such ironclad evidence.
They had no room for rebuttal.
At this point, Han Xing looked toward the depths of the Flame Plateau.
"Old guy, how long are you going to play dead?"
"Keep pretending, and I’ll make sure you really rest here forever."
Hearing Han Xing’s threat to their clan leader.
Despite their anger, none of the Flaming Stone Men dared to say another word.
Moments later, a sigh was heard from the depths of the Flame Plateau.
"Dear little friends of the Human Race, this matter is the fault of this old one."
"It has nothing to do with my clansmen."
"If there’s any problem, come to me..."
Han Xing listened and hesitated not a bit.
Directly controlling the Sky Island, he flew over the Legendary-level Flaming Stone Men.
In the air.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun and others wore victory smiles, looking at the Stone Men.
Soon, they arrived in front of the entirely black Stone Giant Race Leader.
"Is there anything more you want to say?" Han Xing directly asked.
The Stone Giant Race Leader sighed, "In truth, there’s nothing more to say about this matter."
"This old one, in pursuit of greater power, heeded the false promises of the Otherworldly Evil God and accepted their gifts."
"Upon initially absorbing the divine power from these stones, this old one broke through to a Middle-tier Demigod level, gaining immense power."
"Seduced by that power, I began trading more frequently with them, acquiring more black stones."
"Then, these stones started circulating within the clan,"
"Only then did this old one realize that they bore the consciousness of those Evil Gods."
At this point, a pained expression appeared on the Stone Giant Race Leader’s face, seeming extremely regretful.
"They used these stones to infiltrate our bodies."
"And began vying for control over us."
"The entire Flame Plateau, all Legendary-level Stone Men, have experienced this pain."
"But fortunately, this old one found that the pure Flame Divine Power on the Flame Plateau could suppress and even eliminate this otherworldly divine power."
"For all these years, all our clan members have been fighting against this otherworldly power."
"Now, the otherworldly power within those clan members has almost been cleansed."
"Only this old one has not yet recovered due to consuming too much otherworldly divine stone."
Everyone listened, casting scrutinizing looks at the Stone Giant Race Leader.
As if evaluating the truth of its words.

sentences.text: Cheng Jianyong’s eyes filled with a look of satisfaction, and he mocked, "Damn it, scream then!"
"Weren’t you shouting quite happily just now?"
"Didn’t you say you wanted to wage war against us?"
"Now you have the chance, try attacking us once."
Listening to Cheng Jianyong’s mocking voice.
The group of Stone Men kept silent.
They had hot tempers, but they weren’t fools.
Currently, the initiative lay in the hands of the Humans.
To engage in conversation now would be to give the other side a reason for war, wouldn’t it?
Yet despite this, they still felt quite frustrated inside.
At this moment, a Stone Man with High-tier Legendary power said, "Master of the Human Race, do you intend to use your power to forcibly take our clan’s divine artifact?"
"We will report the happenings here truthfully to the Three Great Clans."
However, Han Xing laughed, "Threatening me with the Three Great Clans?
When I mentioned maintaining respect among the clans earlier, why didn’t you speak up?"
"Also, do you really think the threat of the Three Great Clans would work on me?"
Listening to Han Xing’s voice.
The fire power on the Shi Ren’s bodies flickered continuously.
But they didn’t counter.
That Stone Man thought for a moment,
"Saint Master Han Xing, even so, it’s not a reason for you to use force to seize our divine artifact."
"The Three Great Clans will not allow you to do so."
"I have already reported the situation here to the Three Great Clans."
"The Elf King and the Dwarf King will soon receive the news."
Upon hearing this, not only was Han Xing unmoved, but he also laughed, "Alright, go ahead and report."
"Don’t think I don’t know about the underhanded dealings you guys have been up to."
"Each and every one of you, actually colluding with the Otherworldly Evil God, what audacity!"
Yes, Han Xing had already sensed it.
Not only did the Demigod-level Stone Man bear the aura of the Otherworldly Evil God.
The same was true for these Legendary-level Stone Men!
Although faint, how sharp was Han Xing’s perception.
He immediately sensed something amiss.
"You clearly know that the Otherworldly Evil God is the enemy of the entire Holy Spirit Realm."
"As soon as a trace of their power appears, it could evolve into a horrifying calamity."
"Tell me, if I announce this publicly."
"Would the Three Great Clans trouble you first, or me?"
Upon hearing this, the faces of all the Flaming Stone Men changed drastically!
As if their deepest secret had been revealed.
Their flames flickered continuously.
But they also knew, that this was something they absolutely could not admit.
Thus, they all started to refute.
"You’re spouting nonsense!"
"To get our divine format, you’re stooping to any means, using such reasons to slander us!"
Han Xing ignored their explanation, and in his hand appeared a stone out of thin air.
"You recognize this, right?"
"I think each Stone Man’s body contains such a stone now."
"Do you need me to cut open your bodies and test it on the spot?"
At the sight of the stone in Han Xing’s hand.
All the Flaming Stone Men fell silent.
Each body became stiff.
Faced with such ironclad evidence.
They had no room for rebuttal.
At this point, Han Xing looked toward the depths of the Flame Plateau.
"Old guy, how long are you going to play dead?"
"Keep pretending, and I’ll make sure you really rest here forever."
Hearing Han Xing’s threat to their clan leader.
Despite their anger, none of the Flaming Stone Men dared to say another word.
Moments later, a sigh was heard from the depths of the Flame Plateau.
"Dear little friends of the Human Race, this matter is the fault of this old one."
"It has nothing to do with my clansmen."
"If there’s any problem, come to me..."
Han Xing listened and hesitated not a bit.
Directly controlling the Sky Island, he flew over the Legendary-level Flaming Stone Men.
In the air.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun and others wore victory smiles, looking at the Stone Men.
Soon, they arrived in front of the entirely black Stone Giant Race Leader.
