chapters.title: Chapter 662 - 392: Flame Divine Format, Acquired
paragraphs: Han Xing said, "You mean you haven’t made any other deals with the otherworldly evil gods?"
The Stone Giant Race Leader nodded.
Han Xing asked seriously, "Are you sure?"
"You should know that any leftover trace of the otherworldly evil gods’ power could brew a terrible disaster."
The Stone Giant Race Leader pondered for a moment, then nodded knowingly, "I’m sure."
"When I detected that this was power from the alternate space, I immediately severed contact with them."
"And over the years, besides combating the power of the alternate space within us, we have been continuously searching and patrolling the Flame Plateau area."
"There should be... no overlooked places."
Han Xing nodded, indicating that he believed the guy’s account.
Moreover, if there really were traces of the otherworldly evil gods’ power, Coal Ball’s sense of smell should be able to detect it too.
But currently, Coal Ball hasn’t given him any related information.
This indicates that the Flame Plateau is temporarily not being corrupted by those evil gods.
Han Xing said, "Stone Giant Race Leader, I’m very direct."
"I want that divine format from your clan."
"And in return, I will not pursue your dealings with the otherworldly evil gods."
"Also, I will help you keep it a secret."
"It’s your choice."
The Stone Giant Race Leader was stunned for a moment.
But it also knew that the current situation was firmly under the control of this member of the Human Race.
Having witnessed the power of the Frozen Star Cannon.
In terms of strength, even if their entire clan joined forces, they wouldn’t be a match for Han Xing.
And thinking of using the rules of the Holy Spirit Realm to make them hold back,
they also had their leverage held by Han Xing.
It could be said that when Han Xing ascended the Flame Plateau for the second time,
it no longer had any right to refuse.
The Stone Giant Race Leader nodded helplessly, saying, "I will listen to Saint Master Han Xing."
At this moment, Han Xing smiled.
Even Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong revealed relaxed smiles.
Then, Han Xing directly said, "Stone Giant Race Leader, lead the way."
"Okay."
The next moment.
The gigantic stone-like figure, resembling a planet, stood up, then moved its heavy steps to lead the way.
"Thud! Thud! Thud!"
Every step it took brought about heavy, muffled sounds.
The plateau kept trembling.
All along the way, every stone giant stood still, not daring to say a word.
The direction the Stone Giant Race Leader was heading was deeper into the Flame Plateau.
Those places had never been open to strong individuals of other races.
Considered the forbidden land of the Stone Giant clan.
Soon, Han Xing and the others appeared in a completely red area.
Here, the temperature was terrifyingly high.
Waves of heat rolled over them.
Even melting their divine power domain.
Even the ground emitted astonishing heat, like a red-hot piece of iron.
The Stone Giant Race Leader said, "Dear friends of the Human Race, this is where the Flame Divine Format is located."
"The closer you get, the higher the temperature inside."
"Even I cannot approach the core area."
"If you want to take the divine format, you’ll have to rely on your own power."
Han Xing nodded, realizing this was something they knew.
Last time, when retrieving the Ice and Snow Divine Format, they encountered the same situation.
"Stone Giant Race Leader, you can stop here."
"We’ll find a way through the rest of the path ourselves."
Hearing Han Xing’s words.
The Stone Giant Race Leader nodded but did not leave.
He stood there watching Han Xing.
Seemingly wanting to know how Han Xing would approach the core region of the Flame Divine Format.
After all, even it, a middle-tier demigod, could barely approach within ten thousand meters of the divine format by releasing all its divine power.
Going any closer could result in instant death.
No matter how strong they are, those of the Human Race are still only at the legendary level.
So, the Stone Giant Race Leader was extremely curious.
Han Xing didn’t speak.
Instead, he showed the method through his actions.
At this moment, ten Frozen Star Cannons and five Withered Snowflake Calamity Towers in Ten Thousand Stars City activated simultaneously!
The next moment.
An astonishing chill emerged.
"Whoosh—whoosh—"
A gust of cold wind blew in.
Amazingly, it directly suppressed the terrifying high temperatures of the nearby area.
The Stone Giant Race Leader’s eyes showed a look of shock.
It looked up.
Appearing surprised, seeing the Flame Plateau that for millions of years had been shrouded in terrifying heat.
Snow was actually falling...
White snowflakes descended,
creating a unique beauty in this entirely red, flame-like world.
"Snow..."
"Flame Plateau, it’s actually snowing..."
The Stone Giant Race Leader murmured.
It instinctively reached out to touch one of the snowflakes.
"So beautiful..."
The next moment, it found in shock that as soon as those snowflakes made contact with its body,
an extremely cold sensation appeared.
It felt as if its palm was instantly invaded by a chill, losing sensation in that spot.
The Stone Giant Race Leader quickly shook its hand, trying to shake off the snowflake.
However, the snowflake melted into a special liquid upon contacting its body, permeating inside.
Most of the palm showed signs of erosion!
The Stone Giant Race Leader’s eyes filled with fear and it said in shock, "What kind of ghostly thing is this!"
"It’s actually eroding my body, and so quickly!"
It suddenly looked up.
And the next moment, saw countless snowflakes floating towards it in the air.
The Stone Giant Race Leader felt a sense of threat in each snowflake!

chapters.title: Chapter 663 - 392: Flame Divine Format, Acquired
paragraphs: It vanished in an instant as if it had seen a ghost, retreating tens of thousands of meters!
Then it looked with utter terror towards the area where Han Xing and the others were located.
That area was completely covered by snow and wind, even it suffered harm.
A Legendary Powerhouse entering would almost certainly die!
And this is the power of the Catastrophe-level Weapon: Withered Snowflakes.
Enhanced by two pieces of the Sun Crown Stele.
These snowflakes truly reached the catastrophic power of the Endless Void.
Even before the shock in its eyes could dissipate.
Suddenly saw.
An astonishing wave of energy abruptly appearing from that man’s territory.
Then.
Several frost snowballs with a diameter of up to five hundred meters fiercely erupted!
The moment the frost snowballs appeared.
The air emitted a series of sizzling sounds.
That was extreme heat and extreme coldness.
Clashing after two diametrically opposed energies.
A reaction appeared.
Fog appeared in the air.
In the next moment.
These few snowballs suddenly exploded!
The instant energy fluctuation caused the Stone Giant Race Leader to feel a series of heart palpitations!
The oppressive heat was instantly suppressed.
The Flame Plateau forged by terrifying heat instantaneously reached twenty to thirty degrees.
And the Stone Giant Race Leader beside it.
Had already fallen into a state of utter shock!
"Too... too terrifying..."
"The Master of the Human Race actually has such horrific means."
Seeing the oppressive heat ahead being suppressed.
Han Xing controlled the Ten Thousand Stars City Sky Island to continue advancing.
Every few hundred meters, he would fire another round.
In this way, Han Xing alternated controlling the Frozen Star Cannon and the Withered Snowflakes all the way.
The terrifying heat was suppressed in pieces.
They advanced unimpeded directly to a region a mere ten thousand meters from the Flame Divine Format.
The Stone Giant Race Leader at the back no longer knew what to say.
Because this was the limit distance it could approach.
Yet they reached it with ease.
Han Xing was unaware of the inner thoughts of the Stone Giant Race Leader.
Instead, he focused his attention on the scene before his eyes.
At this time, Han Xing and his group were completely engulfed in flames.
The oppressive heat even started causing space to collapse.
But fortunately, snowflakes constantly fell around them, suppressing this terrifying heat.
Just then, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "The power of these Divine Formats is truly terrifying."
"It feels like even a Demigod wouldn’t be able to approach at this moment."
"I guess only a Top Demigod like the Dwarf King, relying on a robust constitution, could forcibly snatch the Divine Format."
They continued to delve deeper.
At this time, the flames had completely solidified.
Turning into masses of burning flames, devouring everything.
Even the snowflakes from the Calamity Defense Tower melted the moment they appeared.
However, Han Xing still did not panic.
Because until now, he had only alternated between activating ten Frozen Star Cannons and five Calamity Towers.
This means Han Xing had not exerted his full strength.
If the cold from five Calamity Defense Towers was not enough, then ten, twenty!
From a gentle snowfall, it suddenly transformed into a blizzard!
"Zz, zz, zz..."
Two enormous forces continually neutralized each other.
The entire space was completely covered by fog.
Then, Han Xing controlled fifty more Frozen Star Cannons.
The moment those fifty terrifying frost snowballs appeared.
The oppressive heat capable of space collapse vanished instantly.
A vast area ahead froze into frost.
The saying that water and fire oppose each other is based on the energy levels of both sides being similar.
When one side’s energy level is high enough.
Even frost can overpower flames!
Han Xing and his group proceeded forward unimpeded.
Finally, they reached a zone less than five thousand meters from the Flame Divine Format.
A system message appeared.
[Detected the appearance of the target, conducting identity verification.]
[Race: Human Race (match), Strength: Legend (match), Unlocking flame constraints...]
Upon hearing this message, joy appeared on everyone’s faces.
Because they knew they had succeeded.
At the same time.
The Flame Divine Format, continuously releasing Blazing Divine Power.
Suddenly stopped releasing further on this day.
All the Stone Men could feel the terrifying heat gradually subside.
The Stone Giant Race Leader watching from afar suddenly felt a bit of reluctance and also some oddity.
"Why did the Flame Divine Format suddenly stop releasing Divine Power?"
It was filled with confusion.
Han Xing and his people continued to advance.
Then, they directly reached the innermost part of the Flame Plateau.
Here.
They saw a red crystal floating in mid-air.
Like the Ice Divine Format they obtained earlier.
The Flame Divine Format emitted a dazzling, radiant glow.
Containing astounding Divine Power.
The properties of this Divine Format appeared before them.
[Elemental Divine King’s Seven Attributes Divine Format·Flame]: Special Item. (Different methods of use can achieve different effects.)

[Effect 1]: A Legendary Professional, by absorbing the Divine Power contained in the Divine Format, can significantly enhance their Divine Power Value, with an enhancement range of 5000~10000. (Upon absorption, the Divine Format shatters.)

[Effect 2]: For the Mage Profession reaching Level 60, using this Divine Format will automatically advance to the hidden profession: Flame Mage God. (Using the Divine Format to advance does not lower the level.)

[Effect 3]: Collect the remaining six Elemental Divine Formats of the Elemental God to advance to the Supreme Hidden Profession: Elemental Divine King. (Other six Elemental Divine Formats are: Ice, Lightning, Light, Dark, Earth, Wind.)
Joy appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
"Great, finally found the second Divine Format."
"Now, we just need to find the remaining five Divine Formats, and Lian Meng can change to the Supreme Profession, Elemental Divine King!"
Upon hearing this, everyone felt great joy as well.
After all, the team member’s power increment means greater aid for them.
If Zhang Lianmeng could become the Elemental Divine King, future achievements would be virtually limitless!

chapters.title: Chapter 664 - 393: The Grand Sacrifice Begins and Arrival at the Broken Land
paragraphs: Moreover, Han Xing’s team’s strength will also be greatly enhanced.
Han Xing said, "Lian Meng, go and put away the Divine Core."
Zhang Lianmeng did not refuse, softly responding with a sound.
He then directly put away the red Divine Core.
At the same time.
The Stone Giant Race Leader also sensed the disappearance of that Divine Power.
In his heart, a sense of emptiness arose.
There was also a touch of melancholy.
This was the same for other stone men who had already developed intelligence.
After all, they had been absorbing the Divine Power released by the Flame Divine Core for tens of thousands of years.
The sudden disappearance indeed made them feel quite uncomfortable.
Of course, this had nothing to do with Han Xing.
After all, this was the condition they agreed upon from the beginning.
After putting away the Divine Core.
Han Xing resumed controlling Ten Thousand Stars City, returning to the Stone Giant Race Leader’s side.
"We’ve got what we came for," Han Xing said.
The Stone Giant Race Leader nodded helplessly.
Han Xing raised his head, glancing over him,
"A word of advice, it’s better to stay away from things related to Otherworldly Evil Gods."
"Although I don’t know what kind of agreement you reached with those Evil Gods,"
"But fortunately, you realized your mistake in the end."
"Otherwise, the Stone Golem Tribe would have ceased to exist today."
The Stone Giant Race Leader, upon hearing this, showed a guilty expression on his face.
"Saint Master Han Xing is right, and we have already paid the price for it."
"I, as an old man, will remember this strictly."
Han Xing nodded.
After speaking, he prepared to lead his people away from the Flame Plateau.
At this moment, the Stone Giant Race Leader suddenly asked, "Saint Master Han Xing."
Han Xing turned his head, asking in confusion, "Is there anything else?"
The Stone Giant Race Leader said, "I heard that the Ogre Lord Gulidun died at your hands?
The incident in the Dwarf Realm had already spread throughout the entire Holy Spirit Realm.
So it was not surprising that the Stone Giant Race Leader knew about it.
Han Xing nodded, "I killed him, why, are you friends with him?"
The Stone Giant Race Leader quickly shook his head with a wry smile, "No, my relationship with Gulidun wasn’t that good."
"I just heard that the Ogre Race holds grudges."
"This time, you killed their leader."
"Given their nature, I’m afraid they might do something extreme."
"So I thought I’d give you a heads-up.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing nodded thoughtfully.
"I understand, thanks for the reminder."
After saying this, Han Xing controlled Ten Thousand Stars City, departing from the location of the Flame Plateau.
A day later.
Ten Thousand Stars City was advancing in the desolate zone.
There were still many floating Sky Islands here.
Some Sky Islands harbored powerful monsters.
Some Sky Islands had rich mineral resources.
They had now traveled almost a million kilometers from the Flame Plateau.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, what did that big stone mean at the end?"
"Will the Ogres make a move against us?"
Han Xing shook his head, "Who knows, those Ogres aren’t quite right in the head,"
"However, their Demon Lord is dead, so they don’t have the power to threaten us anymore."
"Plus, we’re constantly on the move now, even if they want to deal with us, they’d have to find our location first."
Upon hearing this, everyone laughed.
At this time, Shen Yun pondered, "Brother Xing, do you think they might try to target our tribe?"
"After all, the entire Holy Spirit Realm knows that you’re not only the Saint Master of the Witch Race."
"But also the current Master of the Human Race."
"If those guys find our location, they might attack the Witch Race people in the Witch Race Territory."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing replied nonchalantly:
"If those Ogres really dare to do that, then they’re just courting death.
"Even though we took away a few hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons this time,"
"There are still dozens of Godslaying Cannons left in the Witch Race Territory that can handle ordinary demigods with no problem."
"Moreover, I’ve built a few high-level Teleportation Arrays over the past two days."
"If there’s any trouble, we can go back to support at any time."
Upon hearing this, everyone was stunned.
Because they knew the strength of the Ogre Race.
It’s comparable to the Beastman Kingdom.
Aside from a demigod-level Ogre Lord, there are over a hundred legendary level Ogres below.
Now, their Ogre Lord had already been killed by Han Xing.
The remaining legendary Ogres, if they tried to deal with Wu Ling’Er and her group.
That would truly be seeking their own death.
Thinking about this, a relaxed smile appeared on everyone’s lips.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, now that the Flame Divine Core has been collected."
"Where are we going next?"
Han Xing looked at the map of the Holy Spirit Realm and, after thinking for a moment, said.
"The Broken Land."
Upon hearing this strange name, everyone seemed a bit puzzled in their eyes.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, The Broken Land contains a Thunder Attribute Divine Core."
"It’s perennially shrouded by terrifying thunder, and any Sky Island passing by would be shattered."
"That’s why it’s also called the Broken Land."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded in realization.
"I see, it seems that every place with a Divine Core has corresponding dangers," pondered Shen Yun.
Then, they rushed towards the area where the Broken Land was located at great speed.
At the same time.
In the distant Ogre Realm.
All Ogres, regardless of their strength, were urgently summoned to the Central Royal Capital.
Through several days of personnel deployment.
Countless Ogres arrived at the Central Royal Capital.
This was a floating island as vast as the Witch Race Continent.

There was also a touch of melancholy.

chapters.title: Chapter 665 - 393: The Grand Sacrifice Begins and Arrival at the Broken Land (Part 2)
paragraphs: At this moment, the atmosphere above was extremely solemn.
All the ogre soldiers held their weapons, seemingly ready for battle at any moment.
The faces of the ogre civilians also carried an expression of anger.
Everyone knew the news of the deaths of the Ogre Lord and the Demon Son.
This aroused the desire for slaughter within them!
The Ogre Race had over one trillion civilians.
Among them, nearly one-fifth were capable of combat.
This is a truly terrifying ratio.
From this, the number of powerhouses within this race can be seen.
On this day, the ogres who were summoned received the message.
They headed to the ancestral altar of the Ogre Race to pay their respects.
To honor the death of the Ogre Lord.
Though called an altar, it appeared more like a massive volcano.
Reaching tens of thousands of kilometers in height.
The pitch-black mountain and the deep cavernous opening.
There were seven such volcanoes on the entire Ogre Sky Island.
Countless ogres came to kneel near the volcano.
From the mouth of the volcano, down to the base of the volcano.
From a high altitude, it looked like countless ants crawling on the volcano.
Meanwhile.
Dozens of formidable figures suddenly appeared in the sky.
Each figure bore the aura of a Legendary Level.
They were the legendary powerhouses of the Ogre Race.
Upon seeing their appearance.
The ogre soldiers raised their weapons and let out peculiar cries.
"Hoo! Hoo!"
Soon after, more ogre soldiers joined in!
"Boom!"
The roar of tens of millions of soldiers converged, forming a terrifying energy, even scattering the clouds in the sky.
At this moment.
An ogre, half of whose body was covered in blood, possessing high-tier Legendary Level power, stepped forward.
With a wave of its large hand, it declared: "The ritual begins!"
Meanwhile.
A group of ogres, pushing enormous horns over a hundred meters long, came forward.
Then, they sounded the horns together.
"Wooo—
"Wooo—"
The long, heavy sound of the horns echoed,
The thousands of billions of ogres at the seven altar regions felt the call from the depths of their souls.
Then.
The blood-colored ogre continued with a wave of its large hand: "Ignite the torches!"
"Fwoosh! Fwoosh fwoosh!"
Huge torches were ignited one by one.
Expressions of sincerity were revealed on both heads of the ogres.
After a series of ritual actions,
The preparations for the ritual seemed finally complete.
At this moment, the blood-colored ogre waved a hand and said: "Offer the sacrifices, awaken the Demon Ancestor’s Ancient Power!"
Meanwhile.
In the sky, the hundred or so legendary ogres waved their hands, and the corpses of colossal monsters appeared.
These monsters were imbued with powerful Divine Power!
They were all the corpses of legendary level monsters!
The next moment, all these corpses were thrown into the mouth of the volcano.
The seven volcanoes began to shake violently.
The Divine Power in these corpses seemed to cause the volcanoes to boil.
Then, seven pillars of blood-colored light shot into the sky.
Meanwhile.
Every ogre present felt the descent of a familiar and mighty power,
It was the Bloodline Power of the ancient ogres!
Particularly the legendary level ogres, who felt it more intensely.
Their strength surged instantly!
They shouted loudly: "Praise the Demon Ancestor!"
"Thank the Demon Ancestor for bestowing us power!"
However, it wasn’t long before.
The power of the sacrifices seemed to be depleted.
The red beams pouring from the seven volcanoes began to shrink significantly.
They gradually detached from that feeling of rapid empowerment.
The high-tier ogre declared solemnly: "The number of sacrifices is still insufficient, continue to add more!"
As soon as he finished, another monster’s corpse appeared in his hand.
Judging by its aura, it had at least high-tier Legendary strength!
He directly threw it into the altar, and the red light columns surged again.
The momentum of those legendary ogres continued to grow.
However, the high-tier ogre still shook his head and said: "Not enough! It’s still not enough!"
"Continue! Continue!"
As soon as he finished speaking.
He stretched out his large hand and grabbed a huge cluster of ogre civilians kneeling like an ant colony below.
In the terrified eyes of those ogres.
He directly threw this group of ogre civilians into the altar.
The red light column flared with a whoosh.
The ogre civilians were devoured by the volcano before they could even scream.
Meanwhile, the red light continued to surge greatly!
At this moment, this high-tier ogre loudly declared: "All of this is for the glory of the Ogre Race!"
"Let us offer our bodies, souls, and bloodline!"
"Offer everything we have."
Other legendary ogres also loudly echoed!
"For the glory of the Ogre Race!"
Including the ogre armies on both sides,
They also began shouting slogans simultaneously.
In the fevered atmosphere.
All the faces of the ogre civilians showed a fanatical expression.
"I am willing to offer my life!"
"Oh Demon Ancestor, grant us more powerful strength for vengeance!"
They rushed towards the mouth of the volcano one by one.
Then jumped straight in.
And just before being devoured by the red light column, they shouted: "For the Ogre Lord!"
The volcano’s mouth swallowed their bodies in an instant.
Countless ogre civilians continued forward one after another.
Continually jumping into the mouth of the volcano, offering up their lives.
In less than half an hour,
over a hundred billion ogres had already sacrificed their lives.
Meanwhile.
The red light columns at the seven volcanic mouths were almost becoming solid.
In the sky, the momentum of those legendary level ogres began to surge.

chapters.title: Chapter 666 - 393: The Grand Sacrifice Begins and Arrival at the Broken Land (Part 3)
paragraphs: Initial-stage Legend breaking through to Middle-tier Legend.
Middle-tier Legend breaking through to High-tier Legend!
And those few High-tier Legends among the ogres, their bodies covered with blood-red skin.
They clenched their fists excitedly and said, "Almost there!"
"Just a little more, and we can have that level of power!"
"Sacrifices, we need more sacrifices!"
Ten billion, twenty billion, thirty billion!
Until billions of ogre civilians near the seven altars were all thrown into the altars.
The red pillar of light shot up to a million meters high!
But even so.
These few High-tier ogres still did not break through to demigod.
Their expressions gradually turned twisted.
Because they could feel that they were just a step away from breaking through to demigod!
However, the number of sacrifices needed for that last step was unimaginable.
"Go, gather more civilians as quickly as possible!"
The ogres declared once more.
An hour later.
Massive transport ships carried a large number of ogre civilians over.
The sacrificial ceremony continued.
Before the ogre civilians landed, they were thrown toward the altar in mid-air.
Just like dumplings being dropped.
As more and more ogre civilians died.
On this day, the ogre race’s population sharply reduced by half.
And in return, they gained relative power.
"Buzz!"
Five mighty auras surged up!
It actually broke the limit of legendary.
Officially breaking through to demigod!
That ogre with only a head left, its skin completely turned blood-red.
It clenched its fist and said excitedly, "Finally, I have obtained demigod power."
"Although it can only last a few days, it is enough to complete our revenge plan!"
With that, it looked behind.
The legendary ogres behind it all wore faces of ferocity and excitement as they looked at it.
Their power had all surged tremendously.
None of them were below Middle-tier Legend!
There were even over thirty with High-tier Legend combat strength!
This was the power obtained by the ogre race, at the cost of billions of their civilians’ lives.
At this moment, several demigod ogres waved their large hands.
"Gather the army! Mobilize all the war power within the race!"
"Follow me to the Witch Race Territory!"
"We will kill all the Witch Race people and devour all of the Human Race, leaving none behind!"
"Kill!"
"Kill!"
"Kill!"
The next moment.
Countless ogre soldiers boarded the battleships.
Thousands of fleets began moving, advancing towards the Witch Race Territory.
Three days later.
Han Xing and his team advanced over three million kilometers again.
The sky here gradually turned dark purple.
The environment here looked extremely harsh.
Almost comparable to the Flame Plateau.
Meanwhile, from afar, they could occasionally see a thunder strike.
"Crack!"
Those thunder strikes fell without a pattern, making loud booming sounds.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared in front of everyone.
[You have arrived at a new area: Broken Land, World Influence +732, Legendary Points +5.]
"We finally reached the Broken Land!" Cheng Jianyong said excitedly.
Then, he looked at Han Xing and asked, "Brother Xing, do you know what the lifeform species in the Broken Land are called, and what they look like?"
Han Xing shook his head, "In the Broken Land, there aren’t many living beings."
"And there are no specific lifeform species."
Hearing this, everyone was a bit stunned.
After all, even in an extreme environment like the Flame Plateau, there was the Stone Man race.
And yet, the Broken Land had no biological race?
Han Xing explained, "I’ve mentioned before, these thunder strikes fall randomly."
"Those Sky Islands get affected and then shattered."
"So not many Sky Islands can survive here."
"The surviving Sky Islands are home to some powerful thunder attribute monsters."
After listening to Han Xing’s explanation, everyone nodded in understanding.
Cheng Jianyong praised, "As expected of Brother Xing, you know a lot."
Han Xing smiled and said, "Last time at the Dwarf Kingdom, when I had nothing to do, I collected some information."
"With a bit of research, you can know these things too."
Hearing this, Shen Yun seemed to remember.
"Oh right, I remember during that time, Xiaoyongzi kept going to the dwarf taverns every day."
"He even dragged me along every day, didn’t think of this at all."
Cheng Jianyong said a bit sheepishly, "There was no helping it."
"The Dwarven brewing skills are astounding, and every tavern had its own signature drinks."
"Not just a month, even a year wouldn’t be enough to visit all those taverns."
Shen Yun was immediately exasperated, "You rascal..."
Han Xing interrupted them, looking forward, "Alright, let’s continue deeper."
Everyone nodded and continued to advance.
As mentioned before, not many Sky Islands existed in the Broken Land.
In the sky, there were also occasional thunder strikes.
"Crack!"
At this moment, a thunderous sound echoed in everyone’s ears.
A purple flash of lightning suddenly struck above everyone’s heads.
Without any warning or sign.
It looked like it was about to hit the Ten Thousand Stars City’s Lord’s Mansion.
But in the next moment.
A layer of blue divine power shield appeared.
"Buzz!"
The attack from the thunder strike hit the divine power shield.
Instantly, it was neutralized and dissipated into nothingness.
This shield was Han Xing’s divine power domain.
Since entering the Broken Land, their divine power domain had been continuously active.
This was to handle situations like the one just encountered.
And sure enough.
Their decision was correct.
This lightning didn’t cause them any harm.
They continued onward.
In less than ten minutes, they encountered at least eight thunder strike attacks.
Cheng Jianyong rubbed his head and said, "This cursed place is really unfit for humans to stay..."

Hearing this, everyone was a bit stunned.
After all, even in an extreme environment like the Flame Plateau, there was the Stone Man race.
And yet, the Broken Land had no biological race?
Han Xing explained, "I’ve mentioned before, these thunder strikes fall randomly."
"Those Sky Islands get affected and then shattered."
"So not many Sky Islands can survive here."
"The surviving Sky Islands are home to some powerful thunder attribute monsters."
After listening to Han Xing’s explanation, everyone nodded in understanding.
Cheng Jianyong praised, "As expected of Brother Xing, you know a lot."
Han Xing smiled and said, "Last time at the Dwarf Kingdom, when I had nothing to do, I collected some information."
"With a bit of research, you can know these things too."
Hearing this, Shen Yun seemed to remember.
"Oh right, I remember during that time, Xiaoyongzi kept going to the dwarf taverns every day."
"He even dragged me along every day, didn’t think of this at all."
Cheng Jianyong said a bit sheepishly, "There was no helping it."
"The Dwarven brewing skills are astounding, and every tavern had its own signature drinks."
"Not just a month, even a year wouldn’t be enough to visit all those taverns."
Shen Yun was immediately exasperated, "You rascal..."
Han Xing interrupted them, looking forward, "Alright, let’s continue deeper."
Everyone nodded and continued to advance.
As mentioned before, not many Sky Islands existed in the Broken Land.
In the sky, there were also occasional thunder strikes.
"Crack!"
At this moment, a thunderous sound echoed in everyone’s ears.
A purple flash of lightning suddenly struck above everyone’s heads.
Without any warning or sign.
It looked like it was about to hit the Ten Thousand Stars City’s Lord’s Mansion.
But in the next moment.
A layer of blue divine power shield appeared.
"Buzz!"
The attack from the thunder strike hit the divine power shield.
Instantly, it was neutralized and dissipated into nothingness.
This shield was Han Xing’s divine power domain.
Since entering the Broken Land, their divine power domain had been continuously active.
This was to handle situations like the one just encountered.
And sure enough.
Their decision was correct.
This lightning didn’t cause them any harm.
They continued onward.
In less than ten minutes, they encountered at least eight thunder strike attacks.
Cheng Jianyong rubbed his head and said, "This cursed place is really unfit for humans to stay..."

chapters.title: Chapter 667 - 394: I’ll Be Straight With You—I Want Your Sky Island
paragraphs: The thunder overhead was relentless, bringing with it a strong sense of threat.
Cheng Jianyong complained, "This is just the outskirts of the Broken Land, and the Thunder Strike is already so frequent."
"If we went inside, wouldn’t we be struck by lightning every day?"
Han Xing chuckled.
At this point, Shen Yun suddenly said, "Brother Xing, there seems to be a Sky Island up ahead."
Upon hearing this, everyone looked intently.
Indeed, there was a Sky Island ahead, covered by purple clouds.
The area was very vast.
At least the size of a main city of the Witch Race.
Han Xing sensed a formidable presence within it.
"Let’s go take a look."
With that, he maneuvered Ten Thousand Stars City towards it.
A system prompt appeared.
[This is a Sky Island with extremely active Thunder Elemental Energy, guarded by a very powerful creature. Would you like to enter?]
Although the prompt mentioned a powerful creature inside.
Given Han Xing and his team’s strength, they didn’t perceive it as particularly dangerous.
Thus, he directly clicked ’Yes’.
The purple clouds dispersed.
In front of Han Xing appeared a vast expanse of dark purple crystal land.
It was truly a land of crystal!
Everything here appeared so smooth.
The entire land emitted a glow reminiscent of Crystal Stone.
Han Xing glanced briefly.
[Thunder Stone Vein (Rich)]: A vein with abundant mineral resources, possibly nurturing some higher-grade metals.
Seeing the system introduction, Han Xing’s eyes lit up instantly.
"Goodness, we really came to the right place this time!"
Upon hearing this, everyone looked over, puzzled, "Brother Xing, what do you mean?"
Han Xing smiled, "Don’t you see that massive pile of Thunder Stones on the ground?"
Cheng Jianyong nodded, "I see it, but aren’t Thunder Stones considered a rather low-grade material?"
"As I recall, Brother Xing’s previous Thunderbolt Tower required a large number of Thunder Stones."
"Could it be that Brother Xing wants to build more Thunderbolt Towers?"
Han Xing shook his head with a smile.
During the Blood Tide, the Thunderbolt Tower played a crucial role.
It helped Han Xing annihilate countless Blood Tide Monsters!
Although as their strength increased, the enemies they faced became more powerful, and the Thunderbolt Tower gradually became obsolete.
However, what Han Xing wanted was not these Thunder Stones.
Han Xing said, "Don’t forget, I still have a Calamity Defense Tower, the Silent Annihilation Lightning hasn’t been established yet."
"The critical material needed for such a Calamity Tower is the Thunder Divine Stone."
"And wherever there are Thunder Stones, there are usually small amounts of Thunder Divine Stones present."
Shen Yun tentatively asked, "Is that what you mean, Brother Xing?"
Han Xing nodded, "Precisely, the resources on this Sky Island are somewhat exaggerated, as it is entirely composed of Thunder Stone."
"One can imagine there’s a terrifying amount of Thunder Divine Stones beneath."
"If we can extract them all, we could establish many Towers of Annihilation Lightning!"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes brightened.
They had already experienced the power of the Calamity Defense Tower: Withered Snowflakes.
And with even stronger Attack Power, the Silent Annihilation Lightning must be even more formidable!
They had already begun to anticipate the power of the Tower of Annihilation Lightning!
Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "Then let’s go, Brother Xing, let’s eliminate the monster on this Sky Island and then merge this Sky Island!"
Han Xing nodded.
Then he maneuvered the Sky Island to float forward.
The area of this Sky Island was vast.
At least many times larger than Ten Thousand Stars City.
After Han Xing advanced about ten kilometers on it.
He saw a central area surrounded by a mass of purple lightning.
Sparks of electricity occasionally emerged from it.
Before they got close, everyone felt their hair stand on end.
Meanwhile.
"Roar!"
A powerful beast roar echoed.
Then, they saw that mass of purple lightning rushing into the sky.
A four-legged Thunder Dragon, entirely purple and radiating electric light, appeared before them.
"Buzz! Buzz buzz!"
At this moment.
Thousands of Thunder Strikes filled the sky, as if an ancient deity controlling Thunder had awakened.
Before Han Xing, the attributes of this creature also appeared.
[Thunder Crystal Demon Dragon: High-tier Legendary Creatures]
[Level]: 59
[Attributes]: Power 51021, Agility 48631, Spirit 61347, Constitution 54865.
[Skills]: Thunder Manipulation, Thunder Body, Destruction Claw, Ultimate Skill - Doomsday Thunderstorm!
This fellow had a very ostentatious appearance.
Composed entirely of purple crystal, coupled with the overflowing electric light.
It resembled the appearance of a major boss.
"Roar!!!"
The Thunder Dragon let out wave after wave of beast roars.
Through the system translation, everyone understood what it was saying.
"Humans, why have you intruded into my territory?"
Han Xing was taken aback that this creature could communicate.
He had thought that creatures encountered on such wild Sky Islands were simply wild beasts that couldn’t communicate.
Han Xing had even wanted to blast it with a cannon and eliminate it.
But now, he slightly changed his mind.
After a moment, Han Xing straightforwardly said, "An honest person doesn’t speak in riddles."
"I’ve taken a liking to this Sky Island."
"Now you have two choices, either submit and sign a Lord Contract with me."
"Or you’ll be eliminated by me."
The Thunder Dragon was stunned by Han Xing’s straightforward declaration.
After a moment, it seemed to take it as a colossal joke, showing a disdainful expression in its eyes.
"A few humans with only Mid-Tier Legendary Combat Power dare to make me submit!"
"Today, I’ll show you the might of the Dragon Race..."
Before it could finish speaking.
A bright full moon suddenly appeared behind the Thunder Dragon.
Then, it directly sealed it in mid-air.
Han Xing didn’t bother wasting more words on it.

chapters.title: Chapter 668 - 394: I’ll Be Straight With You—I Want Your Sky Island, Too
paragraphs: The signature skill was used directly, starting with the Shattered Moon.
The Thunder Dragon, feeling its mobility restrained, showed a look of panic in its eyes.
However, before it could react and break free from the Shattered Moon’s hold,
Cheng Jianyong and the others’ attacks had already struck.
Having been partners for so long,
the moment Han Xing used his skill, they knew exactly what to do next.
"Swish! Swish swish!"
Sword Qi slashed wildly, Large Fireballs danced in the sky!
All these attacks landed on the Thunder Dragon’s body.
When the Shattered Moon skill ended,
"Crack! Crash!"
The round moon directly shattered into pieces.
Then, the Thunder Dragon’s massive form, like a kite with a broken string, fell from the sky.
"Boom!"
It crashed heavily onto the ground.
Compared to its previously magnificent figure, the Thunder Dragon now looked extremely ragged.
Even... somewhat miserable.
The purple scales on its body were charred and blackened by the onslaught.
Its back was pierced by countless arrows and marked with terrifying sword wounds.
One could say that with that concentrated wave of attacks,
if Han Xing hadn’t ordered the team to control their force,
this Thunder Dragon would already have been killed in an instant!
Of course, even now it wasn’t in good shape either.
This Thunder Dragon was already on the brink of death.
It looked at Han Xing and the others with a hint of fear in its eyes.
Han Xing approached it and asked, "Now, are you willing to sign a Lord Contract with me?"
The Thunder Dragon angrily replied, "Human Race, how dare you attack the mighty Dragon Race."
"If you kill me, the great Dragon King won’t let you off!"
Han Xing, hearing this, curiously asked, "Dragon King... are you referring to Hawthorne Glaser?"
The Thunder Dragon was taken aback, surprised that these humans knew the name of the Golden Dragon.
But then, it quickly responded seriously, "That’s right!"
"The Dragon King possesses top Demigod strength; in the entire Holy Spirit Realm, few can match it!
"No matter how strong you are, compared to the Dragon King, you’re like a firefly against the Bright Moon!"
Han Xing laughed, "The Golden Dragon you’re talking about? I fought it a few months ago."
"Including Nelos from your race, I took it down as well, even its Dragon Soul is gone."
Upon hearing this, the Thunder Dragon was instantly shocked in place.
As part of the Dragon Race, it indeed sensed the fall of a Demigod-level Giant Dragon.
Now it looked at Han Xing with a face full of shock, "You did that?"
Han Xing didn’t answer but rather asked back, "So now, I ask you again."
"Will you choose to sign a Lord Contract with me, or choose death?"
The Thunder Dragon stared blankly at Han Xing.
At this moment, it realized it had encountered a formidable opponent.
This human had even killed a Demigod-level Giant Dragon.
How could he possibly care about a High-tier Legendary Giant Dragon like it?
But the pride of the Dragon Race prevented it from bowing to this human.
"Human Race! You dare attempt to enslave the noble Dragon Race, this is a humiliation to us!"
"I will never submit to you!"
Moments later.
A system prompt appeared before Han Xing.
[Thunder Crystal Demon Dragon: High-tier Legendary Creature has signed a Lord Contract with you, Camp Fortune Value +500.]
At this moment,
After signing the Lord Contract, the Thunder Crystal Demon Dragon’s attitude took a complete 180-degree turn.
Its eyes on Han Xing were full of respect.
"Master."
Everyone laughed.
This guy, previously so dead set against it,
in the end, obediently signed the contract.
"You’re quite true to your heart!" Cheng Jianyong pointed at it and said.
The Thunder Dragon wasn’t embarrassed, but respectfully said, "Being the master’s Contracted Beast is my honor."
Cheng Jianyong rolled his eyes.
The others couldn’t help but marvel at how terrifying the Lord Contract Scroll was.
It could make even such a proud creature willingly become a servant.
The Thunder Dragon looked at Han Xing, seemingly waiting for him to give a command.
Then, it was surprised to discover that its power had suddenly surged again.
"Master... is this?"
Han Xing smiled, "Oh, it’s nothing. This is simply a benefit of signing the contract with me."
This benefit naturally came from Han Xing’s [Advanced Legendary Beast Tamer] title.
It could increase the attributes of contracted creatures by 20%.
Given the Thunder Crystal Demon Dragon’s attributes of over fifty thousand, 20% was at least a ten thousand increase in attributes.
The enhancement was absolutely terrifying!
At this moment, the Thunder Crystal Demon Dragon felt the powerful energy surging throughout its body.
Even its injuries were gradually healing.
The way it looked at Han Xing became increasingly respectful.
Then, Han Xing said, "Thunder Crystal Demon Dragon, we need to continue exploring deeper into the Broken Land."
"You manage this Sky Island and wait for us to return here."
"Then, I will take you to my territory."
This was why Han Xing chose not to kill the Thunder Crystal Demon Dragon but to contract with it instead.
This Sky Island was too massive.
Combining it would not be convenient for mobility.
Han Xing planned to, after obtaining the Thunder Divine Format, take these Sky Islands back to the Witch Race Territory for Wu Ling’Er and the others to mine.
The Thunder Crystal Demon Dragon responded respectfully, "As you command, Master."
Han Xing nodded.
Then he flew away from the Sky Island directly.
Taking his companions further into the Broken Land.
Half an hour later.
Another vast Sky Island appeared ahead.
It was also covered by purple lightning clouds.
The group exchanged a glance.
Then Han Xing directly maneuvered the Ten Thousand Stars City closer.
The system prompt appeared.
[A Sky Island with extremely active Thunder Elemental Energy, with a powerful creature on top, would you like to enter?]
It was the same prompt as on the Thunder Crystal Demon Dragon’s Sky Island.

chapters.title: Chapter 669 - 394: To Be Frank, I’ve Taken a Fancy to Your Sky Island_3
paragraphs: Han Xing clicked yes directly.
The Leiyun dissipated.
In front of them, a Sky Island made of amethyst appeared once again.
Its area was no less than the one where the Thunder Crystal Demon Dragon resided.
This also indicated that it had reserves of Thunder Divine Stones comparable to the previous Sky Island.
Han Xing and his group headed straight toward the central area of the Sky Island.
Then, they saw an extravagant creature over ten thousand meters long!
Covered in crystal-like wings, it had four wings.
[Four-winged Thunderbird]: High-tier Legendary Level Creature
[Level]: Level 59
[Attributes]: Power 53231, Agility 56432, Spirit 47441, Constitution 58543
[Skills]: Thunder Manipulation, Wings of Destruction, Thousand Birds, Four-Winged Godslaying Spear, Ultimate Skill — Ten Thousand Ridges Thunder Light!
"Goodness, another high-tier legend!"
Cheng Jianyong marveled, "The ratio of high-tier legends here is really high."
Han Xing nodded.
Indeed, the ratio was high.
However, to survive in such extreme environments, one needed some strength.
Upon seeing Han Xing and the group approaching, the Four-winged Thunderbird immediately entered a state of attack.
"Scree!!!"
Its massive wings spread, covering the sky and sun!
Bolts of lightning wings fell like raindrops!
"Sizzle!"
Zhang Lianmeng was just about to use a control skill, the Ice Age.
Suddenly, she heard Shen Yun say from behind, "Sister Lian Meng, let me test this guy’s power."
Hearing this, everyone was taken aback for a moment.
But they didn’t intervene further and all looked towards Han Xing.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Be careful."
Shen Yun responded swiftly, "Alright!"
With those words, he leaped up.
Immediately, four holy wings appeared on his body!
Like a four-winged archangel, he gained the ability to fly.
This was Shen Yun’s transformation after breaking through the legend.
At this moment, he held the shield high, radiating intense Holy Light.
He charged toward the massive four-winged strange bird in the sky.
Lightning wings poured down like raindrops.
Then they struck Shen Yun’s Giant Beast Shield, making sizzling sounds.
Each of these lightning wings was enough to cause severe damage to a typical Legendary powerhouse.
However, Shen Yun, holding the shield, remained unmoved.
Thus, the attack was entirely withstood by him.
Even the Four-winged Thunderbird had a slightly astonished look in its eyes.
The next moment.
More Power of Thunder gathered in its four wings.
"Sizzle... sizzle..."
The sky turned dark.
This demonstrated that this move was absolutely terrifying.
Many thunder elements were active in the Broken Land.
So these thunder element monsters cast spells extremely quickly.
In the next moment.
Four Thunder Spears converged again, and like a bowstring being released, they thundered towards Shen Yun.
It was the Four-winged Thunderbird’s Legendary Skill — Four-Winged Godslaying Spear!
Feeling the terror of this strike.
Han Xing was ready to provide support at any moment.
However, Shen Yun’s expression remained unchanged.
After blessing himself with numerous states, he charged forward instead of retreating.
"Sizzle!"
The first spear fell, like a lightning bolt tearing through the sky!
It struck directly on the Giant Beast Shield!
"Boom!"
Electric arcs splashed everywhere, Shen Yun did not move an inch.
Then, the other three spears all fell.
"Boom boom boom!"
Shen Yun completely withstood them but still didn’t take a step back.
It’s vital to know that each of these four Thunder Spears possessed the power to instantly kill an initial-stage legend and severely wound a middle-tier legend.
But they had no effect whatsoever.
At this moment, Shen Yun suddenly raised the Holy Hammer.
He suddenly appeared above the Four-winged Thunderbird’s head.
In the monster’s puzzled eyes.
A heavy hammer slammed down fiercely!
"Boom!"
The Four-winged Thunderbird plummeted straight from the sky.
There was a look of delight on Shen Yun’s face.
The reason he asked Han Xing and the others not to act.
Was that he wanted to test his combat strength.
To see if he could handle a high-tier legend alone without relying on Han Xing and the others’ help.
And it proved that he could.
Shen Yun then turned around and said, "All right, Brother Xing, go ahead.
Han Xing nodded.
Then, the four of them launched attacks like a storm!
Five seconds later.
The Four-winged Thunderbird lay on the ground, barely breathing.
Then, it faced the same fate as the Thunder Crystal Demon Dragon.
A yellowed Contract Scroll was thrown before it.
Han Xing once again gave it two choices.
Either sign the contract and surrender.
Or die.
Clearly, the Four-winged Thunderbird chose the second option.
[Four-winged Thunderbird: High-tier Legendary Level Creature signs a Lord Contract with you, Camp Fortune Value +500.]
The Camp Fortune Value rose once more.
At this time, Han Xing looked at the distant sky and pondered, "In the Broken Land, there are many Sky Islands like this."
"I wonder if this time, I can capture several high-tier legends as contract beasts."
"It’d be best if I could directly increase the Camp Fortune Value up to 100%!"
Thinking of this, Han Xing gave the Four-winged Thunderbird the same orders.
To manipulate the Sky Island beneath its feet, to rendezvous with the Thunder Dragon.
The Four-winged Thunderbird obeyed respectfully.
Then, this massive Amethyst Sky Island.
Began drifting towards the outskirts of the Broken Land.
Logically speaking, both the Four-winged Thunderbird and the Thunder Dragon are creatures with extremely volatile tempers.
Normally, they couldn’t possibly stay together.
But because it was Han Xing’s command.
They dutifully executed it.
Han Xing continued leading the group onward.
Along the way, when they encountered those floating Sky Islands, they would approach them.
After all, the monster quality in the ’Broken Land’ was high, so spending a little more time wasn’t a problem.
As for the monsters within, after being defeated.
Han Xing would always give them two choices.
Sign a contract, or be destroyed.
Under the threat of death.
Almost all fierce beasts would choose to agree to sign the contract.
They spent about a day.
In total, Han Xing contracted fourteen thunder element creatures.
Thirteen of which were high-tier legends.
The other one, Thunder Horned Beetle, was a demigod.
Although it was only at the initial stage, its powerful destructive power was enough to harm a typical middle-tier demigod.

sentences.text: Han Xing clicked yes directly.
The Leiyun dissipated.
In front of them, a Sky Island made of amethyst appeared once again.
Its area was no less than the one where the Thunder Crystal Demon Dragon resided.
This also indicated that it had reserves of Thunder Divine Stones comparable to the previous Sky Island.
Han Xing and his group headed straight toward the central area of the Sky Island.
Then, they saw an extravagant creature over ten thousand meters long!
Covered in crystal-like wings, it had four wings.
[Four-winged Thunderbird]: High-tier Legendary Level Creature
[Level]: Level 59
[Attributes]: Power 53231, Agility 56432, Spirit 47441, Constitution 58543
[Skills]: Thunder Manipulation, Wings of Destruction, Thousand Birds, Four-Winged Godslaying Spear, Ultimate Skill — Ten Thousand Ridges Thunder Light!
"Goodness, another high-tier legend!"
Cheng Jianyong marveled, "The ratio of high-tier legends here is really high."
Han Xing nodded.
Indeed, the ratio was high.
However, to survive in such extreme environments, one needed some strength.
Upon seeing Han Xing and the group approaching, the Four-winged Thunderbird immediately entered a state of attack.
"Scree!!!"
Its massive wings spread, covering the sky and sun!
Bolts of lightning wings fell like raindrops!
"Sizzle!"
Zhang Lianmeng was just about to use a control skill, the Ice Age.
Suddenly, she heard Shen Yun say from behind, "Sister Lian Meng, let me test this guy’s power."
Hearing this, everyone was taken aback for a moment.
But they didn’t intervene further and all looked towards Han Xing.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Be careful."
Shen Yun responded swiftly, "Alright!"
With those words, he leaped up.
Immediately, four holy wings appeared on his body!
Like a four-winged archangel, he gained the ability to fly.
This was Shen Yun’s transformation after breaking through the legend.
At this moment, he held the shield high, radiating intense Holy Light.
He charged toward the massive four-winged strange bird in the sky.
Lightning wings poured down like raindrops.
Then they struck Shen Yun’s Giant Beast Shield, making sizzling sounds.
Each of these lightning wings was enough to cause severe damage to a typical Legendary powerhouse.
However, Shen Yun, holding the shield, remained unmoved.
Thus, the attack was entirely withstood by him.
Even the Four-winged Thunderbird had a slightly astonished look in its eyes.
The next moment.
More Power of Thunder gathered in its four wings.
"Sizzle... sizzle..."
The sky turned dark.
This demonstrated that this move was absolutely terrifying.
Many thunder elements were active in the Broken Land.
So these thunder element monsters cast spells extremely quickly.
In the next moment.
Four Thunder Spears converged again, and like a bowstring being released, they thundered towards Shen Yun.
It was the Four-winged Thunderbird’s Legendary Skill — Four-Winged Godslaying Spear!
Feeling the terror of this strike.
Han Xing was ready to provide support at any moment.
However, Shen Yun’s expression remained unchanged.
After blessing himself with numerous states, he charged forward instead of retreating.
"Sizzle!"
The first spear fell, like a lightning bolt tearing through the sky!
It struck directly on the Giant Beast Shield!
"Boom!"
Electric arcs splashed everywhere, Shen Yun did not move an inch.
Then, the other three spears all fell.
"Boom boom boom!"
Shen Yun completely withstood them but still didn’t take a step back.
It’s vital to know that each of these four Thunder Spears possessed the power to instantly kill an initial-stage legend and severely wound a middle-tier legend.
But they had no effect whatsoever.
At this moment, Shen Yun suddenly raised the Holy Hammer.
He suddenly appeared above the Four-winged Thunderbird’s head.
In the monster’s puzzled eyes.
A heavy hammer slammed down fiercely!
"Boom!"
The Four-winged Thunderbird plummeted straight from the sky.
There was a look of delight on Shen Yun’s face.
The reason he asked Han Xing and the others not to act.
Was that he wanted to test his combat strength.
To see if he could handle a high-tier legend alone without relying on Han Xing and the others’ help.
And it proved that he could.
Shen Yun then turned around and said, "All right, Brother Xing, go ahead.
Han Xing nodded.
Then, the four of them launched attacks like a storm!
Five seconds later.
The Four-winged Thunderbird lay on the ground, barely breathing.
Then, it faced the same fate as the Thunder Crystal Demon Dragon.
A yellowed Contract Scroll was thrown before it.
Han Xing once again gave it two choices.

chapters.title: Chapter 670 - 395: The Army Attacks!
paragraphs: At the beginning, this Thunder Horned Beetle was determined not to yield.
It even wanted to fight Han Xing and his group to the death.
However, when Han Xing activated his ultimate skill—Endless Arrow Prison.
This Demigod-level Thunder Horned Beetle was beaten to the brink of death.
Under absolute power, it chose to surrender.
[Contract successfully signed, Thunder Horned Beetle: Demigod-level creature has joined your camp, Camp Fortune Value +2000.]
And this was the second Demigod-level creature that Han Xing had subdued.
The first one was the Beastman King, Uman.
Watching the rapidly increasing Fortune Value.
A smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
Because the rise in Fortune Value signified that their attributes were improving as well.
The strength of everyone was steadily growing.
At this moment, Shen Yun sighed, "The Broken Land is indeed a remarkable place."
"So many wild Sky Islands, filled with resources, and the monsters are formidable too."
Han Xing nodded, "Indeed, but most of these Sky Islands are in the outer regions."
"The thunder inside is too powerful, and few monsters exist there."
Cheng Jianyong inquired at this moment, "Brother Xing, when do we head to the core of the Broken Land to take that Thunder Divine Format?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment and shook his head, "No rush, the Thunder Divine Format is there, it’s not going anywhere on its own."
"Let’s see if we can conquer all the Sky Islands in the Broken Land first!"
"By then, the Fortune Value gained from these monsters joining my camp will give us a substantial boost."
When they heard this, everyone’s eyes lit up instantly.
As mentioned before, the Thunder Divine Format is just sitting there.
It’s not going to run away on its own.
For now, it’s better to focus on enhancing our strength first.
Therefore, in the period that followed, they explored the Sky Islands in the Broken Land.
Subduing the monsters above.
Fortunately, the Broken Land had no factions settled within.
So Han Xing and his group acted without restraint.
Almost every Sky Island they came across fell into their hands.
Resources, monsters, none were spared.
[Contract successfully signed, Thunder Dream Snake: High-tier Legendary Level creature, Camp Fortune Value +500.]
[Contract successfully signed, Star Electric Fox: High-tier Legendary Level creature, Camp Fortune Value +500.]
[Contracting...]
One monster after another was subdued by Han Xing, causing the Camp Fortune Value to soar.
In a flash, four days had passed.
At this moment in the Holy Spirit Realm.
A massive fleet was advancing at full speed.
The sheer number of ships overshadowed the sky!
The monsters on the wild Sky Islands felt the fleet’s imposing presence and fled in panic.
From afar, they could see on those ships.
A surge of bloodlust and killing intent burst forth.
Everything in their path retreated in fear.
This enormous fleet was none other than the Ogre army.
Led by over a hundred and twenty Legendary Level Ogres, plus five Demigod-level Ogres.
And billions of Ogre soldiers, marching straight towards the Witch Race Territory.
They passed through the borders of many races along their route.
But faced no obstruction from anyone.
For these races sensed the terrifying aura of the Ogres.
Moreover, the presence of five Demigod-level Ogres added to the intense intimidation.
No one dared to provoke the Ogre race at this time.
At this moment, the clan leaders of those large races discussed, "What is the Ogre race planning to do?"
"By their demeanor, they seem hostile."
"Indeed, this time, they have deployed almost all their forces, including five Demigod-level Ogres."
"Could they be headed to wage war on a race?"
Upon hearing these words.
The powerhouses of those large races were stunned for a moment, then said in confusion.
"Wage war?"
"The Three Kings Conference just concluded, and it was said that all races should develop peacefully, right?"
"Whom do the Ogres intend to make trouble with this time?
The powerhouses pondered for a moment.
Then as if recalling something, they said, "I remember recently, there was a bloody incident in the Dwarf Realm."
"A Demigod-level Ogre Lord was killed publicly by a group of humans."
"Could it be that these Ogres are looking to cause trouble for the Human Race?"
The Legendary Powerhouses were taken aback for a moment, then nodded.
"It seems, that is possible!"
"With the vengeful nature of the Ogre race, they might indeed do something like this."
"By the way, should we inform the Human Race of this?"
This suggestion from a powerhouse was quickly rejected.
"Do you even know how to contact those humans to inform them?"
"I say, report this matter directly to the three major races and let them handle it!"
The powerhouses of the large races unanimously agreed on this decision.
At the same time.
A message quickly spread throughout the Holy Spirit Realm.
The Ogre race, mobilizing all its forces, was preparing to attack the Human Race!
The three major races, upon learning of this, immediately contacted the current leaders of the Ogres.
But they were told in response.
This was a private vendetta between them and the Human Race.
They hoped the three major races would not interfere.
The leader of the Ogre race had been killed by humans.
According to the rules of the Holy Spirit Realm, the Ogres had the right to wage war against the Human Race.
Even the three major races could not intervene.
The three major races remained silent.
Because indeed, that is the rule of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Conflicts between two races that cannot be reconciled are to be resolved through war.
As long as it doesn’t involve other races, no other race is to interfere.
At this moment in the Witch Race Territory.
Wu Ling’Er also received an urgent message.
A massive invasion by the Ogre army.

chapters.title: Chapter 671 - 395: The Army Approaches! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Moreover, they are about to feel the territory of the Witch Race.
"The Ogre Race?" Wu Ling’Er slightly furrowed her brow, murmuring.
"Is it because of what happened with Brother Xing last time?"
Thinking of this, Wu Ling’Er quickly opened the communication channel and called for an emergency meeting.
In the central meeting hall of the Witch Race.
Wu Ling’Er looked at everyone sternly, saying, "Everyone has heard, the Ogre Race is attacking us with their entire race."
"Their target is our Witch Race territory, intending to start a war."
Down below, a group of strong warriors of the Witch Race frowned tightly.
They asked, "Lady Saintess, we have had little contact with the Ogre Race."
"Now they suddenly want to attack us. Do we know why?"
Wu Ling’Er glanced at him, "Not long ago, Saint Master Han Xing killed the Demon Lord of the Ogre Race."
"This might be their revenge."
Hearing this, the expressions of the powerful legends of the Witch Race below changed instantly.
Because in this way, the Ogre Race now has a legitimate reason to act.
They want to wage war, and the Witch Race can only hold on.
At this moment, the Twelve Priests of the Witch Race suddenly asked, "Lady Saintess, can Saint Master Han Xing return?"
Wu Ling’Er shook her head, "I don’t know, I haven’t notified him yet."
"But even if I informed the Saint Master, he probably couldn’t return in a short time."
"After all, he is too far away from us now."
Wu Ling’Er was unaware of the marvels of the high-level Teleportation Array.
No matter how far apart they are, Han Xing and his group could instantly return.
"Then..." The Twelve Priests hesitated to finish.
Wu Ling’Er said, "If you have a question, just say it."
The Twelve Priests of the Witch Race continued, "As far as I know, the Ogre Race is powerful."
"Even without their Demon Lord, they still have over a hundred legendary figures."
"If Saint Master Han Xing doesn’t come back, can we withstand them with our Power?"
Wu Ling’Er directly said, "If the Ogre Race’s strength was only this, we could handle them without a problem."
"After all, our Witch Race Continent still has the dozens of Spiritual Godslaying Cannons left by Saint Master Han Xing.
"These Godslaying Cannons are high-tier ancient weapons, along with lots of other defense towers."
Hearing this, the legends of the Witch Race below breathed a sigh of relief.
However, Wu Ling’Er’s next words made their hearts jump again.
"But according to the intelligence I gathered."
"This time, for some unknown reason, the power of the Ogre Race has surged significantly."
"There are more than eighty middle-tier legendary ogres, and nearly thirty high-tier legends."
Hearing this, the Twelve Priests were immediately shocked, "So many legends? And such formidable power!"
"Isn’t it a bit difficult for us to deal with them?"
"After all, we only have twelve legends left, even with the help of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons, we can’t handle so many enemies..."
"Unless the High Priest can use that Secret Technique again to gain demigod-level combat strength."
"Only then can we stand a chance."
Once said, everyone on the scene turned to the High Priest.
High Priest Xiao immediately nodded, "I have no problem."
"Recently, the fortune of the Witch Race has been soaring amazingly."
"My Power has also greatly increased, maintaining the Secret Technique for a long time is not an issue."
The legends present relaxed upon hearing this.
But then, Wu Ling’Er shook her head, "In fact, it’s not just like that."
"Besides those over one hundred legends, there are also five demigod-level ogres this time."
"The enemy’s power is much stronger than we anticipated..."
At this point, the sound of inhalation resonated throughout the audience.
"Hiss!!!"
"Five demigods! Thirty high-tier legends and dozens of middle-tier legends?"
"Oh my god, there’s no hope of victory at all!" The Twelve Priests of the Witch Race exclaimed in shock.
Other legends of the Witch Race also nodded heavily.
At this time, they continued, "Lady Saintess, please notify Saint Master Han Xing as soon as possible.
"Even if he can’t come back now."
"See if he can use his influence to get other races of the Holy Spirit Realm to come to our aid."
"Indeed, Lady Saintess, we are no match for the Ogre Race!"
Wu Ling’Er continued to shake her head, "It’s useless, the rules of the Holy Spirit Realm are that matters between two races must be resolved by themselves."
"We cannot involve other races."
"Moreover, with the Ogre Race suddenly manifesting five demigods this time."
"In the face of absolute Power, no one would be willing to help us."
"So this war still needs to be handled by ourselves."
Hearing this, the scene fell into silence.
A looming sense of crisis seemed to envelop their hearts.
This time, the enemy is too powerful.
Given their strength, there is simply no hope of victory.
The Twelve Priests said helplessly, "Saint Master Han Xing... was too reckless this time."
"Killing the Ogre Lord in front of so many people."
Wu Ling’Er glanced at him, saying in an incredibly serious tone, "Min Luo, do not question any decision of the Saint Master."
"I hope this is the first and last time!"
The Twelve Priests heard the threat in Wu Ling’Er’s tone.
Including other legends of the Witch Race, their gazes towards him were somewhat unfriendly.
After all, right now, Han Xing’s reputation in the Witch Race is said to be at its peak.
Even surpassing the previous Witch Race Saint Master, Helas.
The Twelve Priests dared to question Han Xing, which amounted to violating the crowd’s taboo.
He shivered and hurriedly said respectfully, "I acknowledge my mistake!"
"Saint Master Han Xing has led the Witch Race to victory time and time again, and I recklessly questioned his decision."
"I truly deserve to die!"
Listening to his voice of remorse, Wu Ling’Er shook her head, "That’s enough."

Including other legends of the Witch Race, their gazes towards him were somewhat unfriendly.
After all, right now, Han Xing’s reputation in the Witch Race is said to be at its peak.
Even surpassing the previous Witch Race Saint Master, Helas.
The Twelve Priests dared to question Han Xing, which amounted to violating the crowd’s taboo.
He shivered and hurriedly said respectfully, "I acknowledge my mistake!"
"Saint Master Han Xing has led the Witch Race to victory time and time again, and I recklessly questioned his decision."
"I truly deserve to die!"
Listening to his voice of remorse, Wu Ling’Er shook her head, "That’s enough."

chapters.title: Chapter 672 - 395: The Army Attacks! (Part 3)
paragraphs: The twelve priests stopped their actions.
Wu Ling’Er looked at all the Witch Race Legends on the field and announced.
"Alright, disperse."
"Prepare for the war."
"Yes!"
All Witch Race Legends became solemn and retreated one after another.
Just as they were about to leave.
A sudden and extremely fierce aura emerged in the Witch Race Continent.
Judging by the strength of the aura, it actually possesses Demigod Level power!
And it was swiftly heading towards the Witch Race Central Continent.
"Demigod?"
Wu Ling’Er’s hair instantly burst out, announcing: "Everyone, be on alert!"
She thought it was the Ogre Race demigod attacking ahead of time.
In an instant, all Legendary Powerhouses immediately entered combat state!
However, although the opponent was charging toward them.
They couldn’t sense hostility from that Demigod aura.
Moreover, it did not trigger any defense mechanisms on the Witch Race Continent.
This means the other party is not an enemy.
Wu Ling’Er furrowed her brows: "An allied Demigod?"
"When did we gain a Demigod ally?"
Others were also extremely puzzled.
Nevertheless.
The group of Witch Race Legendary Powerhouses remained vigilant.
A moment later.
A towering beastman figure appeared.
It was the King of the Beastman Kingdom, Uman.
Upon seeing him, Wu Ling’Er asked in confusion, "Beastman King, why have you come to our Witch Race?"
Uman heard and, feeling slightly embarrassed, said, "Saintess, we’re on the same front line."
"In the future, we’re going to be comrades."
Upon hearing this, all Witch Race Legends shrank their pupils.
"Beastman King, what do you mean by that?"
Wu Ling’Er seemed unable to fully believe it.
However, the Beastman King spoke with some difficulty: "What it means... is that your Saint Master Han Xing is now also my... master."
"What!?
Instantly, all Witch Race Legends stood up.
Their eyes were filled with disbelief!
Oh my god!
What did they just hear?
The Beastman King, a dignified Demigod Level powerhouse.
The leader of a race, actually regards their Saint Master as his master?
The Beastman King continued: "Though you might not believe it, it’s a fact."
"I’ve received a command from the master, if the Witch Race is threatened, come to aid immediately."
"Not just me, including our Beastman Kingdom, all Legendary Beastmen are on their way."
At this moment.
Everyone still looked at Uman in disbelief.
But they could see that Uman was not lying.
Regarding Han Xing, they were even more astounded beyond measure!
Because no one on the field knew.
When Han Xing subdued the Beastman King and even other Beastman Legends!
Quietly accomplished such an astonishing deed that could shake the entire Holy Spirit Realm!
Everyone stood frozen in place.
Uman’s voice interrupted them.
"Everyone, from now on, we are in the same camp."
"The ogre army is about to attack, let’s discuss how to deal with them."
The Witch Race Legends snapped back to reality.
At this point, they have begun to gradually accept.
The fact that the Beastman King has become their ally.
Wu Ling’Er was the first to react.
She also believed the Beastman King wasn’t lying.
After all, that man indeed creates miracles time and again.
Subduing the Beastman King is just a normal occurrence.
Wu Ling’Er nodded and said, "King Uman, please take a seat."
Her tone became somewhat relaxed.
With Uman the Demigod, plus the aid of those dozens of Legendary Level Beastmen from the Beastman Kingdom.
The pressure from the invasion of the ogre army is no longer as intense.
Broken Land.
Han Xing has just signed a Lord Contract with a high-tier legendary fierce beast.
Suddenly, he heard a system prompt.
[Notice to the Survivor, the upgrade progress for the title High-tier Legendary Beast Tamer has been completed and has automatically upgraded you to Demigod Level Beast Tamer.]
[Demigod Level Beast Tamer (upgradable)]: All attributes of creatures under contract increase by 30%, experience gain speed increases by 40%.
[Upgrade Progress]: 100/500(Legendary Level), 6/10(Demigod Level).
"Oh my... upgrade?"
Han Xing was incredibly surprised.
These past days.
They’ve been exploring the periphery of the Broken Land,
roughly found over 120 Sky Islands, taming nearly 100 powerful creatures.
Among them, there are as many as five Demigod Level creatures!
In addition to over ninety high-tier legends!
This is a very powerful force.
Besides the three main races.
No other group has such a mighty faction.
Moreover, with Han Xing’s [Demigod Level Beast Tamer] title bonus.
These contracted beasts can further increase their attributes substantially.
Even the high-tier legends now have barely enough power to harm a demigod.
And the Demigod Level thunder element fierce beast among them even possesses middle-tier demigod power!
Han Xing looked at his title with satisfaction.
"Truly impressive!"
"And this title can still be upgraded!"
"By the time I explore all the Sky Islands in Broken Land, I should be able to upgrade this title to middle-tier demigod."
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong and the others also came over.
Compared to four days ago, everyone’s aura increased tremendously.
Everyone’s attributes have received a significant boost.
This is because.
In the past four days, besides the increase in the number of contracted beasts under Han Xing.
Also increasing is the camp’s Fortune Value.
These contracted beasts have altogether increased Han Xing’s fortune value by 57,500 points.
Calculate that as a whopping 57.5% attribute enhancement!
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but exclaim: "The speed at which fortune value rises is too fast!"
"Now just the camp enhancement alone is giving me 80% extra attribute bonus!"
"My Power is close to breaking through 60,000!"
"So exhilarating!"

chapters.title: Chapter 673 - 396: The War Begins!
paragraphs: Cheng Jianyong sighed at the augmentation of Fortune Value, bringing great enhancement.
Including the others, they also nodded in agreement.
It should be known that every major race in the Holy Spirit Realm has this augmentation function of Fortune Value.
However, the Fortune Value of those major races,
is cultivated step by step through nurturing geniuses within the clan.
Pouring in various resources to cultivate a large number of Legendary powerhouses.
Not like Han Xing, who directly goes to the wild in large numbers to catch those Legendary Thunder Beasts.
Han Xing looked at the outskirts of the Broken Land and said, "In four days, we have explored about a fifth of the region in the outskirts of the Broken Land."
"If we could explore it all, the Fortune Value would probably increase a lot more."
"Let’s spend a bit more time to finish exploring the outskirts of the Broken Land first."
Everyone simultaneously nodded, excitement showing in their eyes.
One can imagine, when Han Xing truly conquers the entire Sky Island of the Broken Land,
their attributes would be elevated to a terrifying level!
At this time, Han Xing suddenly received a message.
It was sent by Wu Ling’Er.
She quickly reported what recently happened in the Witch Race Territory and the invasion by the Ogre army.
After listening, Han Xing furrowed his brows.
Then, suddenly revealed a smile.
"Interesting, those Ogres really came to the Witch Race Territory to cause trouble for us."
Everyone was momentarily stunned.
Instantly understood the meaning behind Han Xing’s words.
Cheng Jianyong said, "Uh... why are these Ogres so unreasonable?"
"Do they actually plan to rely on that bunch of Legends to get revenge?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "No, that’s not it. These Ogres are not that stupid."
"They somehow managed to produce five Demigod-level Ogres and a large swarm of Mid-High Tier Legendary Ogres."
"Now, they have already reached the border of the Witch Race Territory."
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "So many Demigods and Legends? That’s indeed quite powerful!"
"No wonder, even after the Demon Lord was killed, they have the confidence to cause trouble for us."
Shen Yun listened, then worriedly asked, "Brother Xing, with the strength we left in the Witch Race Territory, we’re afraid we can’t handle so many Ogres, right?
"Shouldn’t we go back and support them for a wave?"
Han Xing nodded.
This time, despite leaving more than sixty Spiritual Godslaying Cannons and a large number of Defense Towers,
without the amplification of the Sun Crown Stele, these Defense Towers cannot complete qualitative change.
Thus, Wu Ling’Er and the others should not be opponents of the Ogre army.
However, Han Xing had long prepared a plan to deal with this situation.
Which is the High-Level Teleportation Array built in advance.
It can instantly bring them all back to the Witch Race Territory.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "Let’s go, we’ll spare some time to go back once."
"Just in time, let’s take these Contracted Beasts back first."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes brightened.
In the next moment, Han Xing then controlled the Ten Thousand Stars City.
And this Sky Island he just conquered, heading towards a certain place in the Broken Land.
At the same time.
The Witch Race Border.
The Ogre army had already crossed the space turbulence, arriving at the Witch Race Border.
Because they already knew about the Ogre army’s invasion news.
So this time, Wu Ling’Er and the others had brought the Witch Race army and numerous powerhouses in advance.
Even bringing the Witch Race Continent along.
On it, there are terrifying numbers of Defense Towers and dozens of Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
Sufficient to threaten a Demigod.
As for those Witch Race civilians, they have been relocated to safe places.
At this moment.
The two armies are confronting each other.
The soldiers of the Witch Race have gotten their strength enhanced by the Fortune Value, each one strong and powerful.
But compared to the other side, the Ogre army’s momentum is evidently much stronger.
This time, the Ogre Race has come out in full force.
Their army numbers also greatly exceed those of the Witch Race.
The bloody killing intent almost dyes the sky red!
Especially the five leading Demigod-level Ogres, making people feel waves of heart tremors.
At the same time.
They also saw the top-tier powerhouses from both sides.
The presence of Legendary and Demigod-level beings.
Both sides simultaneously surged with terrifying auras.
The Witch Race over here, with the addition of dozens of Legends from the Beastman Kingdom, barely manages to withstand the momentum of the Ogre Race.
At this moment.
The foremost Ogre, looking at the Beastman King, asked.
"Beastman King, this is a grudge between our Ogre Race and the Human Race."
"The Master of the Human Race is the Saint Master of the Witch Race, these Witch Race Legends participating, I can understand."
"But you Beastmen intervening, this disrupts the rules of the Holy Spirit Realm."
The Beastman King heard this and immediately retorted angrily, "You talk nonsense!"
"Saint Master Han Xing is not only the Saint Master of the Witch Race, but also our Beastman Kingdom’s highest leader!"
"Our help, how can that count as breaking the rules of the Holy Spirit Realm?"
The Demigod Ogre furrowed its brows and asked, "Do you mean you are aligning with those Humans?"
The Beastman Kingdom retorted, "Not aligning."
"But we have always been sincere, willing to serve the Master!"
Upon hearing this, the Demigod Ogre showed a trace of surprise.
Uman actually calls that Human the Master.
And according to him, the entire Beastman Kingdom has been subdued by that Human.
Like Wu Ling’Er, its eyes showed some slight confusion and shock.
But a moment later, it responded.
"Ha... even with you Beastmen, the outcome is the same."
"Don’t think, just relying on you, a Demigod, can hold us back!"
"Today, we’re going to slaughter everyone on the Witch Race Continent and devour every Human!"
