chapters.title: Chapter 674 - 396: The War Begins! (Part 2)
paragraphs: "This is a fact that no one can change!"
The Witch Race legends immediately shouted angrily, "Arrogant!"
The demigod ogre sneered, "You’ll soon see if I’m arrogant or not!"
"Ogre army! Prepare for battle!"
After speaking.
The figure of the demigod ogre suddenly appeared in mid-air.
"Woo—"
The long sound of a horn echoed.
The enemy army pressed forward.
This also heralded the start of the war!
In an instant.
A hundred legendary-level beings rose within the ogre army.
There’s no need for Wu Ling’Er to command.
The group of legendary-level beastmen, along with the remaining dozen legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race, all rushed forward.
"Boom!"
Nearly two hundred legendary-level powerhouse battles.
Have already surpassed the Shadow Legion’s massive invasion.
The aftermath of the legendary powerhouses’ battle, made all soldiers below Tier Four unable to withstand it.
They knew this situation, so they carried their opponents and rushed to the endless skies.
Legendary powerhouses created a battleground for themselves.
Below, both sides’ warships and defense towers began firing at each other.
"Boom!"
"Buzz!"
Like an interstellar battle.
Various energy beams streaked across.
Each beam contained attack power that could instantaneously kill a Four-star Elite, Leader.
Those ordinary soldiers touched it almost to their death!
This time, the ogre legion attacked with everything they could bring!
At this moment, under the full-scale firing by both sides, a subtle balance was surprisingly formed.
Even the ogres seemed somewhat surprised.
They hadn’t expected the defense towers of the Witch Race to be so strong!
The demigod-level ogre hadn’t made a move all along.
Now, it spoke with interest, "Underestimated you!"
"Didn’t expect the Witch Race has such formidable defensive power.
"However, you can block our warships; what will you use to stop me?"
After speaking, a powerful aura exploded from its body!
Half the sky was instantly dyed blood red.
This demigod-level powerhouse.
Then, like a burning comet, charged toward the Witch Race’s army.
The Beastman King summoned a war axe out of nowhere and angrily shouted, "I’ll fight you!"
After speaking, he leapt into mid-air.
Directly swinging the axe down!
"Puff!"
The battleground between two demigods, fierce momentum soaring.
Nearly causing everyone to tremble uncontrollably.
The demigod ogre was intercepted, frowning.
"Beastman King, underestimated you."
"All other demigod ogres, attack!"
This ogre, with only one head, was clearly the highest-ranked among the ogres.
Once given its command.
Four strong demigod auras erupted from the ogre army!
An ogre with a long scar across its face, looking ferocious, loudly asked, "Who will fight me?"
High Priest Xiao took a deep breath and said solemnly, "I’ll come."
After speaking.
His red secret pattern instantly ignited, surprisingly possessing demigod-level strength.
This ogre stared at Xiao, licking its lips and saying, "Actually gained demigod-level strength through secret techniques."
"Witch Clan’s secret technique; indeed, a worthy name."
"Just wondering, how delicious are the Witch Race people?"
Xiao sneered, "Go eat in hell."
He directly charged at the scar-faced ogre.
Taking away this demigod-level powerhouse.
However, there were still three demigod-level powerhouses on the field, unopposed!
The three demigod ogres, their mouths twisted into sinister expressions.
"Seems like that’s as far as you go."
"I’ve already sensed the Human Race’s presence, so many humans!"
"On that continent!"
"This time, I want to feast to my fill!
Then, the three ogres simultaneously charged towards the Witch Race Continent.
At this moment, only Wu Ling’Er remained among the strong on the Witch Race Continent.
With her, it’s certainly impossible to match the three demigods.
However, Wu Ling’Er was not panicked.
She began operating the over sixty Spiritual Godslaying Cannons Han Xing had left for her!
"Boom! Boom boom boom!"
The Spiritual Godslaying Cannons bombarded in waves.
Feeling the horror of those energy beams.
The three demigod ogres’ faces suddenly changed.
Their figures disappeared from the spot, hurriedly fleeing.
Yet, two ogres were slow by a step.
Their bodies brushed by the energy beams, instantly tearing away large chunks of flesh.
The two ogres, eyes filled with fear, looked at Wu Ling’Er.
"Damn it! What kind of defense tower is this?"
"Its power is truly terrifying?"
The other demigod ogre was also surprised, "Didn’t expect the Witch Race to have such methods!"
"If we hadn’t held a grand ceremony beforehand this time, we may have indeed suffered a setback!"
"Be careful, don’t get hit by that woman’s attacks!"
The three demigod ogres became more cautious.
Wu Ling’Er continued to manipulate the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons, bombarding the enemy.
However, without the Sun Crown Stele’s enhancement.
At least ten Spiritual Godslaying Cannons had to concentrate fire in one attack.
To threaten a demigod-level powerhouse!
And this meant.
Wu Ling’Er had to activate at least half the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons each time.
To intimidate these three demigod ogres.
Yet, this presented a problem.
The [Spiritual Godslaying Cannon] has a long charge time.
Without the Sun Crown Stele, this charge time is greatly extended.
This resulted in, before Wu Ling’Er could bomb two waves, the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons went into cooldown!
At this very moment.
The demigod ogres ready to dodge suddenly noticed Wu Ling’Er’s current predicament.
Their eyes lit up instantly.
"This woman is done for!"

Nearly two hundred legendary-level powerhouse battles.
Have already surpassed the Shadow Legion’s massive invasion.
The aftermath of the legendary powerhouses’ battle, made all soldiers below Tier Four unable to withstand it.
They knew this situation, so they carried their opponents and rushed to the endless skies.
Legendary powerhouses created a battleground for themselves.
Below, both sides’ warships and defense towers began firing at each other.
"Boom!"
"Buzz!"
Like an interstellar battle.
Various energy beams streaked across.
Each beam contained attack power that could instantaneously kill a Four-star Elite, Leader.
Those ordinary soldiers touched it almost to their death!
This time, the ogre legion attacked with everything they could bring!
At this moment, under the full-scale firing by both sides, a subtle balance was surprisingly formed.
Even the ogres seemed somewhat surprised.
They hadn’t expected the defense towers of the Witch Race to be so strong!
The demigod-level ogre hadn’t made a move all along.
Now, it spoke with interest, "Underestimated you!"
"Didn’t expect the Witch Race has such formidable defensive power.
"However, you can block our warships; what will you use to stop me?"
After speaking, a powerful aura exploded from its body!
Half the sky was instantly dyed blood red.
This demigod-level powerhouse.
Then, like a burning comet, charged toward the Witch Race’s army.
The Beastman King summoned a war axe out of nowhere and angrily shouted, "I’ll fight you!"
After speaking, he leapt into mid-air.
Directly swinging the axe down!
"Puff!"
The battleground between two demigods, fierce momentum soaring.
Nearly causing everyone to tremble uncontrollably.
The demigod ogre was intercepted, frowning.
"Beastman King, underestimated you."
"All other demigod ogres, attack!"
This ogre, with only one head, was clearly the highest-ranked among the ogres.
Once given its command.
Four strong demigod auras erupted from the ogre army!
An ogre with a long scar across its face, looking ferocious, loudly asked, "Who will fight me?"
High Priest Xiao took a deep breath and said solemnly, "I’ll come."
After speaking.
His red secret pattern instantly ignited, surprisingly possessing demigod-level strength.
This ogre stared at Xiao, licking its lips and saying, "Actually gained demigod-level strength through secret techniques."
"Witch Clan’s secret technique; indeed, a worthy name."
"Just wondering, how delicious are the Witch Race people?"
Xiao sneered, "Go eat in hell."
He directly charged at the scar-faced ogre.
Taking away this demigod-level powerhouse.
However, there were still three demigod-level powerhouses on the field, unopposed!
The three demigod ogres, their mouths twisted into sinister expressions.
"Seems like that’s as far as you go."
"I’ve already sensed the Human Race’s presence, so many humans!"
"On that continent!"
"This time, I want to feast to my fill!
Then, the three ogres simultaneously charged towards the Witch Race Continent.
At this moment, only Wu Ling’Er remained among the strong on the Witch Race Continent.
With her, it’s certainly impossible to match the three demigods.
However, Wu Ling’Er was not panicked.
She began operating the over sixty Spiritual Godslaying Cannons Han Xing had left for her!
"Boom!
Boom boom boom!"
The Spiritual Godslaying Cannons bombarded in waves.
Feeling the horror of those energy beams.
The three demigod ogres’ faces suddenly changed.
Their figures disappeared from the spot, hurriedly fleeing.
Yet, two ogres were slow by a step.
Their bodies brushed by the energy beams, instantly tearing away large chunks of flesh.
The two ogres, eyes filled with fear, looked at Wu Ling’Er.
"Damn it!
What kind of defense tower is this?"
"Its power is truly terrifying?"
The other demigod ogre was also surprised, "Didn’t expect the Witch Race to have such methods!"
"If we hadn’t held a grand ceremony beforehand this time, we may have indeed suffered a setback!"
"Be careful, don’t get hit by that woman’s attacks!"
The three demigod ogres became more cautious.
Wu Ling’Er continued to manipulate the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons, bombarding the enemy.
However, without the Sun Crown Stele’s enhancement.
At least ten Spiritual Godslaying Cannons had to concentrate fire in one attack.
To threaten a demigod-level powerhouse!
And this meant.
Wu Ling’Er had to activate at least half the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons each time.
To intimidate these three demigod ogres.
Yet, this presented a problem.
The [Spiritual Godslaying Cannon] has a long charge time.
Without the Sun Crown Stele, this charge time is greatly extended.
This resulted in, before Wu Ling’Er could bomb two waves, the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons went into cooldown!
At this very moment.
The demigod ogres ready to dodge suddenly noticed Wu Ling’Er’s current predicament.
Their eyes lit up instantly.
"This woman is done for!"

chapters.title: Chapter 675 - 396: The War Begins!
paragraphs: "Brothers, let’s attack together!"
As soon as the words were spoken.
The momentum of the three demigod-level ogres instantly soared.
Then they fiercely charged towards Wu Ling’Er!
Wu Ling’Er’s expression changed.
Just as the three ogres were about to approach the Witch Race Continent.
A Frost Slime with high-tier legendary power suddenly appeared.
Its round body abruptly bounced into the air.
The temperature instantly dropped significantly.
However, this scene left the three demigod ogres extremely puzzled.
"A Slime?"
"And with high-tier legendary power?"
They seemed equally stunned.
A low-level creature like a Slime could evolve into a high-tier legend.
Too astonished, the ogres momentarily forgot to act.
Until the Frost Slime suddenly spat out several ice cones, directly descending upon them.
"Puff, puff, puff!"
Feeling the formidable power coming straight at them.
They finally reacted.
The three ogres swiftly sidestepped to dodge!
The next moment, one ogre shouted angrily, "Don’t just stand there, attack!"
They launched their attacks simultaneously.
Three demigod-level strikes descended.
The Frost Slime sensed the terrifying blow.
It immediately curled up into a ball.
And covered itself with a thick layer of Frost Armor!
However, how could a demigod-level attack be easily withstood?
Especially three at once!
At the moment the red energy beams made contact with the Frost Slime.
"Crack!"
A clear shattering sound was heard.
The armor on the Frost Slime instantly shattered.
Like a deflated balloon, it flew backward for several kilometers!
Wu Ling’Er’s brows knitted tightly together.
At this time, the three demigod-level ogres exchanged a glance.
"Great, now there’s no power left to stop us from attacking the Witch Race Continent!"
"Don’t be careless, still be wary of that woman."
Upon hearing these words, the ogres immediately became alert.
They were intimidated by the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon’s attack.
Just then.
The beam of destruction arrived once again.
The three demigod ogres dodged several times.
The Spiritual Godslaying Cannon fell back into a recharging period.
Looking at Wu Ling’Er’s slightly powerless expression.
The three ogres’ eyes flashed with a sinister smile.
"It seems the Witch Race Saintess truly is finished!"
"It’s said that the Witch Race Saintess has an unusual relationship with the Master of the Human Race!"
"This time, let’s capture her!"
"Then wait for the Master of the Human Race to return, and devour the Witch Race Saintess right in front of him!"
These words were agreed upon by the other demigod ogres.
Then, they charged together towards the Witch Race Continent.
Seeing the aggressive enemies.
Wu Ling’Er held an ancient seed in her hand.
She pondered for a moment, looking at the item in her hand, murmuring, "This is the final trump card Brother Han Xing left me."
"Should I use it now?"
Seeing the three ogres getting closer.
Wu Ling’Er knew that if she didn’t use it now, she wouldn’t have another chance.
She sighed.
Just as she was about to crush the gray seed in her hand.
She suddenly felt a familiar aura emanating from the teleportation array behind her.
Wu Ling’Er quickly turned around.
When she saw the teleportation arrays light up, her eyes instantly filled with joy.
"Brother Han Xing!"
Wu Ling’Er almost subconsciously shouted.
At the same time.
The entire Witch Race border battlefield.
All the powerhouses above legendary level sensed those five powerful auras.
And all turned their gaze.
Then, they saw Han Xing’s figure.
At that moment, whether beastmen from the Beastman Kingdom.
Or the legendary powerhouses of the Witch Race, all shouted in joy.
"Master!"
"Saint Master Han Xing!"
They didn’t know how Han Xing suddenly appeared.
But no matter what, as long as this man appeared.
They felt they’d found their backbone.
The overwhelming ogre army ahead could no longer exert much pressure on them.
"Great, the Saint Master has returned!"
"As long as the Saint Master acts, those ogres will surely be defeated!"
"That’s right, the Saint Master is invincible."
Compared to the excitement of the Witch Race legends and the beastmen.
The ogres’ momentum felt strange.
At this moment.
The ogre demigod battling Uman had a ferocious look in its eyes.
"Master of the Human Race, you finally came!"
It shouted loudly among the army.
Han Xing merely glanced at it casually, then looked elsewhere.
Feeling ignored, the ogre demigod’s eyes filled with shame and anger.
"Damn you, Master of the Human Race, are you always this arrogant?"
"I’m talking to you!"
Han Xing glanced at it, then spoke softly, "Not really."
"You’re just too weak to pique my interest."
He saw through it.
This ogre demigod seemed to have broken through using some secret technique.
Its strength was still very unstable.
Even weaker than a typical initial-tier demigod.
So, such an enemy was not worth Han Xing’s attention.
Hearing this, the ogre grew even more furious.
"Master of the Human Race, today you’ll pay for your arrogance!"
It ordered, "You three, go capture the Master of the Human Race!"
As soon as the words were spoken.
The three demigod ogres simultaneously charged at Han Xing.
Han Xing shook his head.
These ogres were truly naïve.
Their Ogre Lord had already been defeated by Han Xing.
Did they think two more demigods could tackle him?
He couldn’t be bothered with words and directly said, "Take care of them."
The team understood.
Shen Yun immediately hurled a sun into the air.
Then Su Xiaoyang shot an arrow.
Countless vines appeared in the void.
The three demigod ogres didn’t even make a move; using divine power, they directly evaporated the vines Su Xiaoyang released!

chapters.title: Chapter 676 - 397: Thunder Beasts Mobilize, Massacre!
paragraphs: They said with disdain in their eyes, "Do you really think such means can deal with us?"
"What a naïve..."
Before the sentence was finished.
They suddenly felt waves of coldness on their bodies.
Layer upon layer of frost began to cover their bodies.
It was Zhang Lianmeng’s legendary control skill, Ice Age!
In the ancient ruins, Zhang Lianmeng had consumed three Insect Mother Cores and five bottles of Genetic Potion.
Added to that, there was a significant increase in Camp Fortune Value.
Her Spirit Attribute had already broken through 80,000!
This is almost the attribute of an initial-tier demigod.
Under such a massive increase in Spirit Attribute, her Ice Age also received a great enhancement!
Three demigod ogres were instantly frozen.
A strong unease appeared in their hearts.
Han Xing glanced over and directly said, "Finish them off immediately."
Everyone listened without a moment of hesitation.
Cheng Jianyong swung his sword, unleashing terrifying Sword Qi.
Heaven-Sundering Sword!
The heavens and earth were instantly split with a 10,000-meter long rift.
Then.
Han Xing’s arrow.
Zhang Lianmeng’s Forbidden Curse, as well as Su Xiaoyang’s Legendary Skills, all fell down.
Feeling the terror of this strike, and witnessing the three ogres frozen into ice sculptures.
The demigod-level ogre immediately exclaimed, "Be careful!"
However, its warning was futile.
Three seconds later.
The three gigantic ice sculptures shattered.
"Crack! Crack crack!"
"Boom!"
Exploding directly!
The next moment.
Suddenly three thunderclaps resounded in the sky.
That was the sign of demigods falling.
At this moment, the entire battlefield was at a standstill.
The battle situation shifted too quickly.
From when Han Xing and his group of five appeared, to when three demigods came to attack them.
Altogether, it took less than half a minute.
Such a change occurred.
The legendary ogres themselves showed intense fear in their eyes!
In one wave, they obliterated three demigods!
Anyone else would think it unbelievable!
The ogres were utterly horrified.
Because such terrifying beings were their enemies.
Just thinking about it made their hairs stand on end!
The High Priest was floating mid-air, muttering, "The Saint Master has become stronger again..."
"And these Humans with him have also grown much stronger."
"Although still exuding a Legendary Level aura, they all have the power to slay demigods..."
"It’s truly incredible..."
Uman split open an enemy in front of him with an axe, looking at Han Xing with fervent eyes.
"Truly worthy of being my master!"
"Compared to the geniuses of the Holy Spirit Realm, with Master, it’s like comparing fireflies to the Bright Moon!"
"Master is truly too powerful!"
The demigod-level ogre showed panic in its eyes for the first time.
It had severely underestimated Han Xing and his group’s power!
From the reports it received, it seemed they had used some special means to kill the Ogre Lord.
But now, it knew that these Humans were not as it imagined.
Terrifyingly strong!
The Ogre Lord died at their hands, and it was not unjustified...
With the appearance of Han Xing and his group.
The morale of the Witch Race Soldiers on the battlefield surged dramatically!
One by one, their eyes filled with madness, suppressing the ogre army who were retreating under pressure despite having lesser power.
Conversely, the ogres’ morale continued to diminish.
If this continued, defeat was inevitable.
The demigod ogre, fighting against the Beastman King, said, "Master of the Human Race, you are indeed strong."
"But this time, we, the Ogre Race, have bet everything."
"Victory will be ours!"
Its tone grew increasingly frantic, its expression becoming terrifyingly grotesque.
Han Xing heard its somewhat crazed declaration, remaining unmoved.
He had no worries about the ogres having any formidable tactics.
In the Holy Spirit Realm, with no gods appearing.
Han Xing could be truly unbeatable.
However, they did not know Han Xing’s current strength.
The demigod ogre waved its hand, declaring, "Continue the sacrifice!"
Meanwhile.
In the distant Ogre Realm.
Countless ogre civilians who had been waiting received a command.
The situation on the battlefield had changed.
The Ogre Race needed their sacrifice.
A fervent look appeared in the eyes of these ogre civilians.
Then, they began to fearlessly leap into the volcanic crater.
Wave after wave, like dumplings.
Additionally, to accelerate the sacrifice.
In the sky, numerous ogre transport ships were at work.
The ogre civilians they carried aboard began to jump into the volcanic crater without hesitation.
At the same time.
Seven beams of light shot up into the sky once again.
And this time, even stronger than before!
These beams contained infinite bloodline power of the Ogre Race.
At this moment, it seemed to be summoned.
Crossing millions of kilometers.
From the distant Ogre Realm, arriving at the Witch Race Territory.
Han Xing suddenly felt.
The strength of hundreds of billions of ogre soldiers on the field began to rise rapidly.
From ordinary Tier Four Warriors, they instantly gained Elite Level power.
And those elites directly gained the prowess of a Leader.
If it were just a portion, it would be fine.
But now, it was the entire group, hundreds of billions of soldiers all enhancing together!
This method was terrifying.
Moreover, what shocked everyone more was.
Not only were the ordinary soldiers enhanced.
Even those in the legendary-level battlefield, the legendary ogres began to break through again and again.
"Boom! Boom boom boom!"
One formidable aura after another rose up.

chapters.title: Chapter 677 - 397: Thunder Beasts Mobilize, Massacre!
paragraphs: The ogres possessing high-tier legendary combat power have astonishingly reached a count of fifty, and the number continues to grow!
As for those ogres who originally had high-tier legendary combat power.
At this moment, it is as if they have broken through some kind of shackle, their strength soaring instantly!
An additional six demigod-level ogres have appeared!
The rise of the Witch Race’s army was immediately suppressed by absolute power.
At this moment, the ogre leader shouted loudly: "Do you see it, Master of the Human Race!"
"This is the power our Ogre Race has obtained by sacrificing our entire tribe!"
"We are certain to win this war."
"Only by devouring all humans can we honor the sacrifice of our Ogre Race!"
Listening to this increasingly crazed talk.
Han Xing said somewhat disinterestedly: "If you consider this your final trump card, I advise you not to struggle anymore."
"Surrender early."
"It’ll save everyone’s time."
The ogre leader sneered coldly: "Stop pretending here."
"Master of the Human Race, I think you’d better surrender early."
"Maybe if we are in a good mood, we can spare some humans as a seed."
Han Xing replied speechlessly: "Sometimes, I really wonder how your Ogre Race, with brains like yours, managed to develop."
"Just as well, I recently found a new batch of contracted beasts to play with you all."
As the words fell.
Within the Witch Race Continent.
A dozen high-level teleportation arrays suddenly lit up.
The brilliance became increasingly dazzling!
Within it, people saw faint traces of the Law of Thunder.
The next moment.
A gigantic creature, covered in dazzling electric light, soared into the sky.
"Caw!!"
When a loud cry pierced the sky, everyone immediately turned their gaze to look.
It was the Four-winged Thunderbird!
At this moment, it swooped down into mid-air, its hawk-like eyes staring at the group of ogres, like a Thunder Monarch occupying the sky!
The ogre leader, after the initial surprise, recognized the Four-winged Thunderbird’s strength and disdainfully said.
"Just a high-tier Legend? You think..."
Before the ogre leader could finish speaking.
The teleportation arrays suddenly erupted, as terrifying creatures emerged one after another!
Each creature was larger than the last!
Frenziedly crawling out from the teleportation arrays.
Purple Crystal Demon Dragon, Thunderous Celestial Beetle, Electric Arc Hundred-Slit Bird...
These creatures all shared one feature: they carried a rich power of the thunder element.
Among them, there were even traces of several demigod-level auras!
When over a hundred thunder-element fierce beasts appeared simultaneously.
The entire sky over the Witch Race Territory was instantly dyed a dark purple.
"Rumble!"
Deep thunder continuously rolled.
As if the entire sky had been completely taken over by this group of thunder-element fierce beasts.
At this moment, the ogre leader’s throat moved with difficulty...
From these thunder beasts, it felt an overwhelming sense of oppression!
Every single Thunder Beast had an extremely strong combat power, and was incomparably solid.
Far beyond the ogre legends and demigods who used secret techniques to enhance themselves.
Any random high-tier legendary Thunder Beast’s aura strength was two to three times that of ogres of the same level!
Upon seeing this group of thunder beasts, the ogre leader immediately had an ominous premonition.
At this moment, Han Xing said: "Go."
"Annihilate those ogres."
Upon receiving Han Xing’s command.
The over one hundred ancient fierce beasts suddenly exhibited extreme killing intent in their eyes!
The next moment, they vanished from where they stood.
"Boom!"
A lightning bolt descended.
In the blink of an eye, the group of thunder-element fierce beasts had already charged to the front of the ogre legends’ formation.
That area was instantly covered by endless lightning!
These thunder-element beasts moved with boundless power of thunder in every action.
The ogres only felt Doomsday approaching.
The ogre leader shouted: "Block these monsters!"
Hearing the ogre leader’s voice, the ogres snapped out of their daze.
However, as the legendary powerhouses of both sides clashed for less than a second.
One legendary ogre was torn apart on the spot, blood raining through the sky!
Then came the second, third, and fourth!
One by one, legendary ogres were crushed unilaterally.
They shouted in horror: "Oh heavens! Where did these monsters come from? How are they so powerful?"
"Talan, save me!"
Screams echoed continuously,
the legendary ogres fell one after another.
Falling like rain!
This was a completely one-sided slaughter.
Before absolute power, they had no chance to fight back.
"Run! Quickly run!"
"We are no match for these monsters!"
Seeing their kin being massacred.
"Damn it!"
At this moment, the newly ascended demigod ogres in the sky cursed angrily as they saw the situation.
They intended to go down to help.
However, several extremely terrifying auras instantly locked onto them.
Currents surged across the surface of the ogres’ bodies.
"Crackle..."
As they looked up.
They saw five colossal creatures, each over tens of thousands of meters, emitting endless lightning, glaring fiercely at them!
Then, they charged directly.
Those demigod ogres muttered: "It’s over..."
The next moment.
Ten demigod-level powerhouses clashed together.
Like on the legendary battlefield.
The demigod-level battlefield was also a completely one-sided crushing!
By the time the final duel between the powerhouses officially began, not even five minutes had passed.
Half of the legendary ogres had already perished.
Those demigod ogres were already covered in wounds.
Terrifying lightning continuously seeped from their bodies.

chapters.title: Chapter 678 - 397: Thunder Beasts Mobilize, Massacre!_3
paragraphs: Electricity rendered them charred on the outside, tender on the inside.
Seeing the battle had somewhat stabilized.
Han Xing deliberately sent out over a dozen thunder beasts to the soldiers’ battlefield to start the massacre.
With the terrifying power of these thunder beasts,
slaughtering these soldiers below Tier Five was as simple as dealing with a group of ants.
A single bolt of lightning could obliterate at least ten thousand ogres.
And each of their casual attacks consisted of hundreds of lightning strikes.
To date, billions of ogre soldiers have been reduced to ashes by the lightning.
These thunder beasts harbored no mercy whatsoever.
Especially since it was Han Xing’s command,
they immediately transformed into reapers of life!
Wherever they went, countless ogres transformed into ashes and perished!
"Help!"
"Demon Lord... your clansmen are being massacred unilaterally, don’t you see it?"
However, their pleas went unanswered.
This was the darkest day in the history of the Ogre Race.
Faced with those terrifying legendary level beasts,
these soldiers stood no chance of resistance!
Even deploying ogre warships for a counterattack proved utterly useless.
The lightning shells of those thunder beasts could withstand incredibly terrifying damage.
The massacre continued.
Even the eyes of the ogre leader showed intense fear.
It never thought things would escalate to this point.
A situation that was initially advantageous collapsed the moment that human appeared!
Moreover, no matter what tactics it employed afterward, they were easily dismantled by this human.
While it was contemplating these matters,
several legendary ogres were torn apart on the spot.
The ogre leader snapped back to reality and exclaimed, "Stop!"
"Human Race, stop now!"
However, Han Xing didn’t even glance at it.
The massacre continued.
The bodies of one ogre after another exploded into clouds of blood.
The defeat of the ogre army was a foregone conclusion.
At this rate, the Ogre Race might even face complete extinction.
The ogre leader no longer had any of its previous madness.
Instead, its eyes were filled with intense fear.
Suddenly, it shouted loudly, "Stop! Master of the Human Race, get these thunder beasts to stop."
"The Ogre Race is willing to surrender!"
It seemed to engage in an intense mental battle.
Its tone was full of reluctance.
Hearing the ogre leader’s declaration of surrender caught the powerhouses on the battlefield off guard.
They didn’t seem to expect this seemingly mad creature to utter words of surrender.
However, what the crowd didn’t know was,
this time, for revenge, the Ogre Race had already given it their all.
They not only sacrificed more than half of their clansmen,
but also brought out almost all their resources.
This army represented their final strength.
If all the ogre soldiers here, including those legendary ogres, perished,
then today would mark the effective extinction of the Ogre Race.
Nonetheless, Han Xing continued to ignore it, "Continue, kill them all."
Upon hearing this, despair filled the eyes of the ogre powerhouses.
At this moment,
the Witch Race powerhouses, along with the thunder beasts, resumed their frenzied slaughter.
Groups of ogre soldiers were blasted to pieces on the spot, dead beyond recognition.
Legendary ogres continued to fall.
They had completely abandoned any thoughts of resistance.
Before the thunder beasts’ attacks arrived, one by one, they shouted loudly, "Don’t kill us!"
"We surrender, we surrender!!"
Yet, Han Xing remained unmoved.
The massacre continued...
The hearts of the ogre race were filled with utter despair.
Seeing that Han Xing had no intention of sparing them,
that ogre put aside its last shred of pride.
It knelt in mid-air and shouted loudly, "Master of the Human Race, we are willing to enter a Lord Contract with you."
"For generations upon generations, we will revere the Human Race!"
"Please, Master of the Human Race, have mercy."
"Leave a path of survival for the Ogre Race!
To preserve a seed of their kind, this ogre leader not only abandoned its dignity to plead,
but also willingly became Han Xing’s slave, for generations to be a subordinate race to the Human Race!
At this moment, every powerhouse present looked at Han Xing, seemingly awaiting his decision.
Yet, Han Xing merely shook his head and said, "Continue to fight."
Hearing this, the ogre leader of demigod level felt enveloped by absolute despair.
It knew that the Ogre Race was finished today!
This human had no intention of sparing the Ogre Race.
He intended to utterly wipe them out!
Han Xing coldly observed it all.
Although he knew that signing a contract with these ogres could greatly increase his fortune value,
and could enhance the foundation and strength of Han Xing’s faction,
not every creature was worth entering a Lord Contract with.
In their genes, the Ogre Race was an enemy of the Human Race.
Furthermore, they fed on humans.
Toward such a race, whenever Han Xing found the opportunity, he would naturally prioritize exterminating them for peace of mind.
Absolutely no chance for them to make a comeback!
At this moment, the battle continued.
As one legendary ogre after another was blasted apart, until all were slaughtered,
then it was the turn of those demigod level ogres.
Their bodies burst open, exploding into clouds of blood in the air.
"Boom boom boom!"
One by one, the demigod level ogres fell.
Strange phenomena appeared continuously in the sky.
On this day, many powerhouses in the Holy Spirit Realm felt a sensation.
It seemed as though top powerhouses were perishing en masse.
So, they projected their consciousness.
All looking toward the Witch Race Territory.
However, the aura of those several hundred high-tier thunder beasts was too terrifying, directly affecting the entire sky.
Even the heavenly phenomena from the fall of demigods were completely covered!
They could only see the sky of the Witch Race Territory completely shrouded by purple thunderclouds.
As for what exactly was happening, it was utterly unknowable...

chapters.title: Chapter 679 - 398: Overwhelming Victory!
paragraphs: The hidden powerhouses of the Holy Spirit Realm wanted to see clearly what was happening within the Witch Race Territory.
However, when they cast their gaze upon it,
all they could see was that the sky over the Witch Race Territory was completely shrouded in purple thunderclouds.
As for what exactly was happening, they had no way of knowing.
Even those ancient beings who had been hidden for countless years could not discern the truth.
At this moment, a few ancient beings of the major tribes were discussing with each other.
"Can any of you see what’s happening in the Witch Race Territory?"
"We can’t see clearly. Ever since that human defeated the Trick, the fortune value of the Witch Race has undergone a terrifying change."
"Using divine sense to probe, we can only see the fortune projection of that human, covering the entire Witch Race Territory."
"We can’t see any other situation at all."
The other ancient beings nodded in agreement.
"This current Master of the Human Race is truly too enigmatic."
"Even during the rise of the Hunter, and that one from the Demon Race, such a thing didn’t occur."
From the distant Sea of Light, a voice emerged: "I see that the fortune of the Ogre Race is already shrouded in red."
"I’m afraid the Ogre Race has already been defeated, and their powerhouses are experiencing a large-scale massacre."
"This current Master of the Human Race harbors heavy killing intent."
The other ancient beings also sighed: "Indeed, alas for the Ogre Race, to have encountered such a great Killing Star."
"He even dares to kill the God of Tricks. If he grows up, he could very well become another Demon Emperor!"
This statement received agreement from the other ancient beings.
"Indeed, such a great Killing Star must not be allowed to grow."
"One Demon Emperor is enough for us to endure."
"That’s right, I propose we immediately activate some countermeasures to eliminate this human!"
At this moment, from the Path of the Giant Dragon came an ancient and forlorn will.
"You old fogies, stop pretending here."
"You knew full well that the Ogre Race’s attack on the Human Race was doomed to fail, yet no one stopped it."
"Weren’t you just using the Ogre Race to probe the current power of the Human Race?"
"Truly hypocritical!"
"And now you want to eliminate this human?"
"If you had the courage, you would have stepped up when the Trick was nearly killed.
Upon hearing this, those wills, despite being exposed in public, were not annoyed but instead laughed: "Old Dragon, you know there’s an old human saying, ’With age comes wisdom,’ don’t you?"
"We’re just a bunch of old fogies struggling to hang on. Of course, we avoid taking risks if we can."
"Furthermore, you call us hypocritical, but isn’t your Dragon Race the same?"
The will from the Sea of Light spoke again.
"Throughout history, the humans who emerged from the Land of the Abandoned Gods have been exterminated by us time and again."
"And the Land of the Abandoned Gods is located in your Path of the Giant Dragon and is the only road leading to the Holy Spirit Realm."
"This generation of humans presented such a significant change, and you claim you didn’t know?"
"Sometimes, I truly wonder which side you Dragon Race are on."
The will from the Path of the Giant Dragon remained silent for a while.
Moments later, it chuckled softly: "The Dragon Race stands on no side."
"I am not like you old fogies."
"You only live on to continue surviving..."
The Sea of Light entity chuckled again: "And you, old dragon."
"Why have you struggled to hang on for so many years?"
"For what..."
The one in the Path of the Giant Dragon seemed unclear as well.
Seeing it not answer, those ancient existences fell silent once more.
At this moment, on the battlefield of the Witch Race Territory.
With the death of all the Legendary and Demigod Ogres,
there remained hundreds of billions of Ogre soldiers on the field.
They were like lambs waiting to be slaughtered, without any ability to resist.
And Han Xing’s order was to kill every Ogre.
Not leaving a single one.
The Witch Race soldiers and the Legendary-level powerhouses faithfully executed Han Xing’s order.
The Witch Race soldiers commenced a one-sided massacre.
The Ogre soldiers died in swathes.
However, due to the sheer number of Ogre soldiers present,
it would take at least half a day to kill them all.
The screams nearly echoed to the sky.
Han Xing frowned.
"The efficiency is a bit slow..."
Then, he waved his hand.
He had the Demigod-level Thunder Beasts join the slaughter as well.
The Demigod-level Thunder Beasts’ killing efficiency was extremely high.
A casual bolt of lightning could take away tens of thousands of Ogre soldiers.
A single burst would unleash at least tens of thousands of lightning bolts.
In just a few minutes,
tens of billions of Ogre soldiers were already dead.
Because so many creatures had died, the battlefield turned blood-red.
The intense blood aura lingered indefatigably.
The entire battlefield was shrouded in a dense blood mist.
"Boom!"
When the last Ogre warship was blasted apart,
this war finally came to an end.
The ferocious war effort by the Ogre Race was effortlessly dissolved by Han Xing.
At this moment, all Witch Race soldiers, excitedly watching Han Xing,
simultaneously knelt on one knee, shouting:
"Hail the Saint Master!"
Hundreds of billions of soldiers knelt in unison.
Even the Legendary-level powerhouses joined in the call.
"Hail the Saint Master!"
Months later,
Han Xing once again appeared in the Witch Race Territory,
causing the soldiers to feel extremely excited.
In their hearts, Han Xing was a man who continuously created miracles,
having saved the Witch Race from disaster more than once.
Now, he had done it again!
The moment he appeared, the menacing Ogre forces crumbled.
Now, they were entirely annihilated!

causing the soldiers to feel extremely excited.
In their hearts, Han Xing was a man who continuously created miracles,
having saved the Witch Race from disaster more than once.
Now, he had done it again!
The moment he appeared, the menacing Ogre forces crumbled.
Now, they were entirely annihilated!

chapters.title: Chapter 680 - 398: Decisive Victory! (Part 2)
paragraphs: To Han Xing, they have already regarded him as a divine spirit in their hearts!
Han Xing nodded, then directly said, "Everyone worked hard in this battle."
"Your bravery has also been witnessed by me."
"You all are the mightiest warriors!"
Having received Han Xing’s praise,
The billions of Witch Race soldiers below immediately lifted their heads in excitement.
Some even had hands holding weapons that were slightly trembling.
Now, Han Xing’s prestige among the Witch Race has surpassed that of previous Saint Masters.
He’s even almost on par with the mighty founder of the Witch Race.
And at this moment, Han Xing continued to speak.
"Although we won this battle,"
"The war is not yet over!"
Hearing this, those strong figures on stage shook their heads in confusion.
Han Xing then announced: "Though the ogre army has been exterminated by us,"
"Do not forget, there are more ogres in the Ogre Realm."
"Now, we have become enemies who will not rest until the other is dead."
"This is a racial war, we cannot give our opponents any chance to rise again!"
The soldiers below steeled their expressions, silently waiting for Han Xing to continue.
"Now, the army will march to the Ogre Realm!"
"To complete the last war!"
Upon hearing Han Xing’s command, the Witch Race soldiers on stage were deeply shaken.
This is to eliminate the entire Ogre Race, to leave not a single one alive!
However, they had no objections and even greatly agreed with Han Xing’s decision.
This is how wars between races are.
The defeated must be prepared for annihilation.
Mere appeasement will only make others think you are easily bullied.
And could even leave a hidden danger, giving the enemy a chance to make a comeback.
Han Xing looked around the field and suddenly asked, "Where is the High Priest?"
Xiao heard this and immediately stepped forth.
"I’m here, my lord."
Han Xing nodded, "I’ll entrust this task to you."
"Lead the Witch Race army to the Ogre Realm and complete the final war.
Xiao was taken aback, then nodded and said, "I accept the order."
After speaking, he turned around and began to gather the troops.
After Han Xing said a few more words, he let the strong ones disperse.
Half an hour later.
Han Xing returned to Ten Thousand Stars City with his team members to rest for a while.
He then went to the royal palace alone.
This was where Wu Ling’Er stayed most of the time.
Wu Ling’Er had been waiting there, and when she saw Han Xing come over,
She said excitedly, "Brother Xing, you’re finally back!"
"You were gone for so many days this time, I was worried to death..."
"But it’s good that you’re back safe and sound."
Wu Ling’Er said, showing Han Xing a gentle smile.
Han Xing nodded and smiled, "Ling’Er, I can come back at any time now, no need to worry."
Upon hearing this, Wu Ling’Er became even happier.
At that time, the sky over the Witch Race was still covered by thick thunderclouds.
Large thunderous creatures dominated the sky.
Even Wu Ling’Er in the royal palace could feel the restless thunder element.
Wu Ling’Er asked in confusion, "Brother Xing, what are those?"
Han Xing replied, "Like Uman, they are now my contracted beasts."
"I brought them back with me this time."
"In the future, they will also be stationed within the Witch Race territory."
"Even when I’m not here, you can order them to do things."
Hearing this, surprise flashed in Wu Ling’Er’s eyes.
But upon thinking that it was this man, there was nothing strange at all.
It was indeed something Han Xing could accomplish.
She nodded joyfully.
"Great! With this, the strength of the Witch Race territory can be enhanced again!"
Han Xing nodded.
After chatting for another half hour or so.
Both felt the longing in each other’s hearts.
Then, Han Xing directly picked Wu Ling’Er up in a princess carry.
Wu Ling’Er buried her head in Han Xing’s embrace, her soft body trembling slightly.
She appeared both shy and expectant.
Then, the two entered Wu Ling’Er’s bedroom.
Two hours later.
Wu Ling’Er, with a look of contentment and a blush, leaned against Han Xing.
She extended her dainty fingers, her whole body soft like boneless, half-pressing on Han Xing.
Han Xing gently petted her soft and silky hair, saying, "Ling’Er, I won’t be staying long this time."
"My Sky Island is still in the Broken Land right now."
"To avoid any accidents, I have to teleport over soon."
"Oh? Leaving so soon?" Wu Ling’Er’s tone carried a hint of disappointment.
Han Xing chuckled, "Don’t worry, even in the Broken Land, I can return at any time."
"Didn’t I already tell you?"
Hearing this, Wu Ling’Er felt a bit more at ease.
Han Xing continued, "By the way, in the coming days, some thunder element wild beasts might keep arriving."
"Just arrange a place for them, and let them stay there."
Wu Ling’Er nodded, "Okay, Brother Xing."
After spending some affectionate time together.
Han Xing left the royal palace.
An hour later.
The team members regrouped.
The next moment.
The five of them directly stepped into the teleportation array, disappearing from the spot.
The scene flashed.
A system prompt appeared.
[You have entered the Broken Land...]
The scene in front of everyone immediately changed.
Compared to the sunshine and calm of the Witch Race territory,
The Broken Land with its constant thunder and lightning had a dark sky.
In an instant, they felt as if they were in another world.
Cheng Jianyong sighed, "This High-Level Teleportation Array is really convenient."
"Covering such a vast distance, at least tens of millions of kilometers, and it sent us back instantly."

chapters.title: Chapter 681 - 398: Decisive Victory! (Part 3)
paragraphs: "It’s as if we’ve suddenly arrived in another world from our own."
Everyone nodded in deep agreement.
At this moment, Shen Yun seemed to remember something and asked in confusion, "Brother Xing, I remember that the natives of this world aren’t supposed to use the teleportation array, right?"
"How could those Thunder Beasts use the teleportation array to return to the Witch Race Territory?"
Han Xing replied, "This is a method I stumbled upon by chance."
"After those Thunder Beasts signed a contract with me, they became my contracted beasts, much like Coal Ball."
"So, they too can return to the Witch Race Territory via the teleportation array."
Everyone nodded in sudden realization.
However, Coal Ball protested excitedly from the side.
It insisted that it was not the same as those Thunder Beasts.
It is a unique presence by the master’s side!
Everyone laughed together.
Han Xing also patted Coal Ball’s head and then said with a smile, "Alright, let’s continue exploring the Sky Island in the Broken Land now."
"First, let’s wipe out all the Thunder Element monsters inside!"
"Then, go to the central area and take the Thunder Divine Format."
Everyone was excited after hearing this.
The following time.
Han Xing and the others continued to explore the Broken Land.
One by one, Thunder Element monsters signed contracts and were transported back to the Witch Race Territory by Han Xing.
They existed as the foundation of Han Xing’s camp.
It can be said that as long as Han Xing doesn’t die, these Thunder Beasts have no chance of rebellion for life.
And with the addition of these Thunder Beasts.
Han Xing’s camp would leap to become the fourth superpower in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Possessing terrifying combat power that could rival or even crush the other three races!
And this time, it’s not just the overwhelming number of defense towers.
The number of powerful individuals is no longer Han Xing’s shortcoming.
Time quickly moved to a month later...
While Han Xing was conquering the Sky Island area of the Broken Land.
The Holy Spirit Realm was also undergoing some changes.
At this moment.
In the Elf Realm.
On countless beautiful Sky Islands filled with giant trees and greenery, where various flowers bloom all year round.
Lived countless elves.
They often flew across the branches of various giant trees and occasionally perched on petals.
The sweet whispers of elf maidens were often heard from those Sky Islands.
It was like a paradise on earth.
However, the recent invasion of Abyss Demons disrupted this peaceful and beautiful scene.
And the places where they built various teleportation arrays were in the Elf Realm.
The Elf Race was greatly troubled by this.
Even the sacred World Tree was damaged by the conspiracies of the Demon Race.
Today.
In front of that vast and sacred World Tree.
Countless elves held devout prayer rituals.
Elf maidens carried small wooden buckets.
Continuously pouring the purest dew from the buckets onto the roots of the World Tree.
This was something they did every day.
Before the sun rose.
This group of elves would emerge early from the tree houses.
Then, using the wooden buckets in their hands, they would collect dew from the forest.
To offer it to the great and sacred World Tree.
And beside the world, there was a group of elf priests dressed in white robes, wearing laurel crowns.
They sang loudly with solemn music.
"Oh, benevolent Mother Tree, you are the mother of all things..."
"We wish to offer you the best blessings of our time..."
"All things in the world grow in your embrace..."
"Oh... holy Mother Tree..."
In the chanting prayers of the elf priests.
Numerous elf maidens, like little bees, consecutively poured out the collected dew.
"Splash..."
The sound of flowing water was unending.
At this moment.
The leaves of the World Tree gently swayed.
It seemed to be delighted by their blessings.
At this time, an elf maiden with transparent wings on her back, looking adorable, wiped the sweat from her forehead.
Then, revealing a cute smile, she said, "Wonderful, the Mother Tree’s injuries have finally improved after all these years of our nurturing."
"Those hateful demons, how could they dare harm our Mother Tree? It’s truly vile!"
Beside her, an elf maiden with a youthful face and an exaggerated voluptuous figure also agreed, "Yes, those demons are incredibly vile!"
"But fortunately, our Elf King is powerful and has repeatedly repelled those demons."
"For so many days, we haven’t heard any news of the Demon Race invading again."
However, before she finished speaking.
Suddenly her expression froze.
Throughout various areas of the Elf Realm, purple pillars of light shot into the sky!
From these purple pillars, everyone felt a familiar yet evil aura.
It was the power from the Abyss Realm!
"Oh no! The Abyss Demons are invading the Holy Spirit Realm again!"
"So many teleportation arrays, quickly inform the Elf King!"
At the same time.
The moment these purple pillars appeared, the entire Elf Realm sounded the alarm.
"Woo—"
The long and overwhelming alarm rang across the sky.
The entire Elf Realm entered a state of alert.
At the same time.
A mighty aura not inferior to the Dwarf King soared into the sky.
He was imbued with a strong holy radiance, burning like a blazing sun.
Just a glance, and it was blinding.
He was the Elf King.
At this moment, the Elf King, emitting a sacred radiance, loudly proclaimed, "All elves, enter Level One war status!"
"The Abyss Demons remain malicious, attempting to launch another attack on our race."
"Soldiers, pick up your weapons and fight with me!"
Elf soldiers immediately shouted, "Follow the will of the Elf King, fight!"
"Charge!!!"
All elf soldiers began war mobilization!
In this situation, they did not panic either.

chapters.title: Chapter 682 - 399: Trial of the Master of War Ghosts
paragraphs: In the past, Abyss Demon invasions frequently occurred.
But each time, they were forcefully repelled.
Those teleportation arrays only allowed the emergence of Tier Four and Tier Five Abyssal Creatures at most.
Even Legendary Demons were rare.
Although they were numerous.
The Elf Race’s power was still sufficient to easily handle them.
In every corner of the Elf Realm, many Demigod-level presences arose.
They all promptly rushed to the areas where the teleportation arrays erupted.
Among them was the Elf Race Goddess, Elinora.
At this moment, clothed in simple silk, the statuesque Elinora stood on a small wooden boat.
Her eyes carried a trace of doubt.
"So many Abyssal Teleportation Arrays? And they are all within the Elf Realm!"
"Moreover, we haven’t detected anything."
"This is exceedingly peculiar."
"Could it be those degenerate beings assisting the Abyss Demon Race?"
The degenerates she spoke of were naturally the Dark Elves.
As traitors of the Elf Race, they have recently been assisting the Demon Race in invading the Holy Spirit Realm.
Meanwhile.
From those purple teleportation arrays, a large number of demon figures began to surge forth.
Those figures were entirely blood red, with wings sprouting from their backs.
Looking at the beautiful Elf Realm, their eyes revealed a menacing intent!
"This... is the Holy Spirit Realm!"
"We finally got here!"
"Such a beautiful aura... and the air doesn’t have that scorching temperature."
"I really want to completely destroy this world..."
The demons made a mad declaration.
At this moment.
The Elf Race’s army had already arrived.
"Soldiers, follow me to fight!"
A white-armored Elf Knight rushed out first.
Behind him, the Elf Race’s army charged forward to engage.
The two sides instantly clashed.
"Bang!"
"Crash!
Monsters from the Abyss were slaughtered in swathes.
Before they could fly very far, they were surrounded and annihilated by the Elf soldiers.
Given this situation.
In less than half an hour, the Elf Race could quell this battle.
However, at this moment.
The Abyssal Teleportation Arrays continued to gush out a massive number of monsters!
"Pop! Bubble!"
Like a volcanic eruption.
Countless Abyssal Monsters frantically poured out from the teleportation arrays.
And the numbers far surpassed any previous event.
The Elf soldiers displayed expressions of surprise in their eyes.
Just then, the Elf captain continued to shout: "Reorganize ranks!"
"Soldiers, continue to fight with me!"
"Roar!"
The group of Elf soldiers reformed their ranks and engaged the enemy again.
At this time.
A terrifying figure suddenly squeezed out of the teleportation array.
The figure had skin entirely blood-red, with two horns on its forehead.
Even before appearing, the evil aura permeated the entire sky.
This was a Legendary Level Demon!
The Elf soldiers’ eyes showed a flicker of shock.
The Elf captain was the first to come back to his senses.
"Quickly notify Officer Moradon!"
Simultaneously.
From the teleportation arrays across the Elf Realm, multiple Legendary Level Demon figures emerged.
The war lasted for nearly a day.
Although, in the end, all these Legendary Demons were eliminated.
Through this event, the Elf Race sensed something unusual.
At this moment, a tall, sharp-eared female officer stood before the Elf King.
She reported the battle situation to the Elf King.
Though clad in white armor, it still couldn’t hide her statuesque figure.
"King, Legendary Level Demons have appeared in the Abyss Realm’s teleportation arrays this time."
"Should we quickly inform the other two major races about this?"
The Elf King, seated on the branch throne, frowned.
Worry also appeared in their eyes.
Because it was difficult to ensure that next time, there wouldn’t be Demigod-Level Demons.
By then, given the Abyss Realm’s terrifying power.
With only the Elf Race, it would be impossible to block them.
The Elf King sighed, "I understand, I will contact the Dwarf King and the Giant King."
"Juliana, you’ve worked hard, you may go and rest now."
"Yes."
The statuesque female Elf nodded and retreated respectfully.
Currently in the Broken Land.
Han Xing had just subdued the 572nd High-tier Legendary Level Thunder Beast.
A system prompt appeared.

[Thunderous Celestial Rhinoceros: High-tier Legendary Level Creature successfully formed a contract with you, Camp Fortune Value +0 (as your Camp Fortune Value is already maxed, there will be no further additions this time)]
Seeing the prompt, Han Xing was already unfazed.
A month ago.
He discovered this.
Once the Camp Fortune Value reached 100,000, which was a 100% increase in all attributes.
Subduing Legendary Level and even Demigod powerhouses wouldn’t further boost the Fortune Value.
Thinking about it, this was quite reasonable,
After all, with the number of powerhouses Han Xing had subdued, the Camp Fortune Value was close to 300,000.
If it could infinitely stack, it would mean a 300% boost for everyone.
That would be too outrageous!
However, even now, the 100% increase in all attributes across the camp was already terrifying enough.
Han Xing glanced at his own attributes.
[Name]: Han Xing, Witch Race Saint Master
[Profession]: Wild Ranger, Legend
[Level]: Level 58 (21%)
[Attributes]: Power 50732+50732, Agility 65784+65784, Spirit 48709+48709, Constitution 54892+54892.
[Divine Power Value]: 6216.
Extremely formidable attributes.
Compared to just after breaking through to Legend.
Han Xing’s single attribute had nearly doubled!
A high agility of 130,000, this was near what an average Middle-tier Demigod would have as an attribute.
"Damn, I feel terrifyingly strong!" Han Xing exclaimed excitedly.

"Crash!
Monsters from the Abyss were slaughtered in swathes.
Before they could fly very far, they were surrounded and annihilated by the Elf soldiers.
Given this situation.
In less than half an hour, the Elf Race could quell this battle.
However, at this moment.
The Abyssal Teleportation Arrays continued to gush out a massive number of monsters!
"Pop!
Bubble!"
Like a volcanic eruption.
Countless Abyssal Monsters frantically poured out from the teleportation arrays.
And the numbers far surpassed any previous event.
The Elf soldiers displayed expressions of surprise in their eyes.
Just then, the Elf captain continued to shout: "Reorganize ranks!"
"Soldiers, continue to fight with me!"
"Roar!"
The group of Elf soldiers reformed their ranks and engaged the enemy again.
At this time.
A terrifying figure suddenly squeezed out of the teleportation array.
The figure had skin entirely blood-red, with two horns on its forehead.
Even before appearing, the evil aura permeated the entire sky.
This was a Legendary Level Demon!
The Elf soldiers’ eyes showed a flicker of shock.
The Elf captain was the first to come back to his senses.
"Quickly notify Officer Moradon!"
Simultaneously.
From the teleportation arrays across the Elf Realm, multiple Legendary Level Demon figures emerged.
The war lasted for nearly a day.
Although, in the end, all these Legendary Demons were eliminated.
Through this event, the Elf Race sensed something unusual.
At this moment, a tall, sharp-eared female officer stood before the Elf King.
She reported the battle situation to the Elf King.
Though clad in white armor, it still couldn’t hide her statuesque figure.
"King, Legendary Level Demons have appeared in the Abyss Realm’s teleportation arrays this time."
"Should we quickly inform the other two major races about this?"
The Elf King, seated on the branch throne, frowned.
Worry also appeared in their eyes.
Because it was difficult to ensure that next time, there wouldn’t be Demigod-Level Demons.
By then, given the Abyss Realm’s terrifying power.
With only the Elf Race, it would be impossible to block them.
The Elf King sighed, "I understand, I will contact the Dwarf King and the Giant King."
"Juliana, you’ve worked hard, you may go and rest now."
"Yes."
The statuesque female Elf nodded and retreated respectfully.
Currently in the Broken Land.
Han Xing had just subdued the 572nd High-tier Legendary Level Thunder Beast.
A system prompt appeared.

[Thunderous Celestial Rhinoceros: High-tier Legendary Level Creature successfully formed a contract with you, Camp Fortune Value +0 (as your Camp Fortune Value is already maxed, there will be no further additions this time)]
Seeing the prompt, Han Xing was already unfazed.
A month ago.
He discovered this.
Once the Camp Fortune Value reached 100,000, which was a 100% increase in all attributes.
Subduing Legendary Level and even Demigod powerhouses wouldn’t further boost the Fortune Value.
Thinking about it, this was quite reasonable,
After all, with the number of powerhouses Han Xing had subdued, the Camp Fortune Value was close to 300,000.
If it could infinitely stack, it would mean a 300% boost for everyone.
That would be too outrageous!
However, even now, the 100% increase in all attributes across the camp was already terrifying enough.
Han Xing glanced at his own attributes.
[Name]: Han Xing, Witch Race Saint Master
[Profession]: Wild Ranger, Legend
[Level]: Level 58 (21%)
[Attributes]: Power 50732+50732, Agility 65784+65784, Spirit 48709+48709, Constitution 54892+54892.
[Divine Power Value]: 6216.
Extremely formidable attributes.
Compared to just after breaking through to Legend.
Han Xing’s single attribute had nearly doubled!
A high agility of 130,000, this was near what an average Middle-tier Demigod would have as an attribute.
"Damn, I feel terrifyingly strong!" Han Xing exclaimed excitedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 683 - 399: Trial of the Master of War Ghosts
paragraphs: At this moment, the other team members also came over.
Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "Brother Xing, I’ve leveled up to 58, and my power has officially broken through 70,000!"
"Now, I really dare to solo an initial-tier demigod!"
Shen Yun also said excitedly, "My spirit attribute and constitution have both broken through 80,000; withstanding an initial-tier demigod’s attack is no problem."
"Moreover, the boost I bring to all of you is even stronger."
Han Xing looked towards Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
Zhang Lianmeng softly said, "Let me see... my attributes."
Then, she exclaimed, "Wow! My spirit has actually broken through 100,000!"
Upon hearing this, everyone simultaneously turned their gaze to her.
"That high?" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise.
It should be noted that Zhang Lianmeng hasn’t switched to a hidden profession yet.
When leveling up, her attribute growth is one tier lower than everyone else’s.
And now, she’s broken through 100,000?
Almost just beneath Han Xing.
Zhang Lianmeng gently nodded, "It seems it’s because this time I consumed three Insect Mother Cores, directly increasing my spirit attribute by 15,000."
"Otherwise, my spirit attribute might just be a bit over 70,000."
Everyone nodded in understanding.
Then, they wore expressions of joy.
100,000 points of spirit attribute.
Coupled with Shen Yun’s blessing, it could even pose a fatal threat to a middle-tier demigod level expert!
Han Xing looked at Su Xiaoyang.
Su Xiaoyang said, "I also have over 80,000 agility now..."
Cheng Jianyong was stunned, "Damn, am I the lowest?"
"What’s going on?"
He slapped his thigh and excitedly said, "I remember now, you all have hidden professions, only Sister Lian Meng and I don’t!"
"But Sister Lian Meng has the Insect Mother Core and can soon switch to the supreme hidden profession, Elemental Law God!"
Speaking of this, Cheng Jianyong suddenly felt unbalanced.
"Damn! I also want to switch to a hidden profession!"
"Brother Xing, help Yongzi!"
This guy immediately lay on the ground, hugging Han Xing’s legs, refusing to let go.
Everyone couldn’t help but laugh.
Han Xing said, "Alright, if there’s an opportunity later, we’ll keep an eye out for you."
"Let’s see if we can find a hidden profession for warriors."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong’s resentful expression instantly disappeared.
Then, an ingratiating smile appeared as he said, "Thank you, Brother Xing!"
"I knew Brother Xing always treats me the best!"
"Get lost!" Han Xing jokingly scolded.
At this point, Han Xing glanced at the recently contracted Thunderous Celestial Rhinoceros.
Then he said, "Control this Sky Island to merge with my other contracted beasts."
"Then, I’ll provide you with a few demigod-level companions."
"Next, your task is to transport this piece of Amethyst Continent that I collected from the Broken Land."
During this period.
Han Xing could be said to have looted the entire periphery of the Broken Land.
Every Sky Island containing a mineral vein was merged by him and gathered together.
Now, it already has an area comparable to the Witch Race Continent.
One can imagine.
Such a large landmass, purely constructed from various mineral veins.
The mineral resources contained within are incredibly abundant.
If they could all be extracted.
Han Xing might be able to directly assemble thousands of catastrophe-level weapons: Tower of Annihilation Lightning!
Of course, extraction requires a vast amount of manpower and resources.
Even with the full strength of the Witch Race.
It would still take at least a decade, or even decades, to fully extract the resources of this Crystal Continent.
At this point.
The Thunderous Celestial Rhinoceros, upon receiving Han Xing’s command, respectfully began to execute it.
It carried the massive Crystal Continent beneath it, along with a group of high-tier legendary Thunder Element fierce beasts.
And five demigod-level fierce beasts.
Proceeding to the Witch Race Territory.
This force is powerful enough to traverse the entire Holy Spirit Realm without obstruction.
Moreover, even if they encounter unforeseen events.
Han Xing has built several teleportation arrays on top.
They can assist at any time.
Ensuring it is foolproof.
After digesting the gains from the periphery of the Broken Land.
Han Xing gazed into the depths of the Broken Land, saying, "Prepare yourselves; we’re entering the deeper parts of the Broken Land."
"The power of thunder inside is even greater, and we need to maintain our Divine Power Shields at all times, without letting up!
Upon hearing these words, everyone instantly became alert.
Then, Ten Thousand Stars City began rapidly advancing towards the depths of the Broken Land.
"Boom!"
"Crack!"
Along the way, terrifying thunderous sounds constantly reverberated.
With caution on their faces,
They continued to maintain their Divine Power Shields,
One hour later.
They had reached a deeper part of the ’Broken Land.’
The sky here had entirely turned from dark purple to black!
Each Thunder Strike was immensely thick.
As if divine retribution continually descended.
Moreover, the scariest part was the incredible density of these Thunder Strikes.
Reaching this point.
Even a high-tier legend, when struck by one of these Thunder Strikes, would be severely injured.
Han Xing and the others’ Divine Power Shields were also repeatedly shattered by the continuous bombardment!
But fortunately, there were five of them.
Each time they could bear the brunt calmly.
In this way.
Narrowly avoiding danger.
They proceeded another five hours.
By now, the sky of the Broken Land had become complete darkness.
However, Han Xing and his team’s vision remained excellent.
Because those divine-like Thunder Strikes were relentlessly falling from the sky.
Nearly nonstop!
Illuminating the entire sky.
This terrifying momentum.
Not to mention legends or even demigods, who wouldn’t last a few seconds before falling.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong and the others looked at Han Xing and asked, "Brother Xing, what do we do next?"
"It feels like just our Divine Power Shield’s strength won’t hold up for long before it shatters?"
Han Xing also furrowed his brows, seemingly pondering something.

chapters.title: Chapter 684 - 399: Trial of the Master of War Ghosts (Part 3)
paragraphs: At this time, Cheng Jianyong seemed to think of something.
He suddenly said, "Brother Xing, how about letting Xiaoyunzi go over?"
"Anyway, his defense is the strongest among us, and he has a divine artifact-level shield."
Shen Yun heard this and immediately rolled his eyes, saying, "Go away, you just wish for your brother to die, right?"
Cheng Jianyong retorted, "Come on, didn’t you say you can withstand the attack of a demigod?"
"These thunders, I think they can only hurt a typical demigod, they shouldn’t kill you."
Shen Yun said speechlessly, "One strike won’t kill me."
"But you also didn’t see the density of these thunders."
"Even with high defense, I can’t withstand the heavens striking me with five thunders!"
"I see."
Cheng Jianyong listened and nodded with an awkward smile.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly had an idea.
"These thunders should also belong to some kind of energy attack."
"I wonder if we can use the attack of the spiritual godslaying cannon to counteract them?"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up.
Han Xing acted immediately.
He operated three of the spiritual energy cannons, then fired a wave over!
Meanwhile.
A thunderbolt fell from the sky.
"Crack!"
This thunderbolt collided with the attack of the spiritual godslaying cannon.
Two completely different energies intertwined instantly, neutralizing each other.
Then, with a humming sound.
All attacks dissipated invisibly.
Everyone’s eyes immediately brightened.
Effective!
As expected, such elemental attacks are entities.
Unlike mental attacks, which are elusive and intangible.
This also means that we can use the same level or stronger power to neutralize the thunder strike from the sky!
Of course, this requires a significant test of Han Xing’s reaction.
At the moment the thunder strike falls.
To operate the spiritual godslaying cannon’s attack to neutralize it.
Han Xing was just about to crush through with the defense tower.
At this moment, he suddenly received a system notification.
[Holy Artifact Set detected: Master of Stars task has been triggered.]
Han Xing froze immediately, "Damn? Holy Artifact Set task?"
"Finally triggered?"
"What’s the task?"
Han Xing couldn’t help but ask.
[The Master of War Ghosts trial task has been activated.]

[Task Content]: Without relying on other forces (defense tower, equipment, pet, etc.), rely on physical power, within the Thunder Divine Format center, endure the baptism of thunder within a ten thousand meter area.
If the challenger is of legendary level, the baptism time is 10 seconds.
If the challenger is of demigod level, they must go to a deeper area, the baptism time is 60 seconds.
After the time ends, the trial task challenge is successful.
[Reward Item]: Holy Artifact - Master of War Ghosts Wrist Guard
Seeing this task introduction.
Han Xing instantly froze in place.
Then, he couldn’t help the twitch of his mouth.
Damn? Not kidding, right?
It’s fine to let me get struck by lightning!
But can’t even use the defense tower, or wear equipment?
Although he knows it’s very difficult to obtain the holy artifact set.
But this task, it’s too twisted.
The team members noticed Han Xing’s expression and asked what was happening.
Han Xing told them the task requirements.
Their eyes immediately showed a look of horror.
"What the heck, to complete the task, we must get struck by lightning and can’t wear equipment!"
"This is clearly sending Brother Xing to die," Cheng Jianyong complained.
Shen Yun beside him also shook his head and said, "Yes, Brother Xing, this task is too difficult."
"If I don’t wear equipment, I can’t withstand even two seconds."
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang’s eyes were full of worry, constantly shaking their heads.
They also strongly advised, Han Xing not to take on this task.
However, after thinking for a moment, Han Xing said, "We have to do this task.
"Holy Artifact Set is unique, each piece has terrifying attributes."
"Even if I rise to demigod, the task difficulty will increase."
"It’s better to complete this trial while I’m in near peak at legendary level."
"Besides, we can’t wait that long, we must take the Thunder Divine Format this time."
After hearing Han Xing’s words, everyone fell silent again.
Zhang Lianmeng said softly, "But, Brother Xing, this trial task is too dangerous."
"I don’t necessarily need that Thunder Divine Format, changing to a regular hidden profession is also powerful."
Shen Yun also echoed, "Yes, Brother Xing, let’s not do this task."
"This is not something a legendary level can complete!"
Han Xing shook his head, "Not necessarily."
"Shen Yun, your constitution is 80,000, right?"
Shen Yun nodded, "It’s 80,000, but if I don’t wear equipment, it might be less than 50,000."
Han Xing continued, "Then do you think, if you don’t wear equipment, you could withstand for a few seconds?"
Shen Yun pondered for a moment, "Probably two seconds, at the most not more than three."
Han Xing nodded, "I have 90,000 constitution points, without equipment it’s about 60,000."
"Then I should withstand for about 4 seconds."
"The remaining 6 seconds, I can rely on divine power value."
Everyone still had intense worries in their eyes.
Han Xing comforted, "Don’t worry, my divine power value is at least three times yours."
"I should be able to last longer than Shen Yun."
After hearing this, although their hearts were still filled with anxiety.
They no longer tried to dissuade him.
This trial task, although it sounds extremely twisted.
But since it’s Han Xing’s decision, everyone will support him.
Meanwhile, a system prompt appeared.
[Accept the Master of War Ghosts trial task?]
[After accepting the task, the challenge will begin in 30 seconds, if this challenge fails, the trial task disappears.]
Seeing this prompt, Han Xing frowned.
"Challenge fails and the task disappears?"
"So, I only have one chance?"

chapters.title: Chapter 685 - 400: Holy Artifact: Master of War Ghosts’ Wrist Guard
paragraphs: "Challenge failed, and the task disappears?"
"Does that mean I only have one chance?" Han Xing pondered.
But since things had come to this point, going back was no longer an option.
Because next, he had to take away the Thunder Divine Format.
By then, there would be no more Thunder Strike here.
Whether this task would reappear or not was uncertain.
So, no matter what.
Han Xing had to accept this task first.
So, he directly clicked to accept it.
The system prompt appeared.
[Successfully accepted the Master of War Ghosts’ trial task, the challenge will begin in 30 seconds, please be prepared.]
Han Xing took a deep breath.
Then he removed each piece of his equipment one by one.
From helmet to cloak, then to his shirt and pants.
All over his body, only a pair of pants remained.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, the two girls blushed red with embarrassment.
Especially Su Xiaoyang.
Ever since she was a child, it was the first time she had been this close.
To see a man bare-chested in front of her.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong could not help exclaiming twice, "Whoa, when did Brother Xing get such a good physique?"
"Wow, it’s making me drool!"
Shen Yun heard these words and immediately looked at him with horror, "Damn! So you have this kind of interest, I need to stay away from you."
Cheng Jianyong’s face stiffened; he knew his words could easily be misunderstood.
However, before he could explain.
Shen Yun already ran off into the distance.
Cheng Jianyong helplessly shrugged his shoulders, then turned his gaze back to Han Xing.
Compared to two years ago.
Back on Blue Star.
Han Xing’s body had undergone an earth-shattering transformation.
The lines of muscles all over his body were extremely clear, sharply defined.
Just slightly clenching his fists.
It was filled with a sense of explosive power!
Han Xing watched as the thirty-second countdown was about to end.
Three...
Two...
One...
Han Xing leaped.
Then he jumped directly into the area ahead, where lightning was striking constantly.
[Master of War Ghosts, trial task has begun...]
[Countdown: 10 seconds.]
At this moment.
Han Xing only felt the thunder element above his head start to gather wildly.
Then, without any pause, a terrifying Thunder Strike came crashing down.
"Boom!"
"Snap!"
A muffled sound echoed in everyone’s ears.
Han Xing’s eyes widened instantly, "Whoa, such speed?"
"There’s no time to react at all!"
No sooner had he spoken than a flash of lightning struck his head at an extremely fast speed.
At this moment.
Han Xing was directly electrocuted, his entire body twitching uncontrollably in the air.
Even his consciousness started to fragment.
He gritted his teeth, striving to resist the raging current within him.
Until after a brief moment, the current gradually dispersed.
Han Xing took a heavy breath.
The feeling of being struck by lightning was not pleasant.
Han Xing even saw that his body was emitting a wisp of white smoke.
But fortunately, he had managed to endure the attack of the first Thunder Strike.
Meanwhile.
On the system interface, the countdown reached the ninth second...
Han Xing sighed in relief, "Fortunately, the Thunder Strike’s attack is not too intense."
"With the strength of my flesh body, I should narrowly withstand it."
However, before he could be relieved for long.
The sky, with violent lightning as if gone mad, all came crashing down!
"Boom boom boom!"
At this moment, at least seven or eight flashes of lightning rumbled towards Han Xing.
"Oh... crap..."
Han Xing hardly hesitated at all.
He abandoned the idea of resisting the sky thunder with his flesh body.
He directly raised his Divine Power Shield.
"Buzz!"
Where lightning met the Divine Power Shield.
Each one had the power to heavily damage a Demigod.
The Divine Power Shield lasted less than half a second before it directly broke apart.
Then, the remaining lightning all struck Han Xing.
At this moment, Han Xing’s body began to tremble uncontrollably again!
Even wisps of black smoke began to appear from his body.
The team members looked at Han Xing worriedly.
Shen Yun was ready to step in and rescue him at any moment!
Yet at this moment, Han Xing took a deep breath and suddenly opened his eyes.
He seemed to have walked through the gates of hell, with his eyes showing a hint of fear.
"Second second... already this outrageous?" Han Xing asked incredulously.
This wave of attack, although he withstood it.
But likewise, Han Xing also suffered serious injuries.
Everyone looked at Han Xing with worry.
However, before they could speak.
They suddenly saw the terrifying thunder once again appearing in the sky.
"Boom boom boom!"
In an instant, the erupting electric light made the surrounding sky as bright as daylight.
And this time, over a dozen thunderbolts struck simultaneously!
The first wave of attack, a single thunderbolt, had already scorched Han Xing inside and out.
This time, so many thunderbolts could nearly heavily damage an average Demigod-level strong person.
More crucially, Han Xing had no equipment on him anymore.
Their eyes immediately filled with panic!
Cheng Jianyong shouted loudly, "Brother Xing, come back quickly!"
"Brother Han Xing!"
Su Xiaoyang exclaimed.
At this time, Shen Yun suddenly raised his shield high.
Without hesitation, he was about to rush up to take the blow for Han Xing.
But at that moment, Han Xing stopped Shen Yun: "Wait a moment."
The figure of Shen Yun rushing forward stopped mid-air.
Meanwhile, Han Xing once again gathered his breath, re-released the divine power, and raised his Divine Power Shield!
Everyone saw, this time.
The Divine Power Shield, facing the attacks of more than a dozen thunderbolts, surprisingly held on for a moment!
The power of the lightning was greatly diminished!
Falling on Han Xing, though once again causing his intense twitching!
Even black smoke surged from his whole body.
However, at this moment, Han Xing seemed to have discovered something, a hint of curiosity and a touch of joy in his eyes.
