chapters.title: Chapter 686 - 400: Holy Artifact - Master of War Ghosts’ Wrist Guard (2)
paragraphs: "The same level of divine power shield could withstand so many lightning attacks?"
"Could it be..."
To verify this guess in his heart.
After Han Xing endured the third wave of lightning attacks.
He still had everyone wait by the side.
The fourth second...
Lightning begins to gather once more.
Then, it fell straight down!
This time, the number of lightning bolts reached as many as twenty!
Even a demigod-level being would fall on the spot taking such a hit.
Let alone, Han Xing, who wasn’t wearing any equipment.
However, after experiencing the initial death crisis.
There was not much panic in Han Xing’s heart.
He fiercely braced the divine power shield.
Clearly, it was the same level of divine power shield.
But when faced with more than twenty lightning strikes.
This time, Han Xing held on even longer than before.
The moment the shield shattered.
The remaining lightning fell, its power was greatly weakened.
It landed on Han Xing, who used his body to forcibly withstand the remaining damage.
This scene left everyone puzzled.
However, Han Xing’s eyes showed a look of surprise!
He opened the system prompt panel and saw messages scrolling down.
[For unknown reasons, your divine power has undergone some special transformation, divine power strength increased by 1%]
[For unknown reasons, your divine power has undergone some special transformation, divine power strength increased by 2%]
Seeing the system prompts, Han Xing glanced at his divine power value.
It was still just over 6000, with no change in the numbers.
But Han Xing could clearly feel.
His divine power had undergone some kind of enhancement.
Or perhaps, some kind of metamorphosis?
He could feel that his divine power became more solid.
Just like the feeling when he faced the Dwarf King back then.
"Damn, so it’s like this..."
"Enduring the lightning attacks can cause my divine power values to undergo a kind of metamorphosis!"
"This kind of transformation cannot be put into words.
"It can’t even be reflected on the panel."
"To put it more mystically, it should be divine power thoroughly refined."
"With the same divine power value, I can unleash double, or even multiple times the effect!"
Han Xing finally understood what was happening to him.
Then came ecstasy!
"So, this so-called Master of War Ghosts trial."
"Though dangerous, it also contains great opportunity!"
"As long as I keep getting struck by lightning, my divine power value will continue to increase!"
Han Xing suddenly became excited.
"Come on, let more lightning strike me!"
"I’m already starving for it!"
As if in response to Han Xing’s call.
Heavy thunderclouds gathered once again in the sky.
"Boom!"
This time, more than thirty bolts of lightning struck down simultaneously!
Yet, Han Xing was unafraid.
He, with an excited expression, instantly condensed his divine power within.
Forming an entirely new divine power shield!
The team members looked on in shock at the changes in Han Xing’s divine power shield.
If before, Han Xing’s divine power was dark blue with a slight tinge of gold when released.
Now his divine power value was completely transforming into gold.
And each time he was struck by lightning.
The gold in his divine power shield became increasingly intense!
"Damn... a golden shield?" Cheng Jianyong was full of confusion.
Including the team members, their hearts were also filled with curiosity.
At this moment, after the divine power shield was shattered once more, Han Xing was thrashed by the lightning again.
But he remained unwavering, repeatedly regathering the divine power shield to withstand the lightning strikes.
After the seventh shield shattered and being struck by lightning.
Han Xing’s whole body had been charred black!
However, he didn’t feel terror.
Instead, he flashed a big bright smile, laughing heartily!
Because he felt within a short span of seven seconds!
His divine power strength had increased by a whole order!
Both the attached attack power and the defense strength of the divine power value doubled!
Moreover, this enhancement was lifelong.
In other words, no matter how much more divine power value Han Xing gains in the future.
He can always receive such amplification!
"This is awesome!"
Han Xing was beyond excited.
Indeed, risk and opportunity coexist.
If he didn’t take on this trial and let himself be struck by lightning.
Where would he find such a huge opportunity?
"Boom!"
A vortex of lightning had already formed in the sky.
Endless thunder elements were gathering within!
Now, the seventh second of the Master of War Ghosts trial had ended,
Last time, there were already sixty to seventy lightning bolts falling at once.
Next comes the eighth second!
It’s imaginable that this attack will be even more terrifying!
In a blink of an eye.
The thunderclouds in the sky did not delay.
It struck down directly!
This time, there were as many as a hundred!
The terrifying lightning illuminated the sky within ten thousand miles as bright as day.
At this level of attack, let alone a legend.
Even a middle-tier demigod-level powerhouse.
Would fall on the spot!
But Han Xing did not evade.
Instead, he raised a brand new divine power shield.
The team members saw that this divine power shield had completely turned gold!
An unparalleled sense of solidity appeared.
"Snap!"
Over a hundred lightning strikes hit the divine power shield, instantly forming web-like cracks.
In less than half a second, it was announced shattered.
However, these lightning bolts also had a great amount of their attack power weakened by the divine power shield.
Han Xing opened his arms wide, actively welcoming these lightning strikes!
A strong sense of paralysis reappeared, the intense sting made Han Xing shudder uncontrollably.
But in the end, he endured it.

chapters.title: Chapter 687 - 400: Holy Artifact: Wrist Guard of the Master of War Ghosts (3)
paragraphs: At the same time, Han Xing also felt.
His divine strength had increased significantly once again!
From the initial 100%, it had risen to 130%!
"Good, good, good, there are still two waves!"
"It should be able to raise my divine power intensity to 200%!"
Han Xing was elated.
Just then.
Everyone looked up.
Because they saw that the thunder vortex above their heads had vanished.
Faintly, a massive figure appeared.
The figure’s upper body was bare, covered with sword scars.
He held dual swords in his hands, long disheveled hair fluttering in the air.
This man, just by his silhouette, gave off a strong sense of oppression!
At this moment, he turned around.
Han Xing couldn’t see his face clearly.
He could only hear a low, dull hum.
Then, the giant raised his twin swords high and slashed down fiercely at Han Xing!
"Swish! Swish!"
Two sharp sword qi tore through space.
Shock appeared in everyone’s eyes.
Because they all felt a terrifying threat from these two sword qi!
Not to mention Han Xing was not wearing any equipment now.
Even in his prime, he might not withstand these two strikes!
Even Han Xing frowned slightly.
"Is the ninth-second trial this terrifying?"
"Something like this has already appeared."
Seeing the two sword qi approaching.
Han Xing directly raised his golden divine power shield.
"Buzz!"
The sword qi collided with the divine power shield.
The divine power shield, which could block hundreds of lightning bolts, could not hold on even for a moment.
It shattered immediately!
The two sword qi struck directly into Han Xing’s body.
"Swish! Swish!"
Blood spurted.
Panic appeared in the team members’ eyes!
"Brother Xing!"
"Han Xing brother!"
They were preparing to rush over.
But at this moment, Han Xing waved his hand, signaling everyone not to worry.
He looked at those two terrifying sword wounds on his body.
Still bleeding out.
Although his injuries looked terrifying.
But Han Xing knew he was not in any real danger.
With his current recovery ability.
He stopped the bleeding trend in an instant.
Han Xing said, "There’s one last attack, come on."
In the sky, that figure also focused on Han Xing, then nodded approvingly.
Then.
His entire figure disappeared from the spot.
As if he and the large sword in his hand had merged into one!
All that was left in the world were these two gleaming large swords!
Han Xing struggled to raise his divine power shield!
But this time, it didn’t even last a moment.
Directly shattered by these two swords!
The next moment.
The two swords fell on Han Xing.
The world fell silent...
In this area, even the thunder stopped appearing.
Everyone watched Han Xing suspended in mid-air, not moving for a long time.
Their eyes filled with worry and a bit of confusion.
Seconds later, Han Xing finally moved.
A layer of golden divine power shield appeared from his body.
An aura more formidable than the Dwarf King’s exploded from within Han Xing!
"Buzz!"
The world instantly became bright!
A system prompt sounded in Han Xing’s ear.
[Due to being blessed by the Master of War Ghosts, you have comprehended a certain Ultimate Secret Technique!]
[You have acquired the passive skill: All Things in the Forest!]
[All Things in the Forest]: Exclusive skill of the Master of War Ghosts, within your Divine Power Domain, renders enemies with divine power values lower than yours ineffective.
After releasing divine power, you are immune to the Power of Rules, and no creature can use the Power of Rules to obliterate you.
During attacks, you ignore the Power of Rules, dealing True Damage to enemies.
After reading this skill introduction, Han Xing fell into a long silent state.
Moments later, he slowly uttered a sentence: "Perverse!"
Indeed, this skill is truly perverse!
It is entirely aimed at the Divine Spirits, even True Gods!
As long as this passive skill is present, even if Han Xing faces Divine Spirits directly, it wouldn’t be the same as before.
There wouldn’t be cases of having his sight deprived or divine power suppressed.
As for the latter two effects, immunity to the Power of Rules’ obliteration and ignoring the Rules, dealing True Damage.
Han Xing is not entirely clear on their specific use right now.
His understanding of Divine Spirits is still quite lacking.
When combating the God of Tricks, he used a defense tower strategy.
It did not manage to test out the opponent’s methods completely.
Still, it’s not hard to see how powerful this newly acquired passive skill is.
Han Xing took a deep breath.
Then bowed to the sky.
He didn’t know which era the Master of War Ghosts belonged to.
But just at a glance.
Han Xing could tell that he was a notable man.
A true strongman who dared to wield a sword against Divine Spirits!
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.
[Successfully completed the trial mission of the Master of War Ghosts, received mission reward, Holy Artifact - Master of War Ghosts Bracelet.]
At this moment, a dawn light broke through the dark sky gradually.
A pair of wrist guards, looking like a mix of armor material and iron, descended from the sky.
From these wrist guards, the team felt an extremely sharp aura.
As if the two large swords of the Master of War Ghosts were presented before them!
Then, this pair of wrist guards floated directly in front of Han Xing.
Seeming to wait for him to reach out and take them.
At the same time.
Han Xing also saw the attributes of the wrist guards in front of him.
[Master of War Ghosts Wrist Guard lv60, Quality: Holy Artifact, Power +8000, Agility +8000]

[Attached Effect]: War Soul (increases Physical Attack strength by 40%), Frenzy (increases Attack Speed by 40%), Soul Fury (Legendary Effect, sacrificing 1000 points of Spirit, increases Power and Agility by 1000 points, limited usage: 10 times), Soul Connection (Divine-level Effect, establishes a connection between the Survivor and the enemy, absorbing the opponent’s divine power value when attacking.)
[Blade of Judgment]: Exclusive effect of Holy Artifacts, imposes Judgment Mark effect on enemies with divine power values lower than yours!

As long as this passive skill is present, even if Han Xing faces Divine Spirits directly, it wouldn’t be the same as before.
There wouldn’t be cases of having his sight deprived or divine power suppressed.
As for the latter two effects, immunity to the Power of Rules’ obliteration and ignoring the Rules, dealing True Damage.
Han Xing is not entirely clear on their specific use right now.
His understanding of Divine Spirits is still quite lacking.
When combating the God of Tricks, he used a defense tower strategy.
It did not manage to test out the opponent’s methods completely.
Still, it’s not hard to see how powerful this newly acquired passive skill is.
Han Xing took a deep breath.
Then bowed to the sky.
He didn’t know which era the Master of War Ghosts belonged to.
But just at a glance.
Han Xing could tell that he was a notable man.
A true strongman who dared to wield a sword against Divine Spirits!
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.
[Successfully completed the trial mission of the Master of War Ghosts, received mission reward, Holy Artifact - Master of War Ghosts Bracelet.]
At this moment, a dawn light broke through the dark sky gradually.
A pair of wrist guards, looking like a mix of armor material and iron, descended from the sky.
From these wrist guards, the team felt an extremely sharp aura.
As if the two large swords of the Master of War Ghosts were presented before them!
Then, this pair of wrist guards floated directly in front of Han Xing.
Seeming to wait for him to reach out and take them.
At the same time.
Han Xing also saw the attributes of the wrist guards in front of him.
[Master of War Ghosts Wrist Guard lv60, Quality: Holy Artifact, Power +8000, Agility +8000]

[Attached Effect]: War Soul (increases Physical Attack strength by 40%), Frenzy (increases Attack Speed by 40%), Soul Fury (Legendary Effect, sacrificing 1000 points of Spirit, increases Power and Agility by 1000 points, limited usage: 10 times), Soul Connection (Divine-level Effect, establishes a connection between the Survivor and the enemy, absorbing the opponent’s divine power value when attacking.)
[Blade of Judgment]: Exclusive effect of Holy Artifacts, imposes Judgment Mark effect on enemies with divine power values lower than yours!

chapters.title: Chapter 688 - 401: The Third Divine Format, Heading to the Sea of Light
paragraphs: [Blade of Judgment]: Exclusive effect of the Holy Artifact, marks enemies with Divine Power Values lower than one’s own with a judgment mark! Reduces all attributes of the target by 20% and allows one to sense their location (no matter the distance). This mark effect is permanent, with a maximum mark capacity: 10 people.

Note: Part of the Sacred Artifact Set, can be combined with [Supreme Star Country Armor], [Magic Mist Forged Heart Lower Armor], [Decaying Dream Traveler’s Cloak], [Galaxy Dream-Casting Necklace], [Ring of the Master of Illusions] to form the [Master of Stars Set].
"Wow, it truly is a piece of Sacred Artifact Equipment!"
"This is just too insane."
Han Xing was utterly shocked.
The previous few effects could greatly enhance Han Xing’s Attack Power and combat capabilities.
That divine-level effect could even link to an enemy and directly absorb their Divine Power Values.
It’s practically a plus version of a Coal Ball!
However, what intrigued Han Xing the most was the exclusive effect of the Holy Artifact.
It could actually mark enemies and sense their position.
Han Xing said with great interest, "Interesting, this effect would be excellent for tracking down enemies."
"With this, no matter where they run, I can sense them!"
At this moment, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong also came over.
They looked at Han Xing with excitement.
The teammates noticed that Han Xing’s demeanor had subtly changed.
It was even more solidified than the kingly aura of the Dwarf King.
Cheng Jianyong praised, "Who would’ve thought, Brother Xing, after being struck by lightning, would undergo such a transformation."
"If I had known, I would have gone to get struck a few times too."
After hearing this, everyone rolled their eyes at him.
"If you’re planning to get struck by lightning, the first strike would take you away immediately!"
"The kind of enhancement Brother Xing experienced isn’t something an average person can achieve."
Cheng Jianyong didn’t retort Shen Yun this time.
He, too, understood that Shen Yun had a point.
Those lightning attacks are not something just anyone could withstand.
Han Xing, at this point, had already donned his equipment once again.
He smiled and said, "Let’s go, we can now head to the central area to retrieve that Thunder Divine Format.
Upon hearing this, everyone excitedly clenched their fists.
Ever since Han Xing learned that the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon attacks could negate the lightning in the sky, this place no longer posed any danger to them.
All they needed was to fire the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon at the moment the lightning struck.
Of course, this would test Han Xing’s reaction ability.
However, Han Xing’s Divine Power Value had already transformed.
Similarly, his reaction speed was now unmatched.
The previously fleeting lightning attacks.
Now in Han Xing’s eyes, he could even catch the trajectory of their movements.
As if he had entered a unique perspective.
Everything in his view became incredibly slow.
"Boom!"
Waves of thunder crashed down from the sky.
But Han Xing intercepted them in advance.
And with impeccable precision.
Not a single one missed.
A few minutes later.
They easily arrived at the center of the ’Broken Land,’ a 5,000-meter region.
A familiar system prompt appeared.
[Target detected, undergoing identity verification.]
[Race: Human Race (conforming), Power: Legend (conforming), lifting thunder seal...]
Everyone reached the center of the Broken Land.
Ever since this Thunder Divine Format appeared, no creature had set foot in the center of the Broken Land for over ten thousand years.
Today, Han Xing and his team were the first strong ones to enter.
Meanwhile, everyone also saw.
The dark purple rhombic crystal floating in midair.
Before them appeared the attributes of this Divine Format.
[Elemental Divine King’s Seven Attributes Divine Format·Thunder]: Special Item. (Can achieve different effects through various methods of use.)

[Effect 1]: The Legendary Professional, by absorbing the divine power contained within the Divine Format, can greatly enhance their Divine Power Value, with an increase range of 6000~8000. (After absorption, the Divine Format shatters.)

[Effect 2]: A Mage Profession reaching Level 60, upon using this Divine Format, will automatically advance to the hidden profession: God of Thunder. (Using the Divine Format for advancement will not reduce levels.)

[Effect 3]: Collect the remaining six Elemental Divine Formats to advance to the Supreme Hidden Profession: Elemental Divine King. (The other six Elemental Divine Formats are: Ice, Fire, Light, Dark, Earth, Wind.)
"The third one!" Han Xing said with a smile on his face.
Everyone, too, felt invigorated in their hearts!
One step closer to collecting all seven Divine Formats and becoming the Elemental Divine King.
After Zhang Lianmeng stepped forward to collect it.
Han Xing excitedly said, "Let’s go, to the next place."
"Sea of Light!"
Upon hearing this name, everyone was somewhat surprised.
Because they all knew, this place was the region where the Bright Divine Son resided.
As for the Bright Divine Son.
Since that relic expedition, they hadn’t contacted him again.
Moreover, in the relic, their interactions weren’t exactly pleasant.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong worriedly said, "Brother Xing, won’t Neotos spill our secrets?"
The secrets Cheng Jianyong referred to naturally involved Han Xing’s godslaying methods.
In the relic, everyone knew it was Han Xing who took down the Insect Mother.
Although, back then, Neotos promised to keep the secret.
But everyone understood, those guys only reluctantly agreed to ensure their survival at the time.
There’s a chance they might sell Han Xing out later.
Han Xing laughed, "It doesn’t matter if he spills the beans,"
"After all, the fact that we possess godslaying methods isn’t a big secret."

chapters.title: Chapter 689 - 401: The Third Divine Format, Heading to the Sea of Light
paragraphs: "Even if the Bright Divine Son doesn’t say anything, I estimate that the Sea of Light over there also knows our strength."
Cheng Jianyong was taken aback, "Huh? Why?"
Han Xing explained, "The last time we fought with the God of Tricks, it attracted many ancient entities to descend."
"They told me not to kill the trickster, but I scolded them away."
"And at that time, I sensed that one of the entities was specifically erupting from the location of the Sea of Light."
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun immediately understood something.
"Brother Xing, are you saying there’s a true divine spirit in the Sea of Light?"
Han Xing nodded, "Most likely, yes."
Upon hearing this, everyone frowned.
The power of the divine spirit is too powerful and too unpredictable.
Even understanding just the control of rules, they haven’t figured out its specific function yet.
Even though Han Xing now possesses the power to slay gods, he cannot afford to be careless.
Han Xing also noticed the worry in everyone’s hearts and said, "There’s no need to worry too much."
"This entity, I estimate, is also like other divine spirits, restricted by the Holy Spirit Realm’s power."
"Otherwise, it would have attacked me last time."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s explanation, everyone felt much more at ease.
Moreover, they also knew that compared to the battle with the God of Tricks, Han Xing’s strength had greatly increased.
The means to deal with divine spirits had increased by more than one.
If the divine spirit in the Sea of Light stays quiet, it would be fine.
If it doesn’t and tries to make a move against Han Xing,
Then Han Xing wouldn’t mind employing some measures to utterly obliterate that divine spirit!
Ten Thousand Stars City began to continue moving forward.
This time, it was towards the Sea of Light five million kilometers away.
Eight days later.
An island in the sky floated in the air.
It was Han Xing and his group.
From afar, Han Xing saw a bright expanse ahead.
A system prompt appeared.
[You have arrived at a new region: Sea of Light, world influence +73, legendary points +5]
"This is the Sea of Light."
"After crossing the Sea of Light, it’s the Realm of Darkness."
"These two places are not far apart, each with a divine format."
"Thus, after finishing what we need to do in the Sea of Light, our next stop is the Realm of Darkness."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s words, everyone nodded in realization.
Shen Yun calculated in his mind, then was surprised and said, "Then this way, wouldn’t we have collected 5 divine formats?"
"Next, there’s only the Earth Element and Wind Element divine formats left!"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
Excited expressions appeared on everyone’s faces.
The difficulty of this collection task is imaginable.
Throughout the Holy Spirit Realm, apart from Han Xing and his group, possibly no one else could complete it.
Firstly, because the places where these divine formats are located are extremely terrifying, and secondly, because these divine formats only recognize the identity of the Human Race.
Similarly, once completed, the rewards are also incredibly great.
Seeing that the goal is getting closer.
They now only have the Earth and Wind divine formats left to collect.
And Han Xing knows the locations of these two divine formats.
They are located at Crystal Mountain and Silent Wind Islands.
It can be said that this divine format collection journey has covered almost half of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Along the way, they have also gained various fortuitous opportunities.
It’s been quite a worthwhile adventure.
At this time, Shen Yun looked at the bright light ahead and asked puzzledly.
"Ever since we got close to the Sea of Light, we haven’t seen nighttime for three consecutive days."
"Is this place permanently without night?"
Han Xing nodded.
Shen Yun’s speculation was correct.
The Sea of Light is perpetually shrouded in the Power of Light, and the concept of night doesn’t exist.
In stark contrast, the nearby Realm of Darkness is forever without day.
Besides the characteristic of never seeing night.
The Sea of Light region rarely has islands in the sky.
The surroundings are filled with dense Power of Light.
And as they venture deeper, this Power of Light is about to solidify.
From afar, Han Xing and his group saw a group of humanoid-shaped creatures with golden bodies floating past in front.
These creatures seem to merge entirely with the environment of the Sea of Light.
If not for their two pitch-black eyes, the group might overlook their existence completely.
"What are these, they look so unique?"
Cheng Jianyong asked curiously.
Han Xing replied, "Didn’t you see them before?"
Cheng Jianyong was puzzled, "I saw them?"
Han Xing nodded, "It’s like the Bright Divine Son."
"They, like the Bright Divine Son, are a type of energy-based creature."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded in realization.
So, this is the creature of the Sea of Light, and they’ve evolved into quite a sizeable group.
At the same time, Han Xing’s view also showed the attributes of these creatures.
[Light Energy Body]: Four-star Elite Level
[Level]: Level 47.
[Attributes]: Power 2746, Agility 2894, Spirit 3367, Constitution 3214.
[Skills]: Body of Light, Light Escape!
Note: Born from the light, a unique energy life.
At this moment, those Light Energy Bodies seemed to notice Han Xing and his group.
Before anyone said anything,
Those energy bodies appeared to see something terrifying and instantly transformed into a stream of light, escaping.
Their bursting speed even surpassed that of leaders of the same level.
Seeing this scene, Cheng Jianyong suddenly laughed, "Hahaha, Brother Xing was spot on."
"These guys really are like the Bright Divine Son."
"Their escape speed is ridiculously fast!"
After hearing this, the group seemed to have thought of something, then laughed together.

chapters.title: Chapter 690 - 401: The Third Divine Format, Heading for the Sea of Light (Part 3)
paragraphs: Han Xing shook his head and said, "Let’s go, we will now head directly to the deepest part of the Sea of Light."
With that, Ten Thousand Stars City moved directly towards the brightest area.
Along the way.
They encountered a large number of Light Energy Beings.
These creatures were like schools of fish living in the ocean; even Energy Bodies at level 1 could fly freely in the air.
However, upon seeing Han Xing’s Sky Island, they acted like schools of fish encountering a shark.
Frightened, they scattered in all directions.
The group was a bit puzzled, not knowing why these Energy Bodies reacted this way.
But they didn’t pay it much attention.
At this moment, Han Xing nodded and said, "No wonder this place is called the Sea of Light."
"The environment here really does feel like the depths of an ocean."
Meanwhile.
The news of a Sky Island entering the Sea of Light quickly reached the ears of its most powerful beings.
Moreover, when they heard that there were a few Humans on that Sky Island.
Numerous Light Energy Beings spread the word frantically.
"Run! The vicious Humans are attacking!"
"Oh no, quickly, go tell the Lord of Light this news!"
"What should we do, what should we do? Is it still too late for me to escape now?"
The entire Sea of Light fell into a state of chaos.
All Soldiers of Light were urgently summoned for a prewar mobilization.
Their Defense Towers all entered a war state.
The reason for this situation.
Was because for nearly a month, the entire Holy Spirit Realm knew of the war between the Ogre Race and the Human Race.
And they also knew.
After that war, the Ogre Race was completely defeated!
The Human Race, or rather the Witch Race, declared a great victory!
However, if it was merely about defeating the Ogre Race, it wouldn’t be a big deal.
But the beings of the Holy Spirit Realm knew.
This time, the Ogre Race had prepared an extremely formidable force, a desperate gamble!
Before heading to the Witch Race Territory, most races in the Holy Spirit Realm received news.
The Ogre Race somehow managed.
To bring forth numerous Middle-tier and High-tier Legends.
Among them, there were even several Demigod Level Ogres.
This was an incredibly formidable force.
Among the races of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Other than the three major races, and the mysterious Giant Dragon Race.
No other race dared claim they could surely defeat the Ogre Race in this state.
In fact, they might even be conquered by that group of Ogres.
However, despite the support of so many powerhouses.
The Ogre Race was still defeated!
Moreover, more terrifyingly.
None of the strong members of the Ogre Race survived.
So many Legends and Demigods were all slaughtered to the last one.
Not even a single Ogre soldier was spared.
And this wasn’t the end.
After the slaughter, the Master of the Human Race continued to give orders.
To utterly destroy the Ogre Race.
Sending the Witch Race army to eliminate the remaining Ogres.
Aiming to completely eradicate the Ogre Race from the Holy Spirit Realm.
Everyone couldn’t help but feel fear towards this Master of the Human Race’s cold-blooded nature.
And those Ogres, terrified, abandoned their homes at the first sign, fleeing throughout the Holy Spirit Realm.
Some even tried to seek shelter from other races.
Hoping to leave behind at least some spark of the Ogre Race.
However, the Master of the Human Race proclaimed.
Within the Holy Spirit Realm, any race that dared to accept the Ogres.
He would not hesitate to initiate a Tribal War against them.
Hoping the races considering offering sanctuary to the Ogres would think it through.
With the Ogre Race’s example as a lesson.
No race in the Holy Spirit Realm now dared to accept them.
With nowhere else to go, the Ogres could only wander throughout the Holy Spirit Realm.
High Priest Xiao led an army to hunt down the fleeing Ogres everywhere.
Determined to root them out completely.
This ruthless approach made people from other races shiver with fear.
Now, Han Xing’s appearance, and any information that could be investigated, had spread throughout the powerhouses’ circles in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Fearing they might provoke this God of Slaughter.
As for those beings below the Fifth Transformation.
They only knew that a brutal Monarch had emerged from the Human Race.
Who slaughtered tens of billions from the Ogre Race.
So when those Light Energy Bodies saw Han Xing and his group, they would flee immediately in fear.
At this moment.
In the depths of the Sea of Light.
Several Energy Beings with overwhelming auras gathered together.
They all possessed Legendary Level power.
Even the Son of Light was present.
The high-ranking members of the Sea of Light initiated an Emergency Meeting.
Discussing matters concerning Han Xing and his party.
In the center, a Demigod Level Light Energy Body spoke.
"Ladies and gentlemen, with the sudden arrival of the Master of the Human Race in our Sea of Light area, what do you think we should do?"
Below, the gathered powerhouses all furrowed their brows.
Regarding the Human Race, no one dared to make a hasty decision.
However, the Demigod Level powerhouse began to grow anxious: "Everyone, quickly come up with a plan."
"That one is about to reach the central area of the Sea of Light."
"We can still pretend not to see him now, but once he’s here, we can’t keep pretending to be blind!"
"Should we send someone over to welcome them, or expel them directly, please give me an answer soon."
The other powerhouses also felt immense psychological pressure.
At this moment, a Legendary Level powerhouse spoke up: "Monarch, how about we send someone to welcome him now?"
"There’s an old Human saying, that you don’t hit a smiling face."
"When the time comes, we can hold a welcoming ceremony for him, maybe then he won’t trouble us."
His words were immediately refuted by another Legendary powerhouse.
"I don’t think it’s wise."
"What if those Humans came just to cause trouble for us?"
"Sending someone over now would be like walking into the tiger’s mouth."
"My suggestion is to not let them approach the depths of the Sea of Light."
"Otherwise, if they suddenly launch an attack, we’ll be very passive."
The other powerhouses nodded, agreeing with the reasoning.
However, yet another Legendary powerhouse suddenly argued, "I think it’s inappropriate!"

sentences.text: Han Xing shook his head and said, "Let’s go, we will now head directly to the deepest part of the Sea of Light."
With that, Ten Thousand Stars City moved directly towards the brightest area.
Along the way.
They encountered a large number of Light Energy Beings.
These creatures were like schools of fish living in the ocean; even Energy Bodies at level 1 could fly freely in the air.
However, upon seeing Han Xing’s Sky Island, they acted like schools of fish encountering a shark.
Frightened, they scattered in all directions.
The group was a bit puzzled, not knowing why these Energy Bodies reacted this way.
But they didn’t pay it much attention.
At this moment, Han Xing nodded and said, "No wonder this place is called the Sea of Light."
"The environment here really does feel like the depths of an ocean."
Meanwhile.
The news of a Sky Island entering the Sea of Light quickly reached the ears of its most powerful beings.
Moreover, when they heard that there were a few Humans on that Sky Island.
Numerous Light Energy Beings spread the word frantically.
"Run!
The vicious Humans are attacking!"
"Oh no, quickly, go tell the Lord of Light this news!"
"What should we do, what should we do?
Is it still too late for me to escape now?"
The entire Sea of Light fell into a state of chaos.
All Soldiers of Light were urgently summoned for a prewar mobilization.
Their Defense Towers all entered a war state.
The reason for this situation.
Was because for nearly a month, the entire Holy Spirit Realm knew of the war between the Ogre Race and the Human Race.
And they also knew.
After that war, the Ogre Race was completely defeated!
The Human Race, or rather the Witch Race, declared a great victory!
However, if it was merely about defeating the Ogre Race, it wouldn’t be a big deal.
But the beings of the Holy Spirit Realm knew.
This time, the Ogre Race had prepared an extremely formidable force, a desperate gamble!
Before heading to the Witch Race Territory, most races in the Holy Spirit Realm received news.
The Ogre Race somehow managed.
To bring forth numerous Middle-tier and High-tier Legends.
Among them, there were even several Demigod Level Ogres.
This was an incredibly formidable force.
Among the races of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Other than the three major races, and the mysterious Giant Dragon Race.
No other race dared claim they could surely defeat the Ogre Race in this state.
In fact, they might even be conquered by that group of Ogres.
However, despite the support of so many powerhouses.
The Ogre Race was still defeated!
Moreover, more terrifyingly.
None of the strong members of the Ogre Race survived.
So many Legends and Demigods were all slaughtered to the last one.
Not even a single Ogre soldier was spared.
And this wasn’t the end.
After the slaughter, the Master of the Human Race continued to give orders.
To utterly destroy the Ogre Race.
Sending the Witch Race army to eliminate the remaining Ogres.
Aiming to completely eradicate the Ogre Race from the Holy Spirit Realm.
Everyone couldn’t help but feel fear towards this Master of the Human Race’s cold-blooded nature.
And those Ogres, terrified, abandoned their homes at the first sign, fleeing throughout the Holy Spirit Realm.
Some even tried to seek shelter from other races.
Hoping to leave behind at least some spark of the Ogre Race.
However, the Master of the Human Race proclaimed.
Within the Holy Spirit Realm, any race that dared to accept the Ogres.
He would not hesitate to initiate a Tribal War against them.
Hoping the races considering offering sanctuary to the Ogres would think it through.
With the Ogre Race’s example as a lesson.
No race in the Holy Spirit Realm now dared to accept them.
With nowhere else to go, the Ogres could only wander throughout the Holy Spirit Realm.
High Priest Xiao led an army to hunt down the fleeing Ogres everywhere.
Determined to root them out completely.
This ruthless approach made people from other races shiver with fear.
Now, Han Xing’s appearance, and any information that could be investigated, had spread throughout the powerhouses’ circles in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Fearing they might provoke this God of Slaughter.
As for those beings below the Fifth Transformation.
They only knew that a brutal Monarch had emerged from the Human Race.
Who slaughtered tens of billions from the Ogre Race.
So when those Light Energy Bodies saw Han Xing and his group, they would flee immediately in fear.
At this moment.
In the depths of the Sea of Light.
Several Energy Beings with overwhelming auras gathered together.
They all possessed Legendary Level power.
Even the Son of Light was present.
The high-ranking members of the Sea of Light initiated an Emergency Meeting.
Discussing matters concerning Han Xing and his party.
In the center, a Demigod Level Light Energy Body spoke.
"Ladies and gentlemen, with the sudden arrival of the Master of the Human Race in our Sea of Light area, what do you think we should do?"
Below, the gathered powerhouses all furrowed their brows.
Regarding the Human Race, no one dared to make a hasty decision.
However, the Demigod Level powerhouse began to grow anxious: "Everyone, quickly come up with a plan."
"That one is about to reach the central area of the Sea of Light."
"We can still pretend not to see him now, but once he’s here, we can’t keep pretending to be blind!"
"Should we send someone over to welcome them, or expel them directly, please give me an answer soon."
The other powerhouses also felt immense psychological pressure.
At this moment, a Legendary Level powerhouse spoke up: "Monarch, how about we send someone to welcome him now?"
"There’s an old Human saying, that you don’t hit a smiling face."
"When the time comes, we can hold a welcoming ceremony for him, maybe then he won’t trouble us."
His words were immediately refuted by another Legendary powerhouse.
"I don’t think it’s wise."
"What if those Humans came just to cause trouble for us?"
"Sending someone over now would be like walking into the tiger’s mouth."
"My suggestion is to not let them approach the depths of the Sea of Light."
"Otherwise, if they suddenly launch an attack, we’ll be very passive."
The other powerhouses nodded, agreeing with the reasoning.
However, yet another Legendary powerhouse suddenly argued, "I think it’s inappropriate!"

chapters.title: Chapter 691 - 402: Let Those Who Can Decide Step Forward
paragraphs: At this moment, another legendary powerhouse from the Sea of Light suddenly retorted, "I believe it’s not possible!"
"Acting rashly might provoke the master of the Human Race."
"Then, it might just give the other side a reason to make trouble."
After this legendary powerhouse finished speaking, the others also found it reasonable.
For a moment, the situation once again fell into a stalemate.
At this moment, another powerhouse spoke up, "The key is, we don’t know why that person from the Human Race came."
"Moreover, this group of the Human Race came to our Sea of Light territory without any notice,"
"Isn’t this kind of against the rules established by the three major races?"
However, a legendary level powerhouse beside him sneered, "Then you go tell the three major races, see if anyone will care about you."
"You need to know, the rules are meant to constrain forces like us."
"For an existence like the master of the Human Race, so powerful and unreasonable, do you think these rules can limit him?"
This legendary level powerhouse also felt it made sense after hearing this.
Then, the group of powerhouses helplessly expressed that they couldn’t make up their minds.
The demigod-level powerhouse sitting in the center sighed.
He didn’t expect that because of the arrival of one person from the Human Race,
the mighty Sea of Light was completely caught off guard.
It’s really because what that person from the Human Race has done is too shocking.
Moreover, recently even the Lord of Light, who has been sleeping,
also sent him a message some time ago.
Advising them not to interact with the Human Race or provoke them recently.
He didn’t know why that mysterious Lord of Light suddenly conveyed such a message to him.
But he did sense something unusual from this message.
The Lord of Light seems a bit afraid of that person from the Human Race...
Thinking of this, he felt even more uncertain.
"Forget it, I’d better go myself first and test the waters with these humans."
"See what exactly they want."
As soon as this demigod-level powerhouse finished speaking, it immediately drew opposition from the other powerhouses.
"Monarch, you mustn’t!"
"If you go now and they suddenly attack, you’ll be walking right into a trap!"
"Yes, Monarch!"
Those legendary level powerhouses strongly dissuaded him.
Then, this demigod glanced at them and said, "Then should we all not go and wait for that person from the Human Race to come to us?"
Hearing this, they fell silent again.
The demigod chuckled, "You guys are the ones who have tarnished the reputation of our Sea of Light."
"Now everyone knows, apart from running away, our Sea of Light’s legends have no other skills."
The group of legends stood there speechless, feeling somewhat embarrassed.
At this time, the Bright Divine Son said, "Uncle, I’ll accompany you over."
Upon hearing this, the demigod’s eyes showed a look of relief.
But he still shook his head and said, "Neotos, you are the hope of our Sea of Light."
"For nearly a thousand years, you are also the Divine Son with the strongest talent."
"I’ll handle this kind of risky matter myself."
If Han Xing were here, he would undoubtedly burst into laughter.
Damn it, what do these guys think of me?
A man-eating tiger?
Why is meeting me such a big deal, like going to the guillotine?
Neotos seemed to want to say something at this moment.
But he was interrupted by the demigod saying, "Neotos, there’s no need to say more."
"There’s not just one king in the Sea of Light."
"But there’s only one Divine Son, which is you."
"Now, go inform the other monarchs, in case of an emergency."
"Wake up... the Lord of Light first."
Upon hearing the words ’Lord of Light’,
all the legendary powerhouses present felt a shiver run through their bodies.
Neotos thought for a moment, then nodded, "Understood, Uncle.
The demigod nodded.
Then disappeared from the scene.
All the legendary level powerhouses present began to wait tensely.
Meanwhile, Han Xing was still controlling the Ten Thousand Stars City floating around.
The group grew increasingly curious.
As they penetrated further into the Sea of Light, they encountered fewer Light Energy Bodies.
It was as if they had somehow been forewarned about Han Xing and his group’s arrival and hid in advance.
Cheng Jianyong asked suspiciously, "Brother Xing, what are these guys up to?"
"Why does it feel like they’re deliberately avoiding us?"
Han Xing shook his head.
"I don’t know."
"But we don’t need to worry about them."
"Once we reach the central area of the Sea of Light, even if they want to hide, they can’t."
The group nodded in agreement.
Shen Yun said worryingly, "Brother Xing, what if the folks from the Sea of Light refuse to give us the Light Divine Format, just like those Stone Men from the Flame Plateau?"
"Do we forcibly take it then?"
This was indeed what everyone was worried about.
After all, unlike the Flame Plateau, which only had one demigod-level powerhouse,
the Sea of Light had been confirmed by Han Xing to harbor Divine Spirit level beings.
If force was truly used, and it sparked a war,
not only would the Human Race’s reputation in the Holy Spirit Realm suffer,
but the group might also face a tough battle.
Han Xing furrowed his brow, pondered for a moment, and then said, "Let’s first see the attitude of the Sea of Light."
"If they are willing to negotiate and give up the Light Divine Format, we can pay an appropriate price."
"But if they refuse to cooperate, then I’ll have to resort to some coercive measures."
The team members took this as Han Xing’s firm stance.
The Light Divine Format was something he was determined to obtain, and no one could stop him.
Even if it meant going to war, it didn’t matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 692 - 402: Let Those Who Can Decide Step Forward
paragraphs: The presence of a Divine Spirit Level being, Han Xing is no longer afraid of.
As for the reputation of the Human Race?
What’s the use of that?
Once those prominent races know, Han Xing not only possesses the power to annihilate the Ogre Race,
but also holds the strength to slay gods,
who would dare say more?
With this in mind, the team members were already prepared for battle.
At this moment, a stream of light flew towards them from the front.
Its speed was extremely fast, crossing thousands of kilometers in the blink of an eye.
From this aura, Han Xing sensed a King Level presence.
But compared to the Dwarf King, it was not just a class below.
Let alone compared to Han Xing who had experienced the trials of tribulation.
"Someone from the Sea of Light is coming, seems to be a demigod?" Shen Yun mused.
Han Xing nodded slightly, "Yes, I don’t sense a killing intent from him."
"Let’s talk first a bit."
Seconds later.
A Light Energy Body stopped in front of Han Xing.
Then, it transformed into a humanoid form.
At this time, the attributes of this energy body also appeared before Han Xing.
[Light Energy Body: Isley Alasad (Middle-tier Demigod)]
[Level]: 65
[Attributes]: Power 138921, Agility 152334, Spirit 142342, Constitution 123513
[Skills]: Light Body, Light’s Judgment, Feather of Light, Brilliant Force Field (Legendary Skills), Ultimate Skill - Saintly Radiance End!
As Han Xing sensed, this was a strong individual of Middle-tier Demigod Level.
After seeing Han Xing, the other party did not put on the airs of a demigod.
Instead, he laughed and asked, "Friends of the Human Race, what brings you to our Sea of Light?"
Before Han Xing could open his mouth.
The other continued, "Master of the Human Race, coming from afar, we apologize for the lack of hospitality from the Sea of Light!"
"We have prepared a welcoming ceremony for you all, and invite the Master of the Human Race to rest in the main city.
"Then, I will take you to experience the local customs of the Sea of Light."
This guy, his attitude was surprisingly enthusiastic.
However, Han Xing interrupted, "Isley Monarch, there’s no need for such trouble."
"We’re here at the Sea of Light for one thing."
Hearing Han Xing directly call out his name, the demigod of the Sea of Light seemed a bit surprised.
But after thinking, he didn’t seem to mind much.
Isley continued to smile and said, "May I know what the Master of the Human Race needs?"
Han Xing responded directly, "I want... that Light Attribute Divine Format in your Sea of Light."
Upon hearing this, Isley went silent, his face turning a bit unpleasant.
This issue seemed to have touched upon a certain taboo deep within him.
Moments later, he forced a smile and said, "Light Attribute Divine Format, it’s the first time I’ve heard of such a thing..."
"May I ask, where did the Master of the Human Race hear of such a Divine Format in our Sea of Light?"
Han Xing glanced at him, knowing this guy was trying to feign ignorance.
So he said directly, "Isley, there’s no need to pretend you don’t know."
"And don’t tell me it doesn’t exist."
"As soon as I arrived at the Sea of Light, I already sensed the Divine Power fluctuations from that Divine Format."
Exposed in public, Isley’s face turned a bit stiff.
He also knew that trying to play dumb wouldn’t work.
Thus, he tentatively asked, "Master of the Human Race, may I ask why you need this Light Attribute Divine Format?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "That’s something you don’t need to know."
"I understand, this Light Divine Format might be very important to you."
"But I won’t take your things for nothing."
"I can exchange it with a large amount of Calamity Divine Gold, Philosopher’s Stones, or even Middle-to-High Tier Ancient Weapons."
"As long as the price you ask is not too excessive, I can accommodate."
Hearing Han Xing’s straightforward words.
Isley’s face gradually sank.
He furrowed his brows and asked, "Master of the Human Race, can we, the Sea of Light, refuse this transaction?"
Han Xing smiled at him and asked back, "What do you think?"
Upon hearing this, Isley immediately understood Han Xing’s meaning.
No.
The opponent was determined to get that Divine Format!
At that moment, Isley’s face became increasingly gloomy.
Seeing the opponent’s unyielding attitude.
And furthermore, a human under demigod dared to threaten him.
Isley felt like bursting on the spot.
His body was trembling slightly.
Han Xing squinted his eyes, watching him closely.
Including the other team members, also got into battle mode.
If Isley made any moves, they would act immediately.
Isley looked at these humans, eager to start a fight.
Once again feeling their lawlessness.
Additionally, he remembered recent rumors about this Human Race.
And the warning given by that ancient being.
Ultimately, he swallowed his anger.
Isley sighed and said, "Master of the Human Race, this matter is beyond my authority."
"The Light Divine Format is the Divine Artifact of our Sea of Light."
"However, I can take you to meet the being that can make the decision."
"Of course, the precondition is that you can persuade him."
Han Xing suddenly squinted his eyes and asked, "The being you refer to can make the decision."
"Is it the one hidden in the depths of the Sea of Light?"
Upon hearing this, Isley looked as if his deepest secret had been exposed, and he was immensely shocked!
"Human... Master of the Human Race, you, you, you know?"
Han Xing smiled and said, "Of course I know, not only do I know he’s hiding in the Sea of Light."
"But also, he’s a Divine Spirit, isn’t he?"
Boom!
When Han Xing said the words Divine Spirit, the once serene Sea of Light.
Suddenly manifested a cloud of thunder.
From that cloud burst forth a bolt of lightning, striking straight at Han Xing.

chapters.title: Chapter 693 - 402: Let Those Who Can Decide Step Forward
paragraphs: However, Han Xing merely raised his head to glance up and then softly said, "Disperse for me."
In the next moment.
A surge of golden divine power, with an even more terrifying momentum, shot straight into the sky.
It directly obliterated the lightning that had descended into nothingness.
Additionally, it soared skyward at an even more horrifying speed.
"Buzz!"
The cluster of storm clouds directly dissipated.
And Han Xing, he didn’t even make a single move.
This technique directly shocked Demigod Level powerhouse Elis.
Because he believed he couldn’t perform such an operation.
This human with only a Legendary aura far exceeded his expectations in strength.
Isley regained composure and said, "Yes, that one is the oldest existence of our Sea of Light."
"Only he can decide whether to barter the Divine Format with everyone."
Han Xing nodded.
"I won’t make things difficult for you, just take me there."
Elis nodded with some helplessness.
He also knew he couldn’t hold back these few humans.
Then, Isley led Han Xing and the others deeper into the Sea of Light.
They hadn’t gone far.
They arrived at the largest Sky Island continent within the Sea of Light.
Hundreds of powerful auras gathered here.
Just the Legendary Level auras numbered at least over three hundred.
Among them, Han Xing also sensed Demigod Level auras, as many as four or five!
The power of the Sea of Light was even stronger compared to the Ogre Race.
However, to the one controlling Ten Thousand Stars City, Han Xing, it made no difference.
Compared to battling the Ogres,
this moment, marked his strongest state.
With the firepower from Ten Thousand Stars City, Han Xing was confident of annihilating the entire Sea of Light within five minutes.
Mind you, it was the entire Sea of Light!
Including all the Sky Islands and even those Demigod Level powerhouses and Divine Spirits.
They would all be obliterated under the terrifying firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City!
And this was his foundation for venturing into the Holy Spirit Realm.
Below.
Numerous energy creatures of the Sea of Light stared with pitch-black eyes.
With a hint of curiosity and fear, they looked towards the Sky Island.
Simultaneously, all those Legendary Powerhouses emerged.
They were afraid Isley would break negotiations with the Master of the Human Race and directly start the battle.
They had even prepared for Isley’s demise mentally.
But now it seemed, the situation hadn’t reached such a severe point.
For a moment, those Legends relaxed.
However, as Isley led Han Xing’s Sky Island to the main city of Sea of Light, they didn’t linger for a moment.
Moreover, they continued deeper onward.
At this moment, that group of Sea of Light Legends couldn’t help but ask, "Monarch, where are you going?"
Isley glanced at them and coolly replied, "Ancestral land."
"What?!"
Below, those hundreds of Sea of Light Legends instantly exploded.
Full of disbelief filled their eyes.
"Monarch, the ancestral land is the most important place to us in Sea of Light, how can you take outsiders there?"
"Yes, Monarch, the ancestral land cannot be defiled! Please reconsider!"
However, Isley didn’t respond.
He couldn’t explain to these Sea of Light legends either.
Seeing Isley’s silence, the group of Legends grew even more anxious,
"Monarch, what exactly is happening?"
"Have these humans coerced you?"
"Monarch, please tell us what exactly is going on!"
Isley remained silent, continuing to lead Han Xing and the others deeper into the Sea of Light.
At this moment.
Within the Sea of Light continent, several Demigod Level auras rose as well.
"Isley, stop right now!"
"Do you know what you’re doing?"
"You’re actually taking these outsiders to our Sea of Light’s ancestral land! This is desecration against the Lord of Light!"
"Stop it right now!
Seeing Isley still indifferent, one of the Demigod Level auras angrily said, "Isley, if you don’t stop."
"We’ll unite to remove your Monarch position!"
However, Isley appeared helpless and said, "It’s useless to talk to me."
"Tell this to the Master of the Human Race."
That demigod immediately looked towards Han Xing in the sky.
Only to see Han Xing ask, "I requested it, is there a problem?"
That demigod wanted to erupt but remembered the recent rumors about this human.
For a moment, his speech faltered.
After a pause, he reluctantly asked, "Master of the Human Race, the ancestral land is our Sea of Light’s most important, most sacred area."
"Even when the Elf King and Dwarf King visited, they never requested to enter."
"This is an act of respect towards civilizations and a basic etiquette among races."
However, Han Xing replied, "They don’t go because there’s a Divine Spirit there."
"They can’t defeat the Divine Spirit, so naturally, they dare not approach."
"I’m going this time to have a talk with your Divine Spirit."
Upon hearing this, countless Legendary Powerhouses across the Sea of Light continent widened their eyes.
Even the Light Divine Son, Neotos, looked at Han Xing with full shock.
He actually knew!
Seeing their expressions, Han Xing continued, "I said, this matter is beyond your authority."
"Having Isley lead us to the ancestral land was my request."
"Do any of you have anything to say?"
At this moment, the group below opened their mouths.
For a moment, no one knew what to say.
Just as Han Xing prepared to move past this group of powerhouses and continue towards the deeper part of the Sea of Light.
He saw the Light Divine Son suddenly transform into a stream of light, rushing into the sky.
Blocking Han Xing’s path.
Seeing the Light Divine Son, Han Xing was somewhat surprised.
"Neotos, you intend to stop me?"
Opposite him, a bitter smile appeared on the Light Divine Son’s face.
Then, as if mustering courage, he said, "Master of the Human Race, you cannot pass!"

chapters.title: Chapter 694 - 403: The Strange Divine Son of Light, Acquiring the Light Divine Format
paragraphs: Han Xing looked at him in confusion and asked, "Why? None of the demigods in your clan said anything."
The Light Divine Son still smiled bitterly and said, "Master of the Human Race, please spare our Sea of Light."
Han Xing was at a loss upon hearing this.
"What are you talking about? I said, I just want to complete a transaction, I have no intention of attacking your Sea of Light."
The Bright Divine Son said nothing, still standing in place.
Han Xing frowned and said, "Move aside quickly, I don’t have time to chat with you here."
Even the demigod-level powerhouses below were persuading Neotos to step aside.
After all, he is a man who isn’t even afraid of divine spirits.
At this moment, a voice transmitted to Neotos’s ear.
"Divine Son, step aside."
Neotos looked towards the front.
It was Isley, one of the five Monarchs of the Sea of Light, who transmitted the message.
At this moment, Isley continued to say:
"I’ve just probed, the Master of the Human Race has the power to slay demigods."
"Besides this, on his Sky Island, there is a force that makes my heart shudder."
"With the current power of the Sea of Light, we’re no match for him."
"Now, we can only pin our hopes on the Lord of Light..."
Their meaning was to have the divine spirit deep within the Sea of Light deal with this Master of the Human Race.
However, Neotos had a bitter smile on his face.
These guys don’t know the terror of this Master of the Human Race.
Although divine spirits are taboos in the entire Holy Spirit Realm, representing true invincibility.
But this human race, in the ruins of the Dwarf Race, personally took down a divine spirit.
The Bright Divine Son witnessed everything with his own eyes,
Now letting him through is like letting a wolf into a flock of sheep!
Thinking of his poor Lord of Light being subjected to the human race’s cruelty,
Neotos was filled with grief.
He must stop this tragedy from happening!
For this, he absolutely cannot step aside.
Seeing Neotos still steadfastly standing in front.
Everyone on the scene wore puzzled expressions.
And Han Xing was gradually becoming impatient.
On his body, a layer of golden divine power appeared.
"Buzz!"
Instantly, the divine power domain of the Light Divine Son was directly broken.
His face showed an expression of terror.
Then he plunged straight down from high above.
"Neotos!"
"Damn, what happened?!"
The demigod-level powerhouses all displayed looks of astonishment.
They thought Han Xing had attacked the Light Divine Son.
Each of them rushed over in fear.
In fact, this was just one of the effects of Han Xing’s All Things in the Forest.
For creatures with lower divine power value than his own, he can directly nullify their divine power value.
So, the Light Divine Son plummeted instantly.
Seeing the demigods and legendary powerhouses of the Sea of Light rushing over,
Han Xing slowly said, "Back off for me."
As his words fell, the golden divine power on his body suddenly expanded!
The entire Sea of Light Continent felt the oppressive aura from the depths of their souls!
The momentum of those demigods and legends instantly came to a halt, a strong sense of panic rising within them.
"The aura of an Emperor..."
"How is it possible, how could he have such an aura?"
At this moment, Han Xing, with his divine power burst, was filled with a golden sense of majesty.
It was as if standing before them was a true Emperor!
Even the ordinary Light Energy Bodies couldn’t help but kneel down.
The powerful beings of the Sea of Light no longer dared to step forward to block him.
Or rather, they no longer had the ability to stop Han Xing.
Han Xing was about to control the Sky Island to move forward when suddenly he saw the Light Divine Son using some means.
Unexpectedly, he staggered and stopped his falling trend.
And once again stood in front of Han Xing and his group.
The Light Divine Son had truly given a lot for their clan.
However, Han Xing’s killing intent had already locked on to him.
"Neotos, I don’t have time to mess around with you here."
The cold voice came.
The Light Divine Son’s heart trembled.
He knew, if he didn’t make way now, Han Xing would really make his move.
Neotos was now drenched in sweat.
But, for the Lord of Light, for the hope of the Sea of Light,
Neotos was willing to give up his life to stop Han Xing.
He felt as if he was bearing the torch, filled with a sense of honor.
He even actively opened his arms.
Seeing this, Han Xing no longer said much.
Instead, he nodded and said, "Very well, then I’ll fulfill you."
Just as Han Xing was about to make his move.
Suddenly, an aged voice came from the depths of the Sea of Light.
"Little Light, let him pass."
This voice could only be heard by those of legendary and above.
They immediately widened their eyes.
"This voice, it’s the Lord of Light..."
"Oh heavens, the Lord of Light has actually awakened!"
"Great Lord of Light!"
Neotos naturally heard this voice too.
But instead of feeling happy, he felt even more frustrated inside.
He stood still, not daring to move.
At this time, everyone was looking at Neotos in curiosity.
It seemed they had no idea what he was doing.
Even with the Lord of Light’s order, what was Neotos persisting for?
At this moment, that ancient being spoke again.
"Child, let them through."
Neotos was practically on the verge of tears.
Oh Lord of Light!
You don’t know the terror of these humans.
I am trying to save you!
However, no one could understand Neotos’s dilemma.
Under the scrutiny of so many eyes.
The Light Divine Son finally, could only step aside reluctantly.
Han Xing wordlessly operated the space to continue forward.
As he passed by Neotos’s side.
Han Xing muttered, "Nervous."

chapters.title: Chapter 695 - 403: The Strange Divine Son of Light, The Light Divine Format Obtained (2)
paragraphs: Then, he crossed the Central Continent and proceeded toward the depths of the Sea of Light.
Only when the group was about to leave did Neotos seem to make some sort of resolution and followed resolutely.
Then he transformed into a stream of light, trailing far behind Han Xing.
He wanted to warn his ancestor not to provoke these gods of slaughter.
Of course, Han Xing could sense that the Bright Divine Son was following them.
But he didn’t care.
An hour later.
Han Xing finally arrived at the deepest part of the Sea of Light.
Here, the light was so intense that it blinded everyone.
Intense divine power waves continuously overflowed.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but complain, "Damn, what’s with this place, I feel like I’ve been forcibly blinded."
"How do you all feel?"
Shen Yun also covered his eyes and said, "Same here, I can’t see a thing."
Even Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang completely lost their vision.
However, Han Xing was unaffected.
Ever since he was struck by lightning last time.
His body had undergone some kind of transformation.
General negative states simply couldn’t affect him.
Even divine-level power of rules would be immune to his passive skills: All Things in the Forest.
So, now Han Xing was essentially unaffected by these states.
Han Xing observed his team members and said, "Close your eyes, the Light Divine Format might be different from the locations of other divine formats and could affect us in unexpected ways."
"Leave it to me here."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded.
It was clear they trusted Han Xing.
The deeper they ventured, the denser the light aura became, nearly condensing into substance.
At this moment, a shapeless, faceless shadow suddenly appeared before the group.
From that shadow, Han Xing sensed an ancient and vast aura.
It was as if standing before them wasn’t a figure.
But a blazing sun!
Although Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong couldn’t see.
The oppressive sensation from deep in their souls caused them unease.
Then, a series of system prompts appeared.
[You have gazed upon an existence beyond the rules, your sight has been forcibly taken, All Things in the Forest skill activated, removal failed.]
[You are shrouded by the aura of an existence beyond the rules, all attributes reduced, All Things in the Forest skill activated, status negated.]
[You are under the divine might of an existence beyond the rules, mobility reduced, All Things in the Forest skill activated, status negated.]
Seeing these system prompts, a smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
Indeed, after acquiring the All Things in the Forest skill.
Even these divine spirits couldn’t affect him.
At this moment, the light shadow saw Han Xing still calmly standing in place, seemingly surprised.
"Master of the Human Race..."
An ancient voice appeared out of nowhere in everyone’s ears.
Then the light shadow vanished on the spot.
A strong sense of crisis rose in Han Xing’s heart instantly.
He quickly said, "Stop!"
Han Xing directly manipulated over a thousand high-tier defense towers on top of the Ten Thousand Stars City.
Entering a charging state simultaneously.
"Buzz!"
Snowflakes danced, energy stirred.
At this moment.
A deathly sense of crisis that covered the entire Sea of Light emerged.
Previously, just over three hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons posed a death threat to the God of Tricks.
And now, the power of the defense towers on Han Xing’s territory expanded several times over!
With just one wave of concentrated fire.
Han Xing was confident he could directly take down this divine spirit.
At this moment, that ancient presence appeared again.
But internally, it was already tumultuous!
From the man’s Sky Island, he could sense the crisis of death!
An unrealistic feeling surfaced in his heart.
He was a divine spirit, wasn’t he?
Yet he felt a threat of death from a group of legendary level beings?
This was utterly absurd.
At this moment, an ancient voice sounded.
"Master of the Human Race, truly extraordinary methods."
"Now I understand how that trickster fell into your hands."
Han Xing smiled, "It’s good that you know."
"So, you should also keep some distance from me."
"I’ve experienced the speed of divine-level adversaries."
"If by accident, I get startled and attack you, it could get quite messy!"
"At that time, it might become irreparable."
At this moment, the ancient presence again fell silent.
In his memory, he seemed to never have encountered such a situation,
A little fellow not even at legendary level dared to talk to him like this.
But thinking back, he dared to kill even Tricks.
What was there under the heavens that he didn’t dare to do?
A moment later, the ancient presence said, "Alright, I won’t come near you."
Han Xing’s thought was correct.
This divine spirit initially intended to utilize his divine-level strength to suddenly strike.
And then control this group of humans.
But the divine spirit never expected, Han Xing’s response was so swift and alert.
This ancient presence ultimately chose to concede.
The first probing wave saw Han Xing gaining the upper hand.
Han Xing saw the opponent indeed stayed put.
Maintaining a safe distance from them.
Relieving his mind slightly.
But Han Xing remained vigilant.
All defense towers maintained their attack stance, ready to deliver a fatal blow at any moment.

Previously, just over three hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons posed a death threat to the God of Tricks.
And now, the power of the defense towers on Han Xing’s territory expanded several times over!
With just one wave of concentrated fire.
Han Xing was confident he could directly take down this divine spirit.
At this moment, that ancient presence appeared again.
But internally, it was already tumultuous!
From the man’s Sky Island, he could sense the crisis of death!
An unrealistic feeling surfaced in his heart.
He was a divine spirit, wasn’t he?
Yet he felt a threat of death from a group of legendary level beings?
This was utterly absurd.
At this moment, an ancient voice sounded.
"Master of the Human Race, truly extraordinary methods."
"Now I understand how that trickster fell into your hands."
Han Xing smiled, "It’s good that you know."
"So, you should also keep some distance from me."
"I’ve experienced the speed of divine-level adversaries."
"If by accident, I get startled and attack you, it could get quite messy!"
"At that time, it might become irreparable."
At this moment, the ancient presence again fell silent.
In his memory, he seemed to never have encountered such a situation,
A little fellow not even at legendary level dared to talk to him like this.
But thinking back, he dared to kill even Tricks.
What was there under the heavens that he didn’t dare to do?
A moment later, the ancient presence said, "Alright, I won’t come near you."
Han Xing’s thought was correct.
This divine spirit initially intended to utilize his divine-level strength to suddenly strike.
And then control this group of humans.
But the divine spirit never expected, Han Xing’s response was so swift and alert.
This ancient presence ultimately chose to concede.
The first probing wave saw Han Xing gaining the upper hand.
Han Xing saw the opponent indeed stayed put.
Maintaining a safe distance from them.
Relieving his mind slightly.
But Han Xing remained vigilant.
All defense towers maintained their attack stance, ready to deliver a fatal blow at any moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 696 - 403: The Strange Divine Son of Light, The Light Divine Format Obtained (3)
paragraphs: The ancient existence opposite didn’t say much.
Instead, it was the Bright Divine Son in the distance who felt relieved as the tense standoff between the two sides eased.
He couldn’t help but let out a long sigh of relief.
’Fortunately, they didn’t start fighting.’ The Bright Divine Son felt a sense of relief.
On the opposite side, the shadow of the Divine Spirit spoke, "Master of the Human Race, I already know your intentions."
"But you also know that the Light Divine Format is crucial to us in the Sea of Light."
"Our people have lived by absorbing this light aura for thousands of years."
"If you take away the Light Divine Format, it will be as if you’ve cut off the source of survival for billions of our kind in the Sea of Light."
"At that time, the entire Sea of Light might cease to exist."
This guy was deliberately making the consequences sound severe.
However, Han Xing was almost tired of hearing these platitudes.
He directly said, "Alright, don’t think I don’t know."
"This thing can only nurture an Initial-tier Demigod at most."
"The Light Divine Power it emits is far less than that of a true Divine Spirit like you."
"Even without this Divine Format, you could just disperse a bit of the Power of Light, and it would be enough for your people to survive."
After several prior collections of Divine Formats, Han Xing had long understood the characteristics of these formats.
So this guy’s attempt to exaggerate the issue didn’t scare Han Xing.
Being exposed publicly by Han Xing, the shadow was silent for a moment again.
Then, it chuckled slightly, "This young friend seems to know quite a bit."
"It seems you must take away this Divine Format."
Han Xing nodded, "That’s right, and there’s no need for you to talk about severe consequences anymore."
"Just tell me, what conditions do you need?"
"Whether it’s High-tier Ancient Weapons, Calamity Divine Gold, or a large amount of Philosopher’s Stones, I can give them to you."
After pondering for a moment, the other party said, "Young friend, can those Defense Towers on your territory be traded?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing paused for a moment.
Then he said, "Yes, but only up to ten."
"These Defense Towers require a lot of resources, and they can’t exert such great power once outside my territory."
Han Xing was speaking the truth.
The shadow with an indistinct face seemed somewhat disappointed after hearing this.
But he could feel that Han Xing had not lied to him.
A moment later, he said slowly, "Alright then, I won’t need High-tier Ancient Weapons or some other materials."
"I hope the Master of the Human Race can help me find something."
Hearing this, Han Xing furrowed his brows again.
But he still patiently asked, "What is it?"
The existence said, "A large bird with three heads, emanating a seven-colored divine light over its body."
"A bird?" Han Xing asked in confusion.
"Yes, it’s a Divine Bird I encountered by chance several thousand years ago."
"I’ve searched through all the materials in the Holy Spirit Realm, and there is no record of such a Divine Bird."
"Over the years, I even began to doubt whether I was experiencing some kind of illusion."
Han Xing asked, "You, a Divine Spirit, couldn’t find this elusive thing, and you want me to look for it?"
However, the other party explained, "This Divine Bird appeared when I had just reached the Demigod extreme and was about to break through to Divine Spirit."
"At that time, I might have been the existence with the strongest fortune in the entire Holy Spirit Realm."
"I vaguely suspect that this Divine Bird appears around people with strong fortune."
"And I see the Master of the Human Race as probably the person with the strongest fortune in this era."
"Placing my hopes on you might yield some unexpected joy."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing furrowed his brows again, "What if I can’t find it?"
The ancient shadow replied, "Even if you can’t find it, it doesn’t matter."
"Just think of it as the old man’s wish..."
Han Xing nodded, "The way you put it, I can agree."
"But if I can’t find it, don’t blame me."
The other party laughed softly twice, "Of course, I won’t blame you."
"Then, Master of the Human Race, go and take it yourself."
"I think this Light Divine Format shouldn’t be too difficult for you."
Thus, the two sides quickly completed this wave of transactions.
Seeing him so straightforward, Han Xing was a bit incredulous.
He stared at the Divine Spirit until its aura disappeared from where it stood.
Only then did Han Xing gradually relax.
Then, he led everyone toward the deepest part of the Sea of Light.
A few minutes later.
They had already approached within ten thousand meters of the Light Divine Format.
Other than seeing a vast expanse of whiteness ahead, no other situations arose.
The Light Divine Format, unlike other Divine Formats, did not create various extreme environments.
Its effects on everyone were mostly limited to depriving them of sight and disorienting them.
And the deeper they went, the stronger that feeling of bewilderment grew.
If trapped inside, one might never be able to escape for a lifetime.
But fortunately, ever since acquiring the All Things in the Forest skill, Han Xing was no longer affected by such a state.
Therefore, taking this Light Divine Format.
For them, it was almost the safest experience in history.
When Han Xing reached five thousand meters of the Light Divine Format area.
A familiar system prompt.
[Target Race Detected: Human Race, Strength: Legendary Level, Light Restriction Removed...]
The dense power of light dissipated.
Everyone’s vision was restored.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun exhaled a long breath.
"Wow, although the light restriction won’t harm people."
"This feeling of seeing nothing and having no sense of direction really made me feel a bit helpless."
Han Xing smiled, "We’ve reached the location of the Divine Format."
Their spirits immediately lifted.
Soon, they saw that completely white, faintly glowing rhombic crystal.
Then they directly put it away.
[Acquired Special Item: Elemental Law God, Seven Elements Divine Format (Light)]
After that, Han Xing looked at his team and said, "Let’s go, to the next destination."
"We’re heading to the Realm of Darkness."
