chapters.title: Chapter 697 - 404: Acquiring the Dark Divine Format
paragraphs: Time passed, and soon a week had gone by...
Han Xing and the others traveled continuously, and at this moment, they had reached the Realm of Darkness.
It seemed that news of their arrival was already known.
The Dark Divine Son was waiting there early.
This being, enveloped in black energy waves, had an indistinct face.
At this moment, his body stood straight, holding a black longsword, looking like a black-clothed swordsman.
Upon seeing Han Xing and the others, a familiar faint smile came through,
"Brother Han Xing, since the last parting at the relic, we haven’t met again."
"I hope you have been well..."
Han Xing nodded, "I hope you have been well. It seems that the Dark Divine Son is doing well."
The Dark Divine Son shook his head with a smile, "How can I compare to Brother Han Xing?"
"Although I haven’t met Brother Han Xing recently,"
"Stories about you have been constantly reaching my ears."
"Brother Han Xing is now a renowned figure in the entire Holy Spirit Realm."
Han Xing also smiled lightly.
He didn’t say much, speaking directly, "Dark Divine Son, there’s no need for pleasantries."
"You should know the purpose of my visit to your Realm of Darkness?"
The Dark Divine Son nodded, "Naturally, I know."
"Any information regarding Brother Han Xing is relayed to those major clans at the first opportunity."
"We have also heard about your quest for these Divine Formats."
Han Xing nodded, "Since that’s the case, you must be aware of the significance of this Divine Format to me."
"Even the Divine Spirits cannot prevent us from taking these Divine Formats."
"If possible, I don’t wish to engage in disputes with you over the Divine Formats."
The Dark Divine Son laughed, "Brother Han Xing, you are too serious."
"Our clan has developed to this point, no longer solely relying on the divine power emanating from the Divine Formats to survive.
"So this Divine Format isn’t that crucial to us."
"If Brother Han Xing desires it, then it is yours."
Upon hearing this, joy appeared on the faces of the team members.
They seemingly didn’t expect the Dark Divine Son to be so agreeable.
To effortlessly give away the precious Divine Format.
Even Han Xing smiled, "Dark Divine Son, you are indeed straightforward."
"However, we won’t take your things for free either."
Han Xing waved his hand broadly.
A large pile of Calamity Divine Gold, Philosopher’s Stones, and middle-to-high tier ancient weapons appeared in front of him.
Rough estimates put the quantity of Calamity Divine Gold at at least ten thousand, and the Philosopher’s Stones at a million.
Ten middle-tier ancient weapons and three high-tier ancient weapons.
Even the Dark Divine Son revealed a look of astonishment upon seeing these items.
As a Divine Son of a major clan, he was well aware of the value of these items.
The preciousness of Calamity Divine Gold was well-known throughout the entire Holy Spirit Realm.
As for those ancient weapons, they were invaluable.
Such things could increase the foundation of an entire clan.
Especially since there were high-tier ancient weapons among them.
These could even harm an initial-tier demigod!
Plus, there were at least a million Philosopher’s Stones.
The Dark Divine Son pondered for a moment and did not refuse.
His Dark Divine Power spread out, and he reclaimed all those things.
Thus, both parties swiftly engaged in a significant transaction.
Meanwhile.
Many eyes in the Realm of Darkness were also focused on them.
The news of Han Xing and his group’s visit had already spread throughout the entire Realm of Darkness.
For a time, all the strong figures felt uneasy and anxious.
After all, the notorious reputation of Han Xing had spread throughout the whole Holy Spirit Realm.
However, the Dark Divine Son voluntarily proposed that he could communicate with Han Xing.
Initially, those powerful figures of the Realm of Darkness disagreed.
After all, the Dark Divine Son was the hope of their clan, even nurtured as the next Clan Leader.
If he were killed by that Great Killing God, they would have nowhere to cry.
But now, it seemed that the Master of the Human Race was not as brutal as rumored.
Moreover, it appeared that the two engaged in pleasant conversation.
For a moment, they all breathed a sigh of relief.
Those vigilant gazes gradually retreated.
Han Xing cast a glance.
With the strength of his Divine Power, he naturally sensed the attention of these powerful figures.
Among them, he also felt an ancient, decaying aura.
Similar to the one in the Sea of Light.
The Realm of Darkness also had a Divine Spirit level presence.
However, Han Xing did not care.
From this being in the Realm of Darkness, he didn’t sense any hostility.
Next, under the guidance of the Dark Divine Son, Han Xing and the others proceeded forward.
They ventured deeper into the heart of the Realm of Darkness.
Here, Han Xing and the others felt the intense Power of Darkness.
Simultaneously, a system prompt appeared.
[You have been affected by the Dark Divine Power; your Divine Power and vision have been sealed. Additionally, every five seconds, you are affected by mind confusion.]
The team members once again fell into a state of blindness.
Compared to the bright white when contacting the Light Divine Format,
Now, it was complete darkness.
[Passive: All Things in the Forest takes effect, Dark Divine Power influence nullified...]
At this moment, Shen Yun and the others were like they had suddenly been locked inside a black box.
Unable to hear any sound or perceive anything.
All five senses were completely stripped away.
Just like the first time facing the God of Light.
They blindly wandered across the Sky Island.
Even nearing the edge of the Sky Island, about to fall off.
Throughout all this, the four were utterly unaware.
Not even Han Xing’s voice reached them.
Han Xing frowned.
After pondering for a moment, he directly cast a seal of divine power forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 698 - 404: Acquiring the Dark Divine Format (Part 2)
paragraphs: Tied all four people up.
Then, he continued deeper into the Realm of Darkness.
Here, everything turned as black as ink.
Couldn’t see anything.
The entire universe was completely pitch dark.
Yet within this darkness.
A golden light pierced the endless blackness and illuminated the surrounding environment.
It was precisely Han Xing’s Divine Power Domain.
The Dark Divine Son, who was beside him, also witnessed Han Xing’s display.
Amidst that divine power, he even felt a strong sense of unease.
The Dark Divine Son murmured in his heart: "He’s gotten stronger again..."
At this time, the Dark Divine Son transmitted a voice saying: "Brother Han, now that we’re here, I can’t accompany you further."
"The remaining path requires you to proceed alone."
Han Xing waved his hand and said, "No problem, you go ahead."
The Dark Divine Son nodded, then left this place.
At this moment, Han Xing supported himself with the Divine Power Shield.
Like a small boat sailing in the endless darkness.
Upon reaching the 5000-meter zone.
All darkness disappeared.
The four team members showed a bewildered expression in their eyes.
They regained their senses.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong discovered he was bound by Han Xing’s divine power and exclaimed in surprise: "Whoa, Brother Xing, what did you do to me?"
"Could it be you did something indescribable to us while we were unconscious?"
Upon hearing this, the two women seemed to realize something.
Their faces immediately turned red with shame.
Han Xing looked at him speechlessly and said, "Shut your mouth."
"If I hadn’t tied you up, you would have fallen down by now."
Cheng Jianyong laughed sheepishly once he understood.
Of course, his words were just a joke.
He also knew Han Xing wouldn’t do anything to them.
Then, the group arrived at the very center of the Realm of Darkness.
There lay an extremely pure black rhombic crystal.
At Han Xing’s gesture, Zhang Lianmeng put away this Dark Divine Format.
Everyone’s faces simultaneously lit up with joy.
With this, they had collected five divine formats.
Now, they only lacked the final Earth Divine Format and Wind Divine Format.
Cheng Jianyong asked with a smile, "Brother Xing, where’s our next stop, Crystal Mountain or Silent Wind Islands?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Neither."
"Those two places are in the other direction in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"From our current location, it’s tens of millions of kilometers away."
"If we want to go to Crystal Mountain and Silent Wind Islands, we’ll have to pass through the Witch Race Territory."
"It will take at least two or three months for a round trip."
After hearing this, everyone paused for a moment.
Shen Yun then asked, "Brother Xing, where’s our next destination?"
Han Xing thought for a moment,
"Let’s return to the Witch Race Territory first."
"I want to check on the Thunder Stone Ore Vein that the thunder beasts took and see how the mining is going."
"To see if we can make a few more Tower of Annihilation Lightning."
"Then, prepare to head to the Abyss Realm again."
"Abyss Realm?" Cheng Jianyong’s eyes suddenly lit up.
"That’s awesome, does this mean we can continue leveling up crazily?"
Han Xing nodded.
"Going to the Abyss Realm to level up is one reason."
"There’s actually another important reason."
Upon hearing this, curiosity arose within everyone.
Cheng Jianyong asked confusedly, "Brother Xing, what is it?"
Han Xing replied directly, "On the 90th layer of the Abyssal Rift, there’s the Divine Treasure Vault of the God of Tricks."
"What!?"
Hearing this, everyone fell into intense shock.
Then, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Wow, the God of Tricks hid his treasure vault in such a place?
"That’s just too outrageous!"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, this guy truly has some secrets."
"If it weren’t for that woman telling me the position, no one would have guessed."
"The God of Tricks actually hid his treasure vault within the Abyssal Rift."
Everyone nodded in agreement, marveling at the cunning of the God of Tricks.
Shen Yun thought aloud, "But this also indirectly illustrates how terrifying that woman is."
"She even knows such things."
"It feels like nothing in the Holy Spirit Realm is hidden from her."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s mind also envisioned the woman’s figure.
The more he delved into the powers in the Holy Spirit Realm.
The more he saw her vast abilities.
Every hidden place in the Holy Spirit Realm was under her control.
She even knew the deepest secrets hidden by each great tribe.
And according to Han Xing’s understanding, this woman seemed to have secretly fueled several wars in the Holy Spirit Realm?
Such a terrifying character.
Yet the major tribes in the Holy Spirit Realm just let her exist?
This made Han Xing ponder asking the three tribes face-to-face, or those ancient beings, what they’re truly thinking.
Moreover, up until now, no one knows what this woman’s intentions are.
Could it be she’s simply trying to cause chaos in the Holy Spirit Realm?
Han Xing shook his head, dismissing these thoughts from his mind.
No matter what her purpose is.
She is ultimately just a demigod, not breaking the limits of power in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Otherwise, last time, she wouldn’t have chosen to pay the price to save the God of Tricks, but rather forcibly snatched him.
Of course, it’s also possible this is part of that woman’s scheme.
Perhaps she’s intentionally playing weak, leading Han Xing step by step into her trap.
But Han Xing doesn’t pay much attention to these things.
Even if she is indeed setting traps for him.
He’s undoubtedly gained tremendous opportunities and improved his strength rapidly.
Han Xing believes as long as he continues to grow stronger at a fast enough pace.
Even faster than everyone could anticipate.

sentences.text: Tied all four people up.
Then, he continued deeper into the Realm of Darkness.
Here, everything turned as black as ink.
Couldn’t see anything.
The entire universe was completely pitch dark.
Yet within this darkness.
A golden light pierced the endless blackness and illuminated the surrounding environment.
It was precisely Han Xing’s Divine Power Domain.
The Dark Divine Son, who was beside him, also witnessed Han Xing’s display.
Amidst that divine power, he even felt a strong sense of unease.
The Dark Divine Son murmured in his heart: "He’s gotten stronger again..."
At this time, the Dark Divine Son transmitted a voice saying: "Brother Han, now that we’re here, I can’t accompany you further."
"The remaining path requires you to proceed alone."
Han Xing waved his hand and said, "No problem, you go ahead."
The Dark Divine Son nodded, then left this place.
At this moment, Han Xing supported himself with the Divine Power Shield.
Like a small boat sailing in the endless darkness.
Upon reaching the 5000-meter zone.
All darkness disappeared.
The four team members showed a bewildered expression in their eyes.
They regained their senses.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong discovered he was bound by Han Xing’s divine power and exclaimed in surprise: "Whoa, Brother Xing, what did you do to me?"
"Could it be you did something indescribable to us while we were unconscious?"
Upon hearing this, the two women seemed to realize something.
Their faces immediately turned red with shame.
Han Xing looked at him speechlessly and said, "Shut your mouth."
"If I hadn’t tied you up, you would have fallen down by now."
Cheng Jianyong laughed sheepishly once he understood.
Of course, his words were just a joke.
He also knew Han Xing wouldn’t do anything to them.
Then, the group arrived at the very center of the Realm of Darkness.
There lay an extremely pure black rhombic crystal.
At Han Xing’s gesture, Zhang Lianmeng put away this Dark Divine Format.
Everyone’s faces simultaneously lit up with joy.
With this, they had collected five divine formats.
Now, they only lacked the final Earth Divine Format and Wind Divine Format.
Cheng Jianyong asked with a smile, "Brother Xing, where’s our next stop, Crystal Mountain or Silent Wind Islands?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Neither."
"Those two places are in the other direction in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"From our current location, it’s tens of millions of kilometers away."
"If we want to go to Crystal Mountain and Silent Wind Islands, we’ll have to pass through the Witch Race Territory."
"It will take at least two or three months for a round trip."
After hearing this, everyone paused for a moment.
Shen Yun then asked, "Brother Xing, where’s our next destination?"
Han Xing thought for a moment,
"Let’s return to the Witch Race Territory first."
"I want to check on the Thunder Stone Ore Vein that the thunder beasts took and see how the mining is going."
"To see if we can make a few more Tower of Annihilation Lightning."
"Then, prepare to head to the Abyss Realm again."
"Abyss Realm?" Cheng Jianyong’s eyes suddenly lit up.
"That’s awesome, does this mean we can continue leveling up crazily?"
Han Xing nodded.
"Going to the Abyss Realm to level up is one reason."
"There’s actually another important reason."
Upon hearing this, curiosity arose within everyone.
Cheng Jianyong asked confusedly, "Brother Xing, what is it?"
Han Xing replied directly, "On the 90th layer of the Abyssal Rift, there’s the Divine Treasure Vault of the God of Tricks."
"What!?"
Hearing this, everyone fell into intense shock.
Then, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Wow, the God of Tricks hid his treasure vault in such a place?
"That’s just too outrageous!"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, this guy truly has some secrets."
"If it weren’t for that woman telling me the position, no one would have guessed."
"The God of Tricks actually hid his treasure vault within the Abyssal Rift."
Everyone nodded in agreement, marveling at the cunning of the God of Tricks.
Shen Yun thought aloud, "But this also indirectly illustrates how terrifying that woman is."
"She even knows such things."
"It feels like nothing in the Holy Spirit Realm is hidden from her."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s mind also envisioned the woman’s figure.
The more he delved into the powers in the Holy Spirit Realm.
The more he saw her vast abilities.
Every hidden place in the Holy Spirit Realm was under her control.
She even knew the deepest secrets hidden by each great tribe.
And according to Han Xing’s understanding, this woman seemed to have secretly fueled several wars in the Holy Spirit Realm?
Such a terrifying character.
Yet the major tribes in the Holy Spirit Realm just let her exist?
This made Han Xing ponder asking the three tribes face-to-face, or those ancient beings, what they’re truly thinking.
Moreover, up until now, no one knows what this woman’s intentions are.
Could it be she’s simply trying to cause chaos in the Holy Spirit Realm?
Han Xing shook his head, dismissing these thoughts from his mind.
No matter what her purpose is.
She is ultimately just a demigod, not breaking the limits of power in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Otherwise, last time, she wouldn’t have chosen to pay the price to save the God of Tricks, but rather forcibly snatched him.
Of course, it’s also possible this is part of that woman’s scheme.
Perhaps she’s intentionally playing weak, leading Han Xing step by step into her trap.
But Han Xing doesn’t pay much attention to these things.
Even if she is indeed setting traps for him.
He’s undoubtedly gained tremendous opportunities and improved his strength rapidly.
Han Xing believes as long as he continues to grow stronger at a fast enough pace.
Even faster than everyone could anticipate.

chapters.title: Chapter 699 - 404: Acquiring the Dark Divine Format_3
paragraphs: Then all these calculations would not fall on me!
Thinking of this, Han Xing began to manipulate the Sky Island.
Turning to head towards the direction of the Witch Race Territory.
The powerhouses of the Realm of Darkness watched Han Xing’s departure...
Time passed quickly.
In the blink of an eye, half a month had passed.
On this day, Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City was still advancing rapidly in the Holy Spirit Realm.
There was still approximately one or two weeks’ journey to the Witch Race Territory.
But halfway there, he suddenly changed direction.
The direction he headed was toward the Dwarf Realm.
"Brother Xing, are we going to the Dwarf Realm?" Shen Yun asked from behind.
Han Xing nodded, "That’s right, in the Dwarf Royal Capital, there are still some things we need to retrieve."
He hadn’t forgotten that some time ago, he had entrusted the Dwarf Race’s Master of Forging, Balrog.
Han Xing asked Balrog to forge a Divine Artifact Level Set for him.
After so long, it should be finished by now.
Three days later.
Han Xing arrived very low-key in the Dwarf Realm, without attracting much attention.
However, he was still detected by the powerful Dwarf King.
The moment Han Xing and his companions stepped into the Dwarf Realm’s territory.
A streak of light flew swiftly.
And immediately appeared beside Han Xing.
It was the Dwarf King.
The Dwarf King did not shy away from approaching because of the defense towers on Han Xing’s territory.
Instead, he naturally stood by his side and said with a smile, "Brother Han Xing, long time no see."
Since learning of Han Xing’s strength, the Dwarf King’s address towards him had changed.
Han Xing didn’t mind and just nodded.
It had been about two or three months since he left the Dwarf Realm.
The Dwarf King’s power remained very solid.
However, compared to the past, his face looked quite haggard.
Han Xing looked at him and asked, "Your Majesty, seeing your expression, have you encountered any troubles lately?"
The Dwarf King gave him a helpless look, sighed, and said, "Brother Han Xing, you’re right."
"The last time you told me, the powerhouses in my race might have been parasitized by monsters from the ruins."
"I went to verify it within my clan."
"Indeed, as you said, our legendary and even demigod level powerhouses have been parasitized by those Insect Race creatures from the ruins."
Upon hearing this, everyone present’s expressions changed slightly.
No one expected the information Han Xing provided to the Dwarf King would be trusted by him.
Moreover, he went to investigate the powerhouses within his own race.
Han Xing knew how well those Insect Race disguised themselves.
Even the system could not detect them.
It’s imaginable that the Dwarf King must have used some coercive measures.
A trace of bitterness crossed his face, and he looked at Han Xing and said.
"Brother Han Xing, thank you very much for the information you provided."
"Had it not been for your reminder, I might never have known that so many powerhouses of our Dwarf Race had been parasitized."
After speaking, the Dwarf King solemnly thanked him.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing smiled and said, "Your Majesty, there’s no need for courtesy."
After a pause, he continued, "Your Majesty, have all the parasitized powerhouses been found?"
The Dwarf King heard this and shook his head helplessly, "As Saint Master Han Xing can see, no, they have not."
"After days of investigation, we only found three legendary and one demigod level individuals who have been parasitized."
"But I have a feeling that there are certainly more."
Han Xing nodded at this.
The Dwarf King was indeed correct.
From what the control center of the ruins told them before.
There were as many as 8 legendary and two demigod individuals.
And, it is not ruled out that the control system lied to them.
The actual number might be more.
Thus, the few Insect Race members the Dwarf King identified were not all of them.
The Dwarf King continued, "These Insect Race are so well hidden, and their methods are incredibly bewildering.
"They not only possess all the memories of our clan members but also have remarkable endurance."
"No matter how I interrogate them, they always put on an innocent facade and refuse to say anything."
"If it were not for me hardening my heart and slaying a very suspicious legendary level individual on the spot."
"After its death, thousands of insects emerged from its body, along with a dense number of eggs."
"Only then did I believe the information Brother Han Xing provided was true."
Although the Dwarf King spoke calmly.
The crowd could imagine the scene at the time.
A legendary level powerhouse being killed and a large number of insects crawling out of the body.
Along with a significant amount of insect eggs inside.
That scene must have been quite shocking.
Han Xing asked, "Can’t the other hidden Insect Race members be found?"
The Dwarf King shook his head, "They can’t be found."
"This group of Insect Race has parasitized our race for many years."
"Unless I kill all the legendary and demigod individuals in our race, it’s impossible to root them all out."
Upon hearing this, the crowd was stunned for a moment.
The Dwarf Race had controlled the Ancient Ruins for so many years.
While enjoying the opportunities within, they also bore the risks.
Of course, Han Xing couldn’t really provide much help either.
At this moment, the Dwarf King asked, "Brother Han Xing, what brings you to the Dwarf Realm this time?"
"Do you need me to prepare a place for you to rest?"
The Dwarf King finally asked the main question.
Last time, Han Xing had slaughtered the Ogre Lord in the Dwarf Realm.
He was truly afraid that Han Xing would cause another earth-shattering event this time.
Han Xing replied, "Your Majesty, this time I came to the Dwarf Realm just to retrieve the items I commissioned Grandmaster Balrog to forge last time."
"We will leave soon, no need for all that trouble."
Hearing this, the Dwarf King also heaved a sigh of relief.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to remember something and suddenly asked, "Oh right, Your Majesty."
"Grandmaster Balrog hasn’t been imprisoned by you, has he?"

chapters.title: Chapter 700 - 405: Behemoth Set, Return to the Witch Race Territory
paragraphs: The Dwarf King paused for a moment after hearing, then shook his head and said, "No."
"Grandmaster Balrog has not been to the Ancient Ruins."
"So he is not suspected of being parasitized."
Han Xing nodded, "Your Majesty, you can carry on with your duties."
"I’ll leave the Dwarf Realm right after I collect my things."
The Dwarf King nodded upon hearing this.
Then he transformed directly into a stream of light and disappeared.
After the Dwarf King left, Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, weren’t we planning to continue exploring the Ancient Ruins to seize the opportunities inside?"
"Should we let the Dwarf King know?"
Han Xing shook his head, "Not for now, the Ancient Ruins are closed, and we don’t know when they’ll open again."
"I’ll talk to him when it’s about to open."
Shen Yun nodded.
Then, they easily arrived at the Dwarf Royal Capital without any obstruction from the Dwarf soldiers.
The five of Han Xing headed straight to Balrog’s forge.
And then walked in.
The forge was as bustling as ever.
Thousands of Dwarf apprentices were bustling in and out of the forge hall.
Around them, various hammering sounds came from the forging chambers.
Passing through the forge hall, Han Xing arrived at a large forge at the back.
Inside, they quickly found Grandmaster Balrog.
Seeing Han Xing come over.
Grandmaster Balrog couldn’t help but sigh.
Who would have thought the human kid who once brought Divine Beast scales to have equipment crafted.
Would turn out to be the current Master of the Human Race.
And possess such formidable power.
Thinking back, he even wanted to take him as a disciple.
Now thinking about it, Grandmaster Balrog felt a rush of heat on his face.
Grandmaster Balrog said, "You are here."
Han Xing nodded and got straight to the point, "Grandmaster Balrog, how are the pieces of equipment I commissioned from you last time?
Grandmaster Balrog, looking somewhat haggard, glanced at Han Xing.
Then said, "To craft these pieces of equipment for you, I’ve spent nearly all my energy over the past half year."
"This old body of mine is almost falling apart."
Hearing this, Han Xing laughed.
It was evident Balrog wasn’t lying.
The aura around him was indeed very chaotic,
and there were dark circles under his eyes.
Han Xing said, "Master, you’ve worked hard."
As for extra reward, Han Xing saw no need for it.
Because last time, he gave Balrog quite a bit of Rhythm Black Iron.
Grandmaster Balrog nodded, "They’re all crafted, just finished a week ago."
"I’ll have someone bring them to you right away."
After speaking, Grandmaster Balrog made a gesture.
A few minutes later.
Several Dwarf soldiers with Fourth-Turn Leader Level strength.
Came over, each pair carrying a large chest.
The chests seemed very heavy.
As they walked, a tremor came from their footsteps.
"Clang! Clang!"
Four chests landed in front of everyone.
Han Xing and the others saw that inside were a set of gray armor, bottoms, a helmet, and shoes.
Even before approaching, a fierce aura rushed towards them.
Seeing this equipment, Shen Yun’s eyes lit up instantly.
Cheng Jianyong beside him, eyed them with envy.
Because, these were armors made with scales from Divine-level creatures.
Truly a Divine Artifact Set.
At the same time, the attributes of this equipment appeared before everyone.
[Giant Beast Armor (Red) lv60, Quality: Divine Artifact, Armor: 12673~13423, Constitution +5000, Spirit +2000.]
[Attached Effect]: Divine Level Unloading, Divine-level Energy Decay, Heart of Struggle (Legendary Effect), Fierce Beast Flame (Epic Effect), Calamity Descending (Divine-level Effect)
[Giant Beast Helmet (Red) lv60, Quality: Divine Artifact, Armor 4298~4623, Spirit +5000, Constitution +2000, Hit Rate -10%]
[Attached Effect]: Dizziness Immunity, Eye of the Fierce Beast, Calamity Will, Calamity Incarnation...
[Giant Beast Lower Armor (Red) lv60, Quality: Divine Artifact, Armor 6219~6522, Constitution +4000, Spirit +4000, Movement Ability -10%]
[Attached Effect]: Divine-level Critical Resistance, Divine Armor-Piercing Resistance, Source of Calamity...
[Giant Beast Boots (Red) lv60, Quality: Divine Artifact, Armor 3133~3412, All Attributes +2000, Movement Speed +50%]
[Attached Effect]: Immune to Speed Decay, Divine-level Ice Decay, Breath of Calamity...
A total of four Divine Artifact Level equipment!
Although they don’t have set effects, their strong armor, and terrifying attribute bonuses.
Were enough to cause tremors in everyone’s heart.
Plus, there were four Divine-level Effects, along with a bunch of other effects.
Even a pig wearing this set could turn into a warrior pig!
Shen Yun couldn’t wait to put them on.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said with a tinge of jealousy, "Damn it, I’m really envious."
"I am still wearing level 40 Orange Set, and you have the level 60 Divine Artifact Set ready."
Shen Yun chuckled, his eyes full of pride.
Speaking of which, since they couldn’t enter the Abyssal Rift.
It had been a long time since they replaced any equipment.
On one hand, because they hadn’t found suitable new equipment.
On the other hand, because the set attributes they had were good, so no one wanted to replace them.
However, as they approached level 60.
They indeed needed to change to higher-level equipment.
Shen Yun eagerly stored all four pieces of equipment in his backpack.
Cheng Jianyong said, "Hey kid, now except for weapons and jewelry, you’re already wearing all Divine Artifact level equipment, aren’t you?"
